Indicates whether the comparable property is furnished.

terms.term: Comparable Sales Price Range High Amount
terms.definition: Specifies the high sale value in the range of values within the group of comparable sales researched.

terms.term: Comparable Sales Price Range Low Amount
terms.definition: Specifies the low sale value in the range of values within the group of comparable sales researched.
Specifies the total number of comparable property sales researched.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list which represents the compass direction the comparable property is located when compared to the subject property location.
Indicates the status of the property as either a competitive offering, comparable offering, comparable active listing, comparable expired listing or closed sale.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Comparable Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the emphasis given to the comparable.
Properties used for comparative purposes in the appraisal process that have similar characteristics to the subject property. Also called "comps."

The lender uses a comparative income analysis document to compare the performance of a self-employed borrower's business over a period of years to determine its viability. Fannie Mae Form 1088 July 96.
A non-interest paying bank deposit maintained by the borrower that induces the bank to make credit available to the borrower on more favorable terms than would otherwise be available.
A positive characteristic of a mortgage applicant which may offset a negative factor.
The actual dollar amount of compensation paid.
The estimated dollar amount of compensation to be paid.
Identifies the party responsible for paying the compensation amount due.

terms.term: Compensation Paid By Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe the party that has paid the compensation when Other is selected as the Compensation Paid By Type.
Identifies the party to which payment of the compensation amount will be made.

terms.term: Compensation Paid To Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe the party to which compensation has been paid when Other is selected as the Compensation Paid To Type.
The percent rate of the loan amount used to calculate the dollar amount of the compensation to be paid.
A unique identifier assigned to a compensation plan by the party offering the plan. The party assigning the identifier can be specified using the IdentifierOwnerURI attribute.
The maximum amount of compensation that may be paid as defined by the compensation plan.
The minimum amount of compensation that may be paid as defined by the compensation plan.

The specified fixed dollar portion of the total amount of compensation. This is used when the Compensation Amount is made up of a percentage (stated in the Compensation Percent) plus a specified fixed dollar amount.
Identifies the type(s) of compensation being paid in the loan transaction.
When Other is specified as the Compensation Type, this element contains the description.
A free-form text field used to describe and reconcile the competitive listings used.
Process of completing the Loan Application information regarding the property, the Borrower(s), and the requested loan.
Process of validating the information contained on the loan application and other Borrower and property details required to decision the application.
A bond furnished by a contractor to guarantee completion of construction.
When true, indicates the defect item was not included within the original report.

Establishes that the borrower will accommodate changes to loan documentation that result from errors and omissions, to ensure that the documents conform to industry standards. AKA: Errors and Omissions, E & O.

A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the general class of a fee. This value can be used to determine treatment of fees for compliance purposes when such treatment cannot otherwise be determined.

terms.term: Compliance Fee Classification Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for ComplianceFeeClassificationType.
A report given a lender by a designated compliance inspector indicating whether construction or repairs conform to conditions established by prior inspection.
The dollar amount (either positive or negative) adjustment being made for a specific component of the property.
Specifies whether the component is considered real or personal property.

A method of depreciation involving the separation of the cost of various elements of a building (such as roofing, plumbing and mechanical components) to take advantage of the shorter useful lives of such elements, and thereby increase the depreciation deductions in the early years of a project.
A method to achieve maximum financing by splitting a real estate parcel into separate fee and leasehold interests, and financing each component separately. Also called "split financing."
The estimated time period associated with the updating or remodeling of the property described by the Component Status Type.

terms.term: Component Status Timeframe Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Component Status Timeframe Type.
An opinion on the level of update or improvement completed on the structure subsequent to its original construction.
A free form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Component Status Type.
Interest computed on both the original principal and accrued interest.
Options on options. The buyer is required to pay a fee for the right to buy an additional option at a later date, at a given strike price.

terms.term: Comprehensive Environmental Response Compensation and Liability Act
terms.definition: See SUPERFUND.

terms.term: Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation and Liability Act (CERCLA)
terms.definition: Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation and Liability Act. See SUPERFUND.

A policy which covers a variety of general liability exposures, including premises, property and operations, products liability, owner's and contractor's protective, contractual liability, elevator liability and employer's liability.
See COMPARABLES.

The measurement that specifies the total area of the unit computed by total structure area divided by the number of living units.The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Area Unit Of Measure Type.

A field of artificial intelligence that uses machine learning and neural networks to teach computers and systems to derive meaningful information from digital images, videos, and other visual inputs. Computer Vision enables computers to "see," observe, and interpret much like human vision.
HUD's automated system that tracks the application for mortgage insurance from the initial appraiser request through to loan closing and MIC issuance.

An electronic system that furnishes subscribers with the latest data on available loan programs at a variety of lending institutions. Some CLOs offer mortgage information services and can prequalify buyers, process loan applications, underwrite loans and even make a commitment of funds.
A discount or other inducement given by a landlord or seller to a prospective tenant or buyer to induce them to sign a lease or purchase property.
Indicates that a new first mortgage will be closed concurrently with a second or a HELOC loan.
Indicates that a concurrent loan is from the same lender. This is in conjunction with Concurrent Origination Indicator.
Indicates that servicing is transferred concurrent with loan delivery.
The taking of private property for public use under the right of eminent domain with just compensation paid the owner and others with an interest in the condemned property.

Documentation or information that must exist (""be satisfied"") at or before a point in the origination process, such as Prior to Closing, Prior to Funding, etc. Common conditions include proof of mortgage insurance (when applicable), proof of homeowners insurance, and requests for additional documentation.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that classifies a condition to a part of closing preparation or underwriting.
The closing instruction text description.
When true, indicates that the condition has been satisfied.
A free-form text field used to describe in detail the condition rating of the identified component.
A rating of the condition of the identified component.
The name of the person who signs off that the condition has been met.
The date the condition was met/satisfied.
The date the condition must be satisfied before the loan can proceed.
The party responsible for obtaining the necessary information to satisfy the condition.

terms.term: Condition Satisfaction Responsible Party Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Condition Satisfaction Responsible Party Type.
The point in the Loan Process where this condition must be satisfied before proceeding to the next stage.

terms.term: Condition Satisfaction Timeframe Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Condition Satisfaction Timeframe Type.
When true, indicates that the condition has been waived.

An agreement to lend money to a borrower that has yet to be identified, but is still subject to the approval of the lender. During HUD/FHA mortgage insurance processing, it indicates the satisfactory completion of technical processing involving the estimated cost of the project, the "as-is" value of the site, a detailed estimate of operating expenses and taxes, supportable costs, the financial and credit capacity of sponsors, financial requirements and mortgage amounts.

A form reproduced locally by HUD/FHA offices and varying in content depending on local conditions. It lists the most common conditions imposed on conditional commitments, giving each a number. Only the number of the condition is entered on the commitment itself, and the list is attached. Also see VC sheet.
A monthly prediction of the number of current outstanding mortgages in a pool that will prepay.
A provision of a balloon mortgage which, at the time of the scheduled balloon payment, allows the borrower to convert to a fixed rate for a fixed period which will fully amortize the mortgage.
A contract for the sale of a property in which transfer of title to the buyer is contingent on fulfillment of certain conditions.
Limitations on the use of land and resulting penalties for failure to comply. Commonly used by land subdividers on newly plotted areas.
When true, indicates that the loan may be assumable, subject to certain conditions.
A form of property ownership whereby the purchaser receives title to a unit in a multiunit structure and a proportionate interest in common areas.
A fee paid by the homeowner to the association which governs a condominium complex for his/her part of the maintenance and management of the project.
The process of changing rental units into a condominium form of ownership.

The basic condominium documents that must be registered by the originating property owner prior to the conveyance of the first unit sold. The declaration thoroughly describes the entire condominium entity, including each unit and all common areas, and specifies essential elements of ownership that permanently govern its operation. Also known as a "master deed."
Confirms the percentage of a Condominium (Condo) Association or phase is currently occupied.
Specifies the current state of the condominium project.
The full text description of the Condo or PUD declarations.
An entity which issues mortgage-backed securities backed by mortgages which were originated by other lenders.

Data and information assets must be confined to authorized access and not be disclosed to others who do not have a need to know. Exact criteria for criticality is to be determined by each organization
Process of reviewing the loan approval's expiration dates and the expiration of documents associated with the underwriting approval.
Court approval of the sale of property by an administrator, executor, guardian, conservator or commissioner in a foreclosure sale.
When true, indicates that the loan amount is a conforming loan amount by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac standards.
A mortgage loan which meets all requirements (size, type and age) to be eligible for purchase or securitization by federal agencies.

A two-digit numeric code to identify each Congressional District within a State. These codes are unique within each State. A congressional district identifies an electoral constituency that elects a single member of a congress.

terms.term: Consent To Receive Documents Electronically Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates the consent to receive documents electronically.

terms.term: Consent To Sign Using Electronic Signature Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates consent to the use of electronic signatures.
Authorizes a person to sign documents for a borrower.
The process in which the consumer considers the hazard risk of a property.
Something of value offered and accepted in exchange for a promise, without which a contract is unenforceable.
Amount of the consideration.
When true, indicates that the client requested the appraiser to consider the additional property.
Description of the consideration or money amount of the document (not necessarily the mortgage amount).
A description of a CONSIDERATION type not included in the enumerated list.

Percentage of the original loan paid in equal annual payments that provides principal reduction and interest payments over the life of the loan. For example, a $1 million loan with a 10.8% constant requires a $108,000 annual payment.

Periodic payment of a fixed amount that includes interest and principal. As the loan amount reduces, the portion of the payment applied to the principal increases. Standard home mortgages are constant payment loans.

An agreement between a general contractor and an owner/developer stating the specific duties the general contractor will perform according to blueprints and specifications at a stipulated price and terms of payment.
Describes in detail the construction costs to build a new structure.
All costs incurred in the completion of a construction project, including land, labor, overhead and builder's profit.
The total cost amount of additions to raw land that normally increase its value (i.e., the building) as part of a construction loan.
The amount of the estimated value of the improvements to be made as a part of a construction loan.
A short-term, interim loan for financing the cost of construction. The lender advances funds to the builder at periodic intervals as work progresses.
A written agreement between a lender and a builder and/or borrower which details the specific terms and conditions of a construction loan, including the schedule of payments.
A partial disbursement of the construction loan based on the schedule of payments in the loan agreement. Also called "takedown."

terms.term: Construction Loan Estimated Interest Calculation Basis Type
terms.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the amount the loan commitment is based on when referring to either the Amount Advanced or Entire Commitment.

terms.term: Construction Loan Estimated Interest Calculation Method Type
terms.definition: The basis for calculating the amount of estimated interest on the construction loan.

terms.term: Construction Loan Estimated Interest Calculation Method Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected as the Construction Loan Estimated Interest Calculation Method Type.
When true, indicates that the loan is a construction loan.
The reserve amount required by the lender to pay interest on advance amount used for construction.

terms.term: Construction Loan Total Term Months Count
terms.definition: The total term of a construction loan, including the construction phase plus the fully amortizing phase.
Specifies the specific type of construction loan.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the manner in which the structure was constructed.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Construction Method Type.

terms.term: Construction Period Included In Loan Term Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates the construction phase of a single-transaction construction-to-permanent loan is part of the overall loan maturity term.
The interest rate to be used for calculations during construction period.

terms.term: Construction Period Number Of Months Count
terms.definition: The length of the construction period expressed in number of months.

terms.term: Construction Phase Interest Payment Frequency Type
terms.definition: How frequently interest payments are due during the construction phase.

terms.term: Construction Phase Interest Payment Frequency Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe the construction phase interest payment frequency if Other is selected as the Construction Phase Interest Payment Frequency Type.

terms.term: Construction Phase Interest Payment Method Type
terms.definition: How are the construction phase interest payments paid.

terms.term: Construction Phase Interest Payment Method Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe the construction phase interest payment method if Other is selected as the Construction Phase Interest Payment Method Type.
Represents whether interest is payable periodically or at the end of construction.

terms.term: Construction Phase Interest Payment Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe the construction phase interest payment if Other is selected as the Construction Phase Interest Payment Type.

terms.term: Construction Phase Interest Period Days Count
terms.definition: The number of days over which interest accrues prior to the first payment period on a construction loan.
When true, indicates the construction phase of a construction-to-permanent loan was financed by a different creditor from the permanent phase.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents stage of construction at the time of the inspection.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Construction Status Type.

terms.term: Construction To Permanent Closing Feature Type
terms.definition: Specifies the type of feature associated with closing for the Construction To Permanent loan.

terms.term: Construction To Permanent Closing Feature Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Construction To Permanent Closing Feature Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the type of closing process for the construction-to-permanent loan.

terms.term: Construction To Permanent Closing Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Construction To Permanent Closing Type.

terms.term: Construction To Permanent First Payment Due Date
terms.definition: The due date of the first payment of the permanent mortgage phase of a construction to permanent loan.
The date when the value of the property is reconfirmed or re-established upon completion of the construction as part of the conversion to permanent financing.

terms.term: Construction To Permanent Recertification Value Amount
terms.definition: The reconfirmed or re-established property value upon completion of the construction as part of the conversion to permanent financing.
Notice attempted indirectly by newspaper or public record, or similar device, whether received or not, which satisfies the legal requirements for notification.

A person defined as a consumer under the federal E-SIGN Act. In the mortgage industry this party has historically been known as the borrower; however, E- SIGN legislation referring to the term "consumer" actually references "an individual who obtains, through a transaction, products or services which are used primarily for personal, family, or household purposes," which could include borrowers and sellers for the purpose of consent and disclosure.
An organization that collects information about a consumer's credit history. Information is collected from national repositories and public records.
Consumer Finance Protection Bureau (CFPB)
Describes Adjustable Rate Mortgages and reviews their benefits and risks. AKA: CHARM.
The processes that could occur prior to the consumer starting the mortgage application process.
To bring to completion.
A unique identifier for the contact party as defined by trading partners.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the day of the week associated with the time restrictions or permissions.

terms.term: Contact Point Day Preference Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of "Other" is used for Contact Point Day Preference Type.
The email address for the contact.
The extension associated with the specified fax number.
The fax number for the contact.

terms.term: Contact Point No Contact Ending Date
terms.definition: The date that a no contact period of days ends, inclusive of the ending date.

terms.term: Contact Point No Contact Starting Date
terms.definition: The date that a no contact period of days begins, inclusive of the starting date.
The contact information that is not email, phone or fax.
The description of the type on contact information being provided when Contact Point Other Value is populated.
The ending time of day for the contact point time restriction or permission. Used with Contact Point Time Zone Type.
When true, indicates that the particular party's Contact Point (i.e. phone number, email address or other) is preferred over any others.
The starting time of day for the contact point time restriction or permission. Used with Contact Point Time Zone Type.

terms.term: Contact Point Request No Contact Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that the party has requested not to be contacted by any method other than by mail during the period specified.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the location associated with the Contact Point Type (for example, Phone).

terms.term: Contact Point Role Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe the Contact Point Role Type if Other is selected as the Contact Point Role Type.
The extension associated with the specified telephone number.

terms.term: Contact Point Telephone Toll Free Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates the Contact Point Telephone Value or Contact Point Fax Value is a telephone number with a distinct three-digit area code that can be dialed with no charge to the person placing the call.
The telephone number for the contact.

terms.term: Contact Point Time Preference Notice Datetime
terms.definition: The date/time that restrictions or permissions regarding contact point efforts was received.

terms.term: Contact Point Time Preference Source Type
terms.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the source of information regarding contact point time restrictions or permissions.

terms.term: Contact Point Time Preference Source Type Additional Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to provide a supplemental comment or remark regarding the Contact Point Time Preference Source Type.

terms.term: Contact Point Time Preference Source Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when "Other" is selected for Contact Point Time Preference Source Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the time zone of a reference location.

terms.term: Contact Point Time Zone Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when "Other" is selected for Contact Point Time Zone Type.
Adjoining.
A clause in a contract that requires the completion of a certain act or the occurrence of a certain event.
A reserve account in which funds are held until certain specified conditions are satisfied.
An equity-sharing provision appended to a loan in which the lender receives a percentage of annual gross or net project income exceeding a certain base amount, in addition to fixed interest.
An agreement between two or more parties which creates an obligation to do or not to do a particular thing.
When true, indicates that the contract amount is unknown.
When true, indicates that the contract date is unknown.
A contract between a purchaser and seller of real property to convey title after certain conditions have been met and payments have been made.
Actual rent as specified in a rental or lease agreement, as opposed to actual market or economic rent.
A unique alphanumeric string identifying a request for contract underwrite or contract underwrite with MI as assigned by the company or entity to whom the contract underwrite request was sent.
Indicates that the loan was underwritten by a contract underwriting organization.
A code assigned by the contracting system identifying a variance from the master contract.
Identifying the party who issued the variance code.

terms.term: Contract Variance Code Issuer Type Other Description
terms.definition: The description of the Contract Variance Code Issuer Type when Other is selected as the option from the enumerated list.
A person or company who agrees to do work and/or furnish materials for a contracted price. Subcontractors are often hired by the contractor to perform specialized or technical labor.
When true, indicates the loan was underwritten following the guidelines contained in a separate contractual agreement between the lender and the GSE Agency.
A cash or other concession by the seller of a property in order to induce a purchaser to buy that property.
A written or oral submission from a MISMO Member or Non-Member to a WG to assist with DWG in drafting a MISMO Standard or MISMO Collateral.
The type of party that is providing the contribution associated with a workout.
A free-form text field used to capture additional information when Other is selected for Contribution Source Type.

terms.term: Contribution To Reduce Capitalized Advances Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount reported by the servicer that is used to offset some or all of the advances for capitalization contributed by the borrower, MI or hazard insurance.

terms.term: Contribution To Reduce Capitalized Delinquent Interest Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount reported by the servicer that is used to offset some or all of the delinquent interest for capitalization contributed by the borrower, MI or hazard insurance.
The type of contribution associated with a workout.
A free-form text field used to capture additional information when Other is selected for Contribution Type.

A Participant has control of a Transferable Record if a system employed for evidencing the transfer of interests in the Transferable Record reliably establishes that Participant as the Participant to which the Transferable Record was issued or transferred pursuant to Section 16 of UETA and Section 201 of E-SIGN. This term is also defined in the MERS eRegistry Procedures Manual available at members.mersinc.org

Occurs when one organization has the power to influence the direction of the management, policies, or activities of the other. One organization "controls" another in spite of the fact that the controlling organization may own, directly or indirectly, through intermediary companies or not, less than fifty percent of the other organization.

Business relationship in which a provider of settlement services receives a referral from an affiliated company in another settlement service business. Real estate brokerage and mortgage lenders that are commonly owned, controlled or franchised and refer settlement service business to each other are typical examples of such CBAs.

The Party (entity) named on the System of Record that has Control of the eNote. For example, the Controller can be thought of as the "holder," "holder in due course," and/or "purchaser" of an original paper note as defined under the Uniform Commercial Code. This term is also defined in the MERS eRegistry Procedures Manual available at members.mersinc.org.

The Controller Delegatee for Transfer Model is used to allow one party to submit registration and transfers on behalf of another party on the MERS eRegistry. This term is also defined in the MERS eRegistry Procedures Manual available at members.mersinc.org.
Mortgage financing which is not insured or guaranteed by a government agency.
Movement of the price of a futures contract toward the price of the underlying cash commodity. As the contract nears expiration, the futures price and the cash price converge.

terms.term: Conversion Date Maximum Extension Months Count
terms.definition: The maximum number of months by which a loan can extend its conversion date.
A feature of a mortgage which allows the conversion to another interest rate, mortgage term or type of mortgage instrument.
The maximum number of times a borrower can exercise conversion options.

terms.term: Conversion Of Contract For Deed Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that the subject transaction proceeds are used to pay off the remaining balance of the land contract (also known as a contract for deed).
The duration (in months) of the conversion option.
The number of percentage points to be added to the index when calculating a new interest rate for the option to convert an ARM loan to a fixed rate loan.
The highest rate, expressed as a percent, to which the interest rate can increase when calculating a new interest rate for the option to convert an ARM loan to a fixed rate loan.
The lowest rate, expressed as a percent, to which the interest rate can decrease when calculating a new interest rate for the option to convert an ARM loan to a fixed rate loan.

terms.term: Conversion Option Note Term Greater Than Fifteen Years Additional Percent
terms.definition: The number of percentage points added to the net yield to obtain the new fixed interest rate when the original term of the Note is greater than 15 years.

terms.term: Conversion Option Note Term Less Than Fifteen Years Additional Percent
terms.definition: The percent added to the net yield to obtain the new fixed interest rate when the original term of the Note is less than 15 years.
A document that notifies the borrower of upcoming conversion options and scheduled interest rate changes..

terms.term: Conversion Option Period Adjustment Effective Date
terms.definition: The payment due date when the convertible factors become applicable, also known as the conversion period start date.

terms.term: Conversion Option Period Demand Notification Frequency Count
terms.definition: The number of payments between demand conversion option notifications to be mailed as a courtesy to the mortgagor.
The payment due date when the convertible factors expire.
The dollar amount that the mortgagor must pay to exercise the conversion option.

terms.term: Conversion Option Period Fee Balance Calculation Type
terms.definition: Indicates whether the conversion fee is calculated as a percentage of the original principal balance or the principal balance at the time of conversion.
The percentage of the loans principal balance (either original or at conversion) that the mortgagor must pay to exercise the option to convert.

terms.term: Conversion Option Period Reply Days Count
terms.definition: The number of days after the notice is generated that the mortgagor must reply to exercise the option to convert.

The percentage to which the interest rate is rounded when calculating a new interest rate for the option to convert an ARM loan to a fixed rate loan. This field is used in conjunction with Conversion Option Period Rounding Type which indicates how rounding should occur.

Indicates how the Conversion Option Margin Rate Percent is rounded when calculating a new interest rate for the option to convert an ARM loan to a fixed-rate loan. The interest rate can be rounded Up, Down or to the Nearest Rounding Factor. This field is used in conjunction with Conversion Option Period Rounding Percent which indicates the percentage to which the rounding occurs.
Indicates the type of conversion option associated with the loan.
Describes how interest rate changes are to be calculated when calculating a new interest rate for the option to convert an ARM loan to a fixed rate loan.
Describes when the loan is eligible to convert.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Conversion Schedule Type.
Specifies the type of conversion permissible for a loan as stated on the mortgage documents.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Conversion Type.
When true, indicates that an area within the structure or the entire structure has been improved from its original use to livable standards.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the converted area's quality of finish compared to the rest of the living area.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that identifies the original purpose of an area, which has been improved from its original use to livable standards.

terms.term: Converted Area Original Use Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Converted Area Original Use Type.
Indicates that the loan has a convertible characteristic.

A type of adjustable rate mortgage that may be converted to a fixed rate mortgage at specified intervals during a predetermined time period. In income property lending, a mortgage in which lender-provided funds convert to equity ownership after a predetermined period of time.
A Fannie Mae mortgage purchase that may be converted to the same yield offered in the most recent Free Market Auction.
Indicates whether the mortgagor has exercised the option to convert the ARM loan to a fixed rate loan.
The act of transferring title to real property from one party to another.
The document, such as a deed, lease or mortgage, used to effect a transfer.
Transfers title to a property from a seller (grantor) to a recipient (grantee); provides evidence of the legal right of ownership.
Contains data about the property sale and conveyance tax calculations. Accompanies a Conveyance Deed at the time of recording. AKA: Deed Tax Form; Conveyance Tax Return.
A free-form text field used to describe in detail the cooling system identified by the cooling system type.
When true, indicates that the structure has a permanent cooling system.
Indicates that the cooling system is the primary unit, not a secondary or additional system.
Specifies the type of cooling system.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Cooling System Type.
A period of time, provided by law or by contract, during which a party to a contract can legally back out of a contract.

Arrangement between a local public housing agency (PHA) and local government under which the government gives tax-exempt status to the PHA and its property, and agrees to provide such municipal services as police and fire protection, trash removal, etc. In exchange, the PHA agrees to make payments in lieu of taxes (PILOT), usually 10% of rents collected, excluding utilities and maintenance.

In real estate, a form of multiple ownership in which a corporation or business trust entity holds title to a property (usually an apartment complex) and grants occupancy rights to shareholder tenants through proprietary leases. Also called a "co-op."

The date of transfer of the lessor's or lessee's interest in a lease. Assignment of lease is the transfer of a lease by a lessee to a third party, with all its rights and obligations. The lessee transfers the entire unexpired remainder of the lease term to a third party. The assignor remains liable under the original lease contract unless expressly released by the landlord. Some leases may contain restrictions on assignments or subleases.
Establishes the rules for governing and operating the Cooperative (Coop) Housing Corporation.
Describes the planned revenues and expenditures of the Cooperative (Coop) for the current fiscal year.
Establishes the rights and duties of the Cooperative (Coop) and member shareholder under which the shareholder is allowed to use a certain unit in the premises.

The closing date of a lease agreement between the Co-op and the shareholder allowing use of a particular unit or apartment. A proprietary lease is a lease given by a corporation to another. It is often used in a co-op context, where the owner is given a certain number of shares in the co-op, along with a proprietary lease for one of the residences in the building. In this manner, a stockholder in the co-op has a certain number of shares in the co-op, along with a lease to use one of the apartments under the conditions specified.
The expiration date of the lease agreement that gives a shareholder the right to occupy a particular dwelling unit.
Establishes the responsibility of the Cooperative (Coop) to notify the lender in the event of borrower default.
Confirms an individual's ownership interest in the Cooperative. AKA: Membership certificate/Perpetual Use & Equity Contract/Certificate of Ownership/Ownership Contract, Coop Stock Certificate.
The stock certification number or identifier for the Co-op shares being purchased.
Authorizes the lender to assign the borrowers stock certificate in case of default. AKA: Coop Stock Power.
The number of cooperative shares the subject unit controls.

The process of removing a loan from the records of a investor - sometimes a loan is reclassified from a pool or security ahead of foreclosure and being fully removed from the Investor's books. Some portion of interim Investor accounting changes may have occurred earlier in the default management process based on the servicing agreement.
Community of Practice. A COP represents the business or technology interests of an industry segment and is made up of subject matter experts for that particular segment of the industry.

A five digit code representing a functional region based around an urban center of at least 10,000 people, based on standards published by the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) in 2000. The CBSA code refers collectively to metropolitan and micropolitan statistical areas.

terms.term: Core Based Statistical Area Division Code
terms.definition: Metropolitan Divisions are defined within Metropolitan Statistical Areas that have a single core with a population of at least 2.5 million. Not all Metropolitan Statistical Areas with urbanized areas of this size will contain Metropolitan Divisions. Metropolitan Division codes are distinguished by a five digit code ending in 4.

One of the components of risk-based capital guidelines which includes common stockholders equity, retained earnings, noncumulative preferred stock and minority interests in equity accounts of consolidated subsidiaries.

terms.term: Core Heating System Below Grade Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that a mechanical unit that produces the heat (e.g., furnace, boiler), for an identified heating system, is located below grade.
Indicates that the property lot or site is situated on a corner.
When true, indicates that the property unit is situated at the corner of the building.
Indicates that the lender is authorized to share loan information with corporate affiliates.
The affirmative and formal action by the board of directors of a corporation approving a transaction, activity or decision.
A business entity owned by a group of owners, called stockholders. A corporation is considered an artificial person under law.

The final step in the appraisal process where the appraiser considers three estimates of value derived from cost, income and market data approaches. The correlation process weighs the influence of each method in relation to the specific property type and final estimate of value.
A specialized type of mortgage banker whose function is limited to the origination of mortgage loans which are sold to other mortgage bankers or investment bankers under a specific commitment.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the method under which a loan was obtained from a correspondent lender by a security issuer.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Correspondent Acquisition Type.
Informs a cosigner of a loan that they will be obligated to pay the debt if there is a default by the main borrowers on the loan.
A free-form text field used to further describe the application of the Cost Approach valuation method to the subject property.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the manner in which the building would be reconstructed.
A free-form text field used to capture additional information when Other is selected for Cost Analysis Type.
When true, indicates the cost approach will be included in the appraisal report to support the assignment.
A valuation approach in which the value of a property is determined by computing the replacement value of improvements, depreciation and the value of the land.
An itemization of all construction costs and other building and material costs for verification. Generally required in HUD/FHA multifamily insurance programs.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the methodology used to arrive at a replacement or reproduction building cost.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Cost Method Type.

terms.term: Cost Of Analysis Component Status Type
terms.definition: A collection of values that specify the level of completeness of the specified Analysis Component Type for which a cost is being provided.
Index used to determine interest rate changes for adjustable rate mortgages. It is based on the cost of funds of the 11th District of the Federal Home Loan Bank.
The amount of money required or expended over and above budgeted cost, including such items as labor, interest, materials and land.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents how the cost to repair amount will be provided for the defects, damages or deficiencies that have been identified for the property.
The difference between the yield on an instrument and the cost of funds to finance it.
A construction contract in which the contract price is equal to the cost of construction plus a profit allowance to the builder, as opposed to a fixed price contract.

An agreement under which the contractor (in an owner-contractor agreement) or the architect (in an owner-architect agreement) is reimbursed for direct and indirect costs and, in addition, is paid a fee for services. The fee is usually a stated sum or percentage of costs.

terms.term: Council Of American Building Officials Certification
terms.definition: Confirms that the property was constructed to CABO (Council of American Building Officials) standards. Provided by builder. AKA: CABO Certification
The number of housing counseling and education activities per category.
Confirms that the borrower has completed counseling related to their mortgage and property obligations
Provides proof to lenders and other interested parties that clients have completed home retention counseling from a HUD-approved counseling agency. AKA: HUD-9912.
Provides proof to lenders and other interested parties that clients have completed homeownership counseling from a HUD-approved counseling agency. AKA: HUD-9911.
Informs the borrower of certain Veterans' Affairs items of interest regarding the loan and financing eligibility. AKA: VA 26-0592.
The date the housing counseling/education program was completed by the borrower.
When true, indicates that the applicant has completed counseling/education program.
The date the mortgage counseling or education program was delivered to the borrower.
When true, indicates that the household received information on fair housing, fair lending, and accessibility rights.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the format in which the counseling/education service is delivered.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for the Counseling Format Type.
The date the housing counseling/education program was initiated.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that categorizes the provider of the counseling services.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Counseling Provider Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the housing counseling service sought by the potential client/borrower.

terms.term: Counseling Service Enrollment Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used when Other is selected for Counseling Service Enrollment Type.
A value from a MISMO prescibed list that can be used to identify why a housing counseling service was changed to inactive.

terms.term: Counseling Service Inactive Reason Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free form text field used when Other is selected for Counseling Service Inactive Reason Type.
The date associated with the housing counseling service status.
A free-form description of the current status of the housing counseling case.
A free-form text field containing notes and comments about an interaction on a housing counseling case.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the setting in which the counseling/education is delivered.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for the Counseling Setting Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the counseling, education and outreach topics covered in a Counseling Event.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Counseling Topic Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that categorizes the counseling/education service being delivered.
The two-character representation of the country.
The name of the country.
The country of birth of the individual.
The name of the country of citizenship of the individual.
Code identifying the county within a state. (Designator Code based on FIPS Publication 6-4)
An unstructured name that identifies the county within a state. (Designator Name based on FIPS Publication 6-4).
The county of recordation name referenced in the subject recordable document.

Annual interest rate on a debt. The coupon rate on a mortgage is the contract rate stated in the mortgage note. The coupon rate on a mortgage security is the rate stated on the face of the security, not the rate of the mortgages in the pool backing the security.
The name of the court of law that has jurisdiction over a legal case.

A legally enforceable promise or restriction in a mortgage. For example, the borrower may covenant to keep the property in good repair and adequately insured against fire and other casualties. A breach of covenant in a mortgage usually creates a default as defined by the mortgage, and can be the basis for foreclosure.
Free-form description of the details regarding the covenant indicated.
A covenant potentially provides benefits or burdens to the ownership bundle of property rights usually associated with the community in which the property is located.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Covenant Type.
The percentage of mortgage pipeline that has investor commitments or is hedged.
Court-ordered reduction of a loan balance.
The process of sending billing statements, payment schedules or payment coupons.
Process in which the Lender creates the eNote and makes it available to the system used at closing
The process in which the Servicer creates the Reconveyance document. (May be referred to as Lien Release, Release of Lien, Lien Discharge, or Deed of Reconveyance)
Process of creating the RMBS Rating dataset to deliver to a third party for validation and subsequent delivery to Rating Agencies.
Process in which the Lender creates a security instrument.
The date and time at which the message, deal or document was created.
Credential Service Provider (often referred to as the AIA, or Accredited Issuing Authority).
Financial status — ability of borrowers to meet the terms of their obligations.
Contains the legal disclaimer text provided by the credit bureau.

The name of the credit bureau that merges data from the credit repositories and produces credit reports for end users. The credit bureau is NOT the same as the Credit Repository (Equifax, Experian, Trans Union) that houses the raw credit files.
Identifies the software technology provider for a credit bureau, if the provider is an outside vendor.

The credit repository bureaus can identify the type of business of the liability holder or the entity requesting a credit report as listed in a credit inquiry record. This information is needed for an automated scoring application. This data is available for liability and inquiry records from Equifax, Experian and Trans Union.
Authorizes a company to use a credit card belonging to a client for mortgage related charges. Generally these charges consist of credit report and appraisal fee.

This is a code value that may be associated with Credit Comment Text data. This could be a repository bureau code (Equifax, Experian, Trans Union), or it could be a code provided by a lender, credit bureau or other source that is specified in the Credit Comment Source Type. The code value should be exactly as shown in the source document without any other characters such as a prefix.
This data element provides an enumerated list of sources for the Credit Comment Code data.

terms.term: Credit Comment Code Source Type Other Description
terms.definition: When Credit Comment Source Type is set to Other, enter its value in this data element.
Date the comment expires.
Indicates the date that the credit bureaus added the comment to the file of the borrower.
This data element provides an enumerated list of sources for the Credit Comment data.

This data element holds comment text data that can appear in various locations on a credit report. The Credit Comment Source Type describes the source of the comment - borrower, credit bureau, lender, or repository bureau.
Allows the credit bureau to identify the type of credit comment (e.g. Consumer Statement).
When Credit Comment Type is set to Other, enter its value in this data element.
This indicator is set to Y when the credit liability is being managed by a credit counseling agency.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies a reason a request for credit was denied.

terms.term: Credit Denial Reason Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Credit Denial Reason Type.
The date that the selected credit enhancement becomes effective.
Specifies the period of time for which the selected credit enhancement option is in effect.
The date that the selected credit enhancement expires.
When true, indicates that the loan has a credit enhancement.
Indicates the party that bears the default loss associated with the credit enhancement type.

terms.term: Credit Enhancement Party Role Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Credit Enhancement Party Role Type.
Indicates whether the Credit Enhancement Type is period based.
Specifies the type of risk offset on the loan.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Credit Enhancement Type.

This is a code value associated with a Credit Error Message Text element. The Credit Error Message Source Type describes the provider of the code, which could be the credit bureau, lender or the repository bureau.

terms.term: Credit File Borrower Age Years Count

The Infile Date is the date that the credit data repository first established this credit data file on this borrower.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that classifies the visibility on a consumers credit report as a result of this Credit Inquiry.

terms.term: Credit File Inquiry Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Credit File Inquiry Type.
The identification number of the credit bureau that owns or manages the credit file being referenced.
The name of the credit bureau that owns or manages the credit file being referenced.

Describes the resulting status of the request for a credit file from a credit repository bureau. The full reason for a Credit File not being returned will be reported in the Credit Error Message data element.

terms.term: Credit File Result Status Type Other Description
terms.definition: When Credit File Result Status Type is set to Other, enter its value in this data element.

This element indicates that there was a variation from the original borrower demographics data in the request and the borrower data in the credit file. It MAY or MAY NOT belong to the borrower specified in the credit request.

The Personal Identification Number (PIN) that is supplied by the credit data repository bureau (Equifax, Experian, Trans Union) to allow a lender to access a credit file that was previously "frozen" or locked at the request of the borrower.
When true, the servicer does not report to credit bureaus based on the value provided in Credit Ineligible Description.
A free-form text field describing the reason that the borrower is ineligible for credit reporting.
The date of the credit inquiry.
The result from a credit inquiry - did the lender offer credit, refuse credit, etc.
Establishes the rates and charges incurred for credit insurance. AKA: Credit Insurance Terms, Credit Life Insurance Disclosure.
The number of times the liability account was reported 30 days late by the liability holder.
The number of times the liability account was reported 60 days late by the liability holder.
The number of times the liability account was reported 90 days late by the liability holder.
The number of times the liability account was reported 120 days late by the liability holder.
The date that the reported Credit Liability Unpaid Balance Amount was reached.
The date that the credit liability account was closed by the liability holder (by either the borrower or the liability holder).
The account number assigned to the liability account as provided by the credit repository bureau.
The date that the credit liability account was opened by the liability holder.

A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the ownership relation of the borrower(s) to the liability account (i.e. are they solely responsible, jointly responsible, a co-signer on the account, etc.).
The date that the credit liability was reported paid to zero by the liability holder.
The date that the credit liability data was reported by the liability holder.

The Status Date is the date that the accounts Current Rating was changed to that status by the liability holder. If the Current Rating status is Bankruptcy, for example, the Status Date would be when the account first went into bankruptcy.
This data element is an enumerated status list for an account as of the Account Status Date.
This describes the type of account established with the Liability Account Holder - credit line, installment, mortgage, open, revolving).
The actual dollar amount received on the borrower's liability account as recorded by the liability holder, for period specified on the Credit Liability Account Reported Date.
The amount that will be due on the account in the form a lump sum balloon payment.

terms.term: Credit Liability Balloon Payment Due Date
terms.definition: According to the contract / invoice, the date that full payment is due on an account.
The amount charged off by a liability holder, usually for an account in collection.
The date that the creditor put the account in a "charge off " status and declared the account balance as uncollectable.
A description of any collateral for the loan (for example, 97 Corvette).
This element indicates whether or not the consumer (borrower) disputes information reported for this account and has filed a FCRA (Fair Credit Reporting Act) dispute document.
The maximum amount of credit extended to the borrower as of the Credit Liability Account Reported Date.

The liability accounts current code (as of Date Reported) for how timely the borrower has been making payments on this account. This is also known as the Manner Of Payment (MOP). See the MISMO Implementation Guide: Credit Reporting for more information on MOP codes.
The liability accounts current rating (as of Date Reported) for how timely the borrower has been making payments on this account.
This element indicates whether or not the liability account contains adverse or derogatory information.

terms.term: Credit Liability First Reported Default Date
terms.definition: The date the loan was first reported to the credit bureau with a status code indicating bankruptcy or 30 day delinquency.
The highest amount of unpaid credit ever recorded on the liability as of the Credit Liability Account Reported Date.

terms.term: Credit Liability Highest Adverse Rating Amount
terms.definition: The highest delinquent amount on the account as reported by the liability holder.

terms.term: Credit Liability Highest Adverse Rating Code
terms.definition: The liability accounts highest (or worst) rating code for how timely the borrower has been making payments on this account. This is also known as the Manner Of Payment or MOP code. See the MISMO Implementation Guide: Credit Reporting for more information on MOP codes.

terms.term: Credit Liability Highest Adverse Rating Date
terms.definition: The date of the highest (worst) delinquency reported by the liability holder.

terms.term: Credit Liability Highest Adverse Rating Type
terms.definition: The liability accounts highest (or worst) rating type for how timely the borrower has been making payments on this account.
The date of last account activity, such as last charge or last payment, as of the Credit Liability Account Reported Date.
The date of the last payment on the liability reported by the liability holder.
This element indicates whether or not the data in the liability account has been manually updated by the credit bureau based on an investigation.

The dollar amount of the monthly payment required on borrower's liability account as reported on a credit report. The amount is either calculated by the credit bureau or provided by the credit liability holder.
The number of months from the Credit Liability Account Reported Date that are remaining to be paid on an installment loan account.
The number of months of account history reported by the liability holder. This is the period over which Late Counts are accumulated.

terms.term: Credit Liability Most Recent Adverse Rating Amount
terms.definition: The most recent amount that the borrower was reported delinquent by the liability holder.

terms.term: Credit Liability Most Recent Adverse Rating Code
terms.definition: The liability accounts most recent delinquency rating code for how timely the borrower has been making payments on this account. See the MISMO Implementation Guide: Credit Reporting for more information on MOP codes.

terms.term: Credit Liability Most Recent Adverse Rating Date
terms.definition: The date of the most recent delinquency reported by the liability holder.

terms.term: Credit Liability Most Recent Adverse Rating Type
terms.definition: The liability accounts most recent delinquency rating type for how timely the borrower has been making payments on this account.
When a liability account has been transferred or is being handled by a collection agency, this element indicates the name of original creditor.
The past due amount of credit owed by the borrower as of the Credit Liability Account Reported Date.

terms.term: Credit Liability Payment Pattern Data Text
terms.definition: This is a set of previous monthly payment ratings beginning with the Payment Pattern Start Date. C=Current, 1-6=# Months Late, 7=Wage Earner Plan, 8=Repossession, 9=Collection, N=No Activity, X=No Data.

terms.term: Credit Liability Payment Pattern Start Date
terms.definition: The date of the beginning of the data in the Credit Liability Payment Pattern Data.

terms.term: Credit Liability Prior Adverse Rating Code
terms.definition: This is the accounts Manner Of Payment (MOP) rating code for the associated Prior Adverse Rating Date. See the MISMO Implementation Guide: Credit Reporting for more information on MOP codes.

terms.term: Credit Liability Prior Adverse Rating Date
terms.definition: Lists the date (month and year) that the borrower was late on payments. The associated Prior Adverse Rating element gives the rating for that date.

terms.term: Credit Liability Prior Adverse Rating Type
terms.definition: This is the accounts manner Of payment rating type for the associated Prior Adverse Rating Date.

terms.term: Credit Liability Prior Information Start Date
terms.definition: The start date of the most recent populated Credit Liability Prior Information record.
A text description for the loan terms (for example, 360 months at $820 per month).
The total number of months established as terms for repayment of a loan.
This enumerated element indicates whether the monthly payment terms amount was provided by the repository bureau, or calculated by the credit bureau.
The unpaid amount of credit owed by the borrower as of the Credit Liability Account Reported Date.
Declining term life insurance taken out by a borrower as an added source of funds for the repayment of a loan.
The date that the loan is reported to credit bureaus as terminated.
This element contains an enumerated list of common loan types. If the loan type is Other, then the description is entered into the Credit Loan Type Other Description element.
If Credit Loan Type was set to Other, then this element will contain a description of the loan type.

terms.term: Credit Public Record Account Ownership Type

The name of the attorney (normally the plaintiff) reported in the public record.

terms.term: Credit Public Record Consumer Dispute Indicator
terms.definition: This element indicates whether or not the consumer (borrower) disputes information reported for this public record and has filed a FCRA (Fair Credit Reporting Act) dispute document.
The name of the court reporting the public record.
The name of the defendant in a public record.

terms.term: Credit Public Record Derogatory Data Indicator
terms.definition: This element indicates whether or not the public record contains adverse or derogatory information.
This element provides the date that the Public Record Disposition Type first became effective.

This is the enumerated disposition or the public record as of the Disposition Date. If the disposition does not fit one of the enumerated categories, select Other, and enter it in the Credit Public Record Disposition Type Other Description element.

terms.term: Credit Public Record Disposition Type Other Description
terms.definition: If the Credit Public Record Disposition Type is set to Other, enter the disposition in this element.
The Docket Identifier can be a Case Number, Docket Number, Public Record Book, Page or Sequence Number.
The date that the public record was filed by the court.

terms.term: Credit Public Record Legal Obligation Amount
terms.definition: This is the amount listed in the public record that the defendant is obligated to pay.

terms.term: Credit Public Record Manual Update Indicator
terms.definition: This element indicates whether or not the data in the public record has been manually updated by the credit bureau based on an investigation.
The date that the Legal Obligation Amount was paid to zero.

terms.term: Credit Public Record Payment Frequency Type
terms.definition: This element indicates the frequency of payments allowed for the Legal Obligation Amount.

terms.term: Credit Public Record Payment Frequency Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Credit Public Record Payment Frequency Type.
The name of the plaintiff in a public record.
The date that the public record data was last reported by the court to the credit repository bureau.
The date that the public record case was settled.

This is the enumerated type of public record reported by the credit bureau. If the type does not fit one of the enumerated categories, enter the type in the Credit Public Record Type Other Description element.

terms.term: Credit Public Record Type Other Description
terms.definition: If the Public Record Type is set to Other, enter the type in this element.
A rating given to a person or company that establishes creditworthiness based upon present financial condition, experience and past credit history.

Identifies which system of Manner Of Payment (MOP) rating codes is in the credit report. If Other is selected, then the name of the coding system will appear in the Credit Rating Code Type Other Description.

terms.term: Credit Rating Code Type Other Description
terms.definition: If the Credit Rating Code Type is set to Other, enter its description in this data attribute.
Specifies the type of credit history or type of payments used as credit history to establish acceptable credit reputation.
A free-form text field used to capture the Credit Reference Type if Other is selected.

1) A report run by an independent credit agency which verifies certain information concerning an applicant’s credit standing 2) Describes the borrowers credit history. Provided by a credit reporting bureau, or a service which consolidates reports from multiple sources into a single report (Tri-merge). AKA: Tri-Merge, Residential Mortgage Credit Report (RMCR).
Indicates that the borrower gave the lender consent to pull credit report.
Date and time the referenced credit report was first issued.
A reference number assigned by the credit bureau to a specific credit report. This report number is also referenced when a Reissue, Upgrade, or Status Query of an existing report is requested.
The date and time that the referenced credit report was last updated or revised.
This element indicates how duplicate data from multiple sources is handled on a credit report.
The price of the credit report produced on the borrower(s).
This describes the type of the Credit Report Price (Net, Tax, Total or Other). If Other is selected enter the description into the Credit Report Price Type Other Description element.

terms.term: Credit Report Price Type Other Description
terms.definition: When Other is specified in Price Type, this element contains its description.
This is additional information that more completely describes the credit report product being requested.
Select the type of service action being requested. If the service action refers to an existing report, specify which one in the Credit Report Identifier.

terms.term: Credit Report Request Action Type Other Description
terms.definition: This describes the desired request action when the Credit Report Request Action Type is set to Other.
Uniquely identifies a specific instance of a credit report transaction.

The type of credit report that was requested or produced. Most common types are Merged report (data from credit data repositories is merged), and RMCR (Residential Mortgage Credit Report - contains verified liabilities, employment, etc.).
When Credit Report Type is set to Other, enter its description in this element.
A letter sent to the borrower indicating that a change has been made and describing the nature of the change regarding how a loan is reported to the credit bureaus.

This element stores the number of repository bureaus desired for a credit request. When a requestor uses this element, they are selecting the number of repositories to be pulled, not specific bureaus. The credit bureau would then choose which bureaus to be pulled based on a methodology agreed on with their customer (for example, zip code or customer preference).
This element indicates whether Equifax is included in either the request or response.

terms.term: Credit Repository Included Equifax Trended Data Indicator

This element indicates whether Experian is included in either the request or response.

terms.term: Credit Repository Included Experian Trended Data Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates Experian trended data is included in the credit report.

terms.term: Credit Repository Included Other Repository Name
terms.definition: This element indicates whether another repository source is included in either the request or response.

terms.term: Credit Repository Included Trans Union Indicator
terms.definition: This element indicates whether Trans Union is included in either the request or response.

terms.term: Credit Repository Included TransUnion Trended Data Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates TransUnion trended data is included in the credit report.
If true, indicates the credit report was based on the input from a single credit repository. Also known as a single in-file credit report.

This element describes the source of the credit file, Equifax, Experian, Trans Union or Unspecified if the specific sources are not specified.

terms.term: Credit Repository Source Type Other Description

This is the subscriber code (sometimes called member code) of the liability holder or provider of data to the credit repository bureau.
A system generated date and time stamp enclosed within each request to identify the initiation time of the credit request.
The Credit Request Type specifies either an Individual Report on one person, or a Joint Report on two married persons.

terms.term: Credit Response Alert Message Adverse Indicator
terms.definition: This indicator is set to Y when the Credit Response Alert Message contains information which may be considered adverse and may require further investigation or other action.

terms.term: Credit Response Alert Message Category Type

terms.term: Credit Response Alert Message Category Type Other Description
terms.definition: When Credit Response Alert Message Category Type is set to Other, enter its value in this data element.
This is the code value associated with the Credit Response Alert Message Text and/or Credit Response Alert Message Type.

terms.term: Credit Response Alert Message Code Source Type
terms.definition: This element identifies the name of the source for the code values used in the Credit Response Alert Message Code. The enumeration definition identifies the source document and name of the table that contains the code values.

terms.term: Credit Response Alert Message Code Source Type Other Description
terms.definition: When the Credit Response Alert Message Code Source Type has a value of Other, this element identifies the name of the source for the code values used in the Credit Response Alert Message Code.
Text of the alert message.
Lists the name of the repository bureau or other product that generated the alert message.

terms.term: Credit Response Alert Message Type Other Description
terms.definition: When Credit Response Alert Message Type is set to Other, enter its value in this data element.

terms.term: Credit Score Category Type Other Description

terms.term: Credit Score Category Version Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Credit Score Category Version Type.

terms.term: Credit Score Considered In Decision Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates borrower's credit score was obtained from a consumer reporting agency and the score was used in making the credit decision.
Date that the referenced credit score was produced.
A value from a MISMO defined list that identifies the reason why a credit score could not be generated.

This indicator is set to True when the Credit Risk Score Value of the borrower or guarantor was negatively affected by the presence of credit inquiry records on their credit report. There may be FACT Act compliance requirements related to this alert message.

Factors of the borrower's or guarantor's credit which give context to the referenced credit score. The factor is normally a numeric code. The Credit Score Factor Text contains the text for the factor code.
The text remarks associated with a Credit Score Factor

terms.term: Credit Score Histogram Interval High Value
terms.definition: The highest possible value for the score model within the given credit score histogram interval.

terms.term: Credit Score Histogram Interval Low Value
terms.definition: The lowest possible value for the score model within the given credit score histogram interval.

terms.term: Credit Score Histogram Interval Score Range Occurrence Percent
terms.definition: The percent of consumers that have score values within this credit score histogram interval.
Identifies a characteristic of the Credit Score that impairs its effectiveness as an indicator of credit risk.

terms.term: Credit Score Impairment Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Credit Score Impairment Type.

This is the lower range of possible score values for this Credit Score Model Name Type. The range of credit score values is required to be part of the FACTA disclosure.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the score algorithm model name used to produce the referenced credit risk score.

terms.term: Credit Score Model Name Type Other Description
terms.definition: When the Credit Score Model Name Type is set to Other, this element holds the description.

terms.term: Credit Score Model Range of Scores Description
terms.definition: The range of scores possible under the credit score model.
Identifies the name of the company providing the credit score data. This is one of the requirements of the 2003 FACT Act.
Specifies the URL or web site address of the company providing the credit score data.
A detailed description of how the credit score compares to the scores of other consumers.
The percentile that the parties credit score is in comparison to all consumers.
Numeric credit score resulting from credit evaluation model.

The Credit Summary Data Set Name-Value pair data provides a standard method of providing a set of summary data. The Data Set Name identifies the type of summary data. The Data Set Value contains the actual data described by the Data Set Name.
This element holds the actual data value described by the Credit Summary Data Set Name attribute.
This is the name used to label or describe an individual group of summary data elements. It is useful when there are multiple groups of summary data elements within a credit report.
Any type of additional summary data that is provided by the credit bureau.

terms.term: Creditor Servicing Of Loan Statement Type

terms.term: Creditor Servicing Of Loan Statement Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to capture additional information when Other is selected for Creditor Servicing Of Loan Statement Type.
Data element where erroneous or unavailable data would cause negative consequences to the organization. Exact criteria for criticality is to be determined by each organization.
A technique used in construction which employs diagramming the interconnected tasks and activities involved in a project.
A hedge of an asset or liability with an instrument of different characteristics.
A clause in some mortgage agreements that states a default by the borrower on one mortgage loan also triggers a default on the other loan stated in the clause.

The Residential Standards Governance Committee and the Commercial Standards Governance Committee work in concert with the MISMO Officers and the MISMO Manager and other MISMO committees and report to the MISMO Board of Directors.

An appraisal method using the cost approach. The front or width of the building is multiplied by the depth of the building and by the height, figured from the basement floor to the outer surfaces of the walls and roof. The total cubic measurement is then multiplied by a cost per factor to obtain the appraisal figure.
The dollar amount of the cumulative total advances made by a servicer for a specified Advance Type.
The total number of days a property is on the market unsold - inclusive of all listing status change dates, from the original listing date to time the listing is selected for the valuation report.
See DEFERRED MAINTENANCE.

The currency the value represents. Recommend using the form urn:org:iso:www:4217:xxx where xxx is a three letter code from http://www.iso.org/iso/support/faqs/faqs_widely_used_standards/widely_used_standards_other/currency_codes/currency_codes_list-1.htm
The dollar amount of interest accrued on the loan between the last paid installment date and the date reported.
The total dollar amount advanced by the servicer for a specified Advance Type for the current reporting period.
The portion of the payment allocated to repayment of deferred expenses due to the investor.
The total dollar amount applied to repay funds advanced by the servicer for a specified Advance Type for the current reporting period.
The ratio of current assets to current liabilities.
Assets that can be turned into cash within a year, such as accounts receivable or marketable securities.

terms.term: Current Buydown Subsidy Amount Total Amount

Specifies the investor holding the first mortgage that is being refinanced.

terms.term: Current First Mortgage Holder Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Current First Mortgage Holder Type.
The total dollar amount of the line of credit as of the date reported.
The monthly total amount for the specified Income Item.

The current interest rate, expressed as a percent, for this loan.
Current list price (e.g. of the property).
The amount of money a firm would gain or lose if it were to meet loan guarantees and mandatory commitments at current market prices.
The dollar amount of negative amortization for the current activity period.
The current balance of interest accumulated according to the note terms permitting negative amortization for a loan or loan component.

terms.term: Current Principal And Interest Payment Amount Total Amount
terms.definition: Provides an arithmetic total of the Current Principal And Interest Payment Amount data items within the Loan container in this data set from the PAYMENT_BREAKOUT container where Payment State Type equals Current.
Date on which the interest rate for the loan was set by the lender for the final time before closing.
The ratio of current assets to current liabilities.

terms.term: Current Total Optional Products Payment Amount Total Amount
