The percentage by which the HUD Median Income can be exceeded in certain high cost areas.
The total dollar amount for HUD based on the median income and adjustment factors.
The HUD estimated median family incomes to determine borrower eligibility for all applications related to affordable lending products.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that is used to identify how the Housing Counseling Applicant learned about the Housing Counseling Agency.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for HUD Referral Type.
When true, indicates that the borrower's stable effective income meets HUD approval.
Standard form used to disclose costs at closing. All charges imposed in the transaction, including mortgage broker fees, must be disclosed separately.

terms.term: HUD1 Cash To Or From Borrower Indicator
terms.definition: When True, indicates that cash is due to the Borrower. When False, indicates that cash is due from the borrower. This field is for use as required on the HUD-1.

terms.term: HUD1 Cash To Or From Seller Indicator
terms.definition: When True, indicates that cash is due to the Seller. When False, indicates that cash is due from the Seller. This field is for use as required on the HUD-1.
When True, this field is used to indicate, as required on the HUD-1, that the loan transaction is a conventional loan with Mortgage Insurance required.
The File Number listed on the HUD-1 Section B, item number 6.

terms.term: HUD1 Line Item Additional Text Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to provide a supplemental comment or remark to an individual HUD1 Line Item. This text is in addition to the HUD1 Line Item Description.
The dollar amount for the specified HUD-1 line item.
The description of the specified HUD-1 line item.

Items that require adjustments for a time period require the listing of the period in which they were paid. This is the start date of the payment adjustment as reflected on the description line on the HUD-1.

terms.term: HUD1 Line Item Paid By Type
terms.definition: The party responsible for payment of the specified HUD-1 line item.

Items that require adjustments for a time period require the listing of the period in which they were paid. This is the end date of the payment adjustment as reflected on the description line on the HUD-1.

A placeholder for the date specified as the Settlement Date on the HUD-1. This field contains the one date of multiple dates associated with the loan transaction (e.g., Disbursement Date, Closing Date, Recording Date) that is identified as the Settlement Date as required on the HUD-1.
The specified Line Item Number on the HUD-1.

The need for human interaction, intervention, and judgment to control or change the outcome of a process. HITL is a practice that is being increasingly emphasized with the use of artificial intelligence.
An investment that is a mix of debt and equity.

An electronic mortgage and a paper based mortgage together, where parts of the transaction were conducted electronically (i.e. the borrower closing, generation of the promissory note and security instrument), but some part of it (other than the promissory note) is converted to paper (i.e. printing the security instrument for filing with the county recording office)

terms.term: Hybrid Process or Hybrid eClosing Process
terms.definition: A signing process for documents in the mortgage industry in which certain documents are printed and signed on paper while other documents are signed electronically.
The industry standard language defined by the W3C for representing a web page.
To pledge property as security for a debt without giving up possession of title.
Used to verify the identities of those using electronic signatures.
The date on which the value represented by the MISMOIdentifier is effective as determined by the issuer or owner as specified by the IdentifierOwnerURI.
Identifies the owner or publisher of the identifier associated with a MISMO term with the class word of "Identifier" by means or a URI. This is an XML attribute.

An electronic credential that uniquely identifies an individual, organization or device to some level of assurance. Identity is based on something you know (password), something you have (ATM card), or something you are (biometrics).
Confirms the correct borrower name to be used in executing the documents.
The expiration date of the document used for identity verification of the individual.

On a particular document or in a particular resource each individual is assigned a unique value. For example a driver's license number or passport number on documents. Another example is the SSN or Taxpayer Identifier within those external resource systems.

terms.term: Identity Document Issued By Country Name
terms.definition: Country which issued the identification.
Agency which issued the identification document.

terms.term: Identity Document Issued By State Code
terms.definition: The two-character representation of the US state, US Territory, Canadian Province, Military APO FPO, or Territory in which the identity document was issued.

terms.term: Identity Document Issued By State Province Name
terms.definition: State or province which issued the identification.
The type of entity that issued the document used for identity verification for this individual.

terms.term: Identity Document Issued By Type Other Description
terms.definition: Expiration date of the document used for identity verification of the individual.
For document the date when the document was issued to the individual. For an external resource the date the individual was added to the data store.
The kind of document that was examined to verify individual identity. A driver's license is an example of an identity document.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Identity Verification Source Type.
A financial or corporate relationship between a project sponsor and contractor that is necessary to receive a Builder's and Sponsor's Profit and Risk Allowance (BSPRA).
Informs the borrower about identify theft and how to protect their credit.

An identity proofing method that relies on something you know - the verification of information that is unique to the Principal, should be known by the Principal, and can be readily demonstrated by the Principal. Some common forms of this type of identity proofing include Knowledge- Based Authentication (KBA), passwords, or personal identification numbers. See also definition of Knowledge-Based Authentication

An identity proofing method that relies on the verification of something you are - the Principal's unique personal traits. Some common forms of this type of identity proofing include comparisons of fingerprints, iris, voice, or face to a reference scan.

An identity proofing method that relies on something you have - the verification of the Principal's possession of unique information or credentials. Some common forms of this type of identity proofing include Digital Certificates, physical or digital government-issued identification cards, one-time passwords, or a response to a message delivered to a mobile device.
If for some reason the sender of a message cannot provide an accurate time for a datetime data point they set this indicator true.

Information Management Work Group. IM ensures that consistent business definitions and business information are used across MISMO Products including but not limited to the Business Glossary, Business Reference Model including MISMO Life of Loan, Logical Data Model and related platform dependent models as applicable, and MISMO XML Reference Model and the supporting Collateral. IM is responsible for ensuring that MISMO Products follow all published MEGs and other established product development guidelines.
A digitized presentation of a document.
A free-form text field used to further describe or comment on the image.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that categorizes the image.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Image Category Type.
The date and time when the image was taken.
A unique alphanumeric string identifying the location of the image within a file structure.
Name of group represented by the images.
Uniquely sequence the images within the named group.
An identifier that may be used to uniquely identify an image.
Indicates the name or title of the image (e.g., Subject Photo).
A representation of the signer's signature that is electronically captured at the time of signing and placed in the signature line on a document. Also known as a Digitized Signature.
See SMART Doc View.
Conversion of a paper document such as a mortgage application into an electronic duplicate that can be stored electronically and viewed on a computer terminal.
An over-the- counter offer by a seller to a purchaser of a mortgage.
Up-front fees charged developers and homebuyers to pay for public improvements and services.

Implementation guidance for use of MISMO Standards to solve industry business and/or technical issues. Guidance may include narrative descriptions, sample use cases, sample code, mappings, and much, much more. Implementation Guides are used to accelerate adoption of the standards.
A document designed to assist individuals who are implementing the MISMO standards by providing helpful information and/or sample files. It typically includes guidance on the usage of the standard.
See ESCROW.
Land having utilities, roads or other improvements.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the predominant material used to surface the road, street and/or driveway.

terms.term: Improved Surface Material Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Improved Surface Material Type.
A free-form text field describing the condition of the component being referenced.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the condition status of the component being referenced.

terms.term: Improvement Component Condition Status Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Improvement Component Condition Status Type.
A free-form text field summarizing the condition of the component being referenced.
A free-form text field describing the quality of the component being referenced.
A free-form text field summarizing the quality of the component being referenced.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the improvement component that is being identified (e.g. Foundation, Floors).
A free-form text field describing the Improvement Component Type being referenced.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Improvement Component Type.

The estimated cost of the improvement calculated by adding all costs to replace or reproduce the improvement, deducting the applicable depreciation, and adding any applicable delivery, installation, and setup fee.

terms.term: Improvement In Boundary Of Easement Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that any part of an improvement is located within the boundary of an easement.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that classifies the structure on the property.
Additions to raw land that normally increase its value, such as buildings, streets, and sewers.
Interest included in the principal amount of contracted debt, if stated interest is less than the amount required by tax law.
Unverified credit report which may contain unchecked, duplicated or overlapping data. Used for "quick look" at a prospective borrower's credit history.
A notarial act in which documents are notarized in electronic form in the physical presence of the notary.

The market condition in which the strike price is lower than the market price; the option then has intrinsic value. For example, a call option is in-the-money if the strike price is below the current market price; a put option is in-the-money if the strike price is above the current market price.
An agreement between public officials and private developers in which developers are offered an incentive to build a desired public improvement.
When true, indicates that the requested documents should be included in the response.
When true, indicates that reports concerning the loan data should be included.
When true, indicates the creditor wants to include consumer signature lines on the integrated disclosure.
When true, indicates that fillable and signable fields should be included in the prepared document(s).
When true, indicates the dollar value of that item is included in the value of an asset account being reported by a borrower.
A free-form text field used to describe or comment on the use of the Income Approach in valuing a property.
The actual or estimated schedule of income and expense items reflecting net gain or loss during a specified period.
When true, indicates the income approach will be included in the appraisal report to support the assignment.
The appraisal technique used to estimate real property value by capitalizing net income.
When true, indicates that income was used in the risk assessment or approval decision for a loan application.
A value from a MISMO defined list that specifies the type of document used as a means of identifying or verifying the borrower's income used in the transaction.
A free-form text field used to capture the Income Document Type if Other is selected.
Identifies the extent or level of the income documentation being collected to process and underwrite the loan.
Indicates that the income is legally exempt from federal tax.

Income restrictions established for low- to moderate-income persons to qualify for admission into subsidized housing programs. The limits are established by law and are based on family size and geographic location.
A loan arrangement wherein the lender shares in property income as well as interest earned on the loan.
Real estate developed or improved to produce income.
A loan secured by commercial real estate.
When true, indicates the borrower cannot make mortgage payments due to income reduction or loss.
Specifies whether the total monthly income is either Pre-tax or Post-tax.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies borrower income items on a mortgage loan application.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Income Type.
An enumerated value or code identifying the extent to which the obligor's income was verified during the loan origination process.
The number of time periods as defined by the Income Verification Range Type for which documentation is collected.
Specifies the period or range of time for which the specific type of Income Document Type is collected.

terms.term: Income Verification Range Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Income Verification Range Type.
A qualifying ratio used in underwriting a residential mortgage loan which computes the percentage of monthly income required to meet the monthly housing expense.
Informs the borrower that the application as submitted is incomplete and establishes a time period in which information must be received. AKA: 10 Day Letter, Request For Additional Information.
A loss in the value of improvements that is not economically feasible to correct.
To protect against damage, loss or injury or to make compensation to for damage, loss or injury.
Security against or compensation for damage, loss or injury. Also a legal exemption from liability for damages.

A published interest rate, such as the prime rate, LIBOR, T-bill rate or the 11th District COFI. Lenders use indexes to establish interest rates charged on mortgages or to compare investment returns. On ARMs, a predetermined margin is added to the index to compute the interest rate adjustment.
A portion of 100 that represents the percentage value of the index required to determine the fully indexed rate as used in computation of the annual percentage rate for certain states.

Indicates that several interest rates are to be averaged to calculate the new interest rate for an ARM change. The average interest rate value, if rate averaging is indicated, is used when the interest rate calculation method indicates some use of a specified rate.
Indicates if and how multiple index values are to be averaged to arrive at the value to be used in the interest rate calculation.

The number of index values that should be averaged to arrive at the value to be used in the interest rate calculation. Used in conjunction with the Per Change Index Averaging Type which indicates how to arrive at the values to be counted and used for averaging.
Indicates the method used to determine the index rate used to calculate the new interest rate.
Specifies whether the index is the primary or secondary.

The number of months prior to an interest rate effective date used to determine the date for the index value when calculating a new interest rate on a loan. Combined with Per Change Index Lead Days Count, with number of Months utilized first to arrive at the total lead time. The first of two possible sets of index data if index averaging is used.
A lease based on the movement of a specified index, for example, the Consumer Price Index.

A value from a MISMO defined list that specifies the point in time prior to the effective date of the payment adjustment at which date the effective value of the published index is taken to compute the new payment.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Loan Index Lookback Type.

The percentage to which the index is rounded prior to use in the calculation of the new interest rate. This field is used in conjunction with the Index Rounding Type which indicates how rounding should occur.
Describes when rounding occurs relative to the minimum index movement rule.

Indicates how the index is rounded prior to use in the calculation of the new interest rate. The index can be rounded up, down or to the nearest factor. This field is used in conjunction with Index Rounding Factor which indicates the percentage to which the rounding occurs.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the type and source of index to be used to determine the interest rate at each adjustment.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information or a description of the index, used when Other is selected for the attribute Index Source Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the general category of mortgage index to be used to determine the interest rate at each adjustment.
A free-form text field to collect additional information when Other is selected for Index Type.
A measurement that specifies the total area. The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Area Unit Of Measure Type.
Describes the funds available through a program that matches funds of the borrower deposited for the sole purpose of purchasing a residence.
A professional or job classification held by a person in a business.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the type of indoor air quality mitigation in place on the property.

terms.term: Indoor Air Quality Mitigation Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Indoor Air Quality Mitigation Type.
A development designed for specific business types which provides required appurtenances including public utilities, streets, railroad sidings, auto parking and water and sewage facilities.
A form of financing whereby a municipality or development corporation issues bonds to finance revenue-producing projects. Project revenue is used to pay debt service on the bonds.
When true, indicates this Loan Product is ineligible based on Deal characteristics.
The ability of an artificial intelligence model to infer, or extrapolate, conclusions from data that is new to it.
An endorsement to an insurance policy that increases coverage to offset the effects of inflation.
Identifies the impact of the indicated Influence on the subject property as used in the appraiser's analysis.
When true, indicates that the site influence meets applicable policy requirements.

The practice of identifying the sensitivity of information considering the risk and impact of the information being accessed, disclosed, modified, used or destroyed without proper authorization and the potential harm resulting from such unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, use or destruction.
When true, indicates the user requested additional informational form series that are not specifically tax returns such as: W-2s, 1099s, 1098s, and 5498s. Used on the IRS Form 4506T and 4506C.
Basic public improvements such as roads, sewers, water, drainage and other utilities which are necessary to prepare raw land for buildings and future development.
To go in. It is used with the term egress (to go out) to describe the right of access to land.
Initial disclosure of potential rate or payment change per CFPB regulation.
The date on which a construction lender funds a construction loan.

terms.term: Initial Credit Report First Issued Date
terms.definition: The date on which the initial credit report for this loan was first issued.
When true, indicates the Loan Draw Amount is the initial draw.
Estimates the amount and activity in the escrow account based on anticipated future payments. AKA: Escrow Analysis Statement, Impound.

terms.term: Initial Escrow Deposit Includes All Insurance Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that the initial escrow account deposit amount includes amounts deposited for the purpose of paying future recurring charges for all types of insurances required on the subject property, as reflected on a single instance of the GFE. For example, the total amount needed to cover the individual payments of hazard insurance, and wind insurance, and earthquake insurance.

terms.term: Initial Escrow Deposit Includes All Property Taxes Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that the initial escrow account deposit amount includes amounts deposited for the purpose of paying future recurring charges for all types of property taxes required on the subject property, as reflected on a single instance of the GFE. For example, the total amount needed to cover the individual payments of county property taxes, and city property taxes, and school taxes.

terms.term: Initial Escrow Deposit Includes Other Description
terms.definition: Specifies the other escrow items for which payment will be covered by the initial escrow account deposit amount, as reflected on a single instance of the GFE.
Identifies the date that the initial escrow statement was given to the borrower.

terms.term: Initial Fixed Period Effective Months Count
terms.definition: The number of months in the initial fixed period of a loan with an adjustable rate or payment.
The dollar amount of the initial interest payment for interest only loans.
The list price amount of the property, when the listing was created.
Percent value used to calculate the discounted initial payment amount when it is not the fully-amortized amount.
The initial effective payment rate at which the borrower is making payments, even if it is temporary.
The total monthly amount of the loan payment to be made by the borrower as disclosed on the Initial Escrow Account Disclosure, including principal and interest and all monthly escrow payment amounts.

terms.term: Initial Principal And Interest And MI Monthly Payment Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount of the initial mortgage monthly payment including principal, interest, and mortgage insurance (MI).

terms.term: Initial Principal And Interest Payment Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount of the principal and interest payment as stated on the Note. The principal and interest payment is usually obtained using the loan amount and interest rate to arrive at full amortization during the loan term.

terms.term: Initial Tax And Insurance Payment Amount
terms.definition: Net taxes and insurance Payment (excluding Optional Insurance) to be collected on a monthly basis. This includes any Mortgage Insurance, all taxes and property casualty that are escrowed.
The amount of all interest scheduled to be paid on a Rule of 78s loan.
The process in which the lender initiaties credit file monitoring.

A term utilized by an owner of property, including a mortgagee who has taken title to property by judicial proceeding or by deed in lieu of foreclosure, in the context of avoiding liability for environmental contamination where the owner has taken certain precautions to ascertain the environmental condition of property prior to acquiring the property.
A condition in which a debtor is unable to pay his or her creditors.
A document verifying that a property is as described. The inspection is usually performed by a designated agent and may be accepted in place of a survey.
The date the inspection of the property was performed.
A free-form description of the inspection report format and content.
Defines the inspection service requested.

terms.term: Inspection Request Action Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe the request action type if Other is selected as the Inspection Request Action Type.
An identifier or number used by the inspecting professional to identify the report.
The periodic payment that a borrower agrees to pay a mortgage lender.
Borrowed money that is repaid in a number of successive payments, usually at regular intervals, for a specific amount and for a specified term.
A sale in which a seller receives payment in regular intervals, allowing the tax on the profit from the sale to be paid over time.
A financial institution that lends to the public. Examples are mutual savings banks, life insurance companies, commercial banks, pension and trust funds and savings and loan associations.
An unstructured name that identifies the individual who prepared the security instrument.
Sequential number assigned to each recorded document by the a County Recorder.
Indicates that the area specified by Insulation Area Type does have insulation.
A free-form text field used to describe the location of the insulation if Other is selected as the Insulation Area Type.
A free-form text field for commenting on the presence or absence of insulation.

A value from a predefined MISMO list representing the Index developed by the Residential Energy Services Network and is a nationally recognized system by which a home's insulation energy efficiency is measured.
A collection of values that specify the insulation material that is used in the specified Insulation Area Type.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for the Insulation Material Type.
Identifies the presence or absence of insulation in area as specified by the Insulation Area Type.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Insulation Presence Type.
Specifies the rating (e.g. "R19") of the insulation.
The interest of an owner, lessee, mortgagee or trustee which is insured against financial loss in the case of specified events.
The net value of property being insured, after land and other exclusions have been deducted.
The date an insurance claim for a loss was denied.
The date on which the insurance claim will be eligible for filing.
The actual date the insurance claim was filed.
The date an insurance claim for loss is paid.
When true, indicates that an insurance claim is pending.
Specifies the type of insurance against which the claim is being made.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected as the Insurance Claim Type.
When true, indicates that a partial insurance claim is being made, not a full claim.
The portion of the monthly mortgage that is allocated to the property insurance on the subject property.
When true, indicates that a specific Hazard Insurance Coverage Type on the property is required for the loan transaction.
A provision in a hazard insurance policy protecting the insured upon the occurrence of property loss or damage even if the insured property is vacant (for an extended period of time).

The term preferred over other terms such as "policyholder" or "policyowner," to describe the party protected under an insurance contract to whom the insurer reimburses losses, pays benefits or provides services.
A document issued by a title insurance company which protects a mortgagee against embezzlement or failure to follow specific closing instructions.
A loan insured by FmHA, FHA or a private mortgage insurance company.
Identifies the individual or corporation who will be named as the insured party on the policy.

Generally, property that has no intrinsic or marketable value in and of itself, but is merely the evidence of value, such as promissory notes, stock certificates or certificates of deposits (as distinguished from land, furniture and equipment).

CFPB mortgage disclosure required under the Truth in Lending Act and the Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act for most closed-end consumer credit transactions secured by real property. This enumerated value is provisionally supported and must not be used until the regulation is final.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Amount Changed Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates the estimated and final cash to close amounts for the specified Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Type are unequal.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Change Description
terms.definition: A statement providing information related to the difference between the estimated and final cash to close amounts for the specified Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Type.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Estimated Amount
terms.definition: The estimated cash to close amount for the specified integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Type.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Final Amount
terms.definition: The final cash to close amount for the specified Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Type.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Payment Type
terms.definition: Identifies whether the Cash To Close Item Amount is due to or from the borrower.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Type
terms.definition: Identifies the type of cash to close item as specified in the Calculating Cash to Close section of the integrated disclosure document.
Specifies the type of integrated disclosure document.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Document Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to capture additional information when Other is selected for Integrated Disclosure Document Type.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Estimated Closing Costs Expiration Datetime
terms.definition: The date and time that the estimate of the loan closing costs amount expires as reflected on the integrated disclosure document.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Home Equity Loan Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates the loan is an extension of credit that does not involve the purchase of real property or the initial construction of a dwelling and will not be used to refinance an existing obligation.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Initial Principal And Interest Payment Amount
terms.definition: The initial principal and interest payment amount as calculated and disclosed on a single instance of the integrated disclosure document.
The date the integrated disclosure was mailed or delivered to the consumer (borrower or seller) as reflected on a single instance of the integrated disclosure document. AKA "Date Issued".
The line identifier for the item as represented in a section of the Integrated Disclosure form.
A description of the loan product which includes, when applicable, certain loan features added to the loan product that may change the periodic loan payment.
The date the borrower received the integrated disclosure.
The total amount of itemized charges and credits within a specified section of the integrated disclosure document.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the title or description of a primary section of an integrated disclosure document.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Section Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to capture additional information when Other is selected for Integrated Disclosure Section Type.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Subsection Paid By Type
terms.definition: The role of the party making the payment of the amount associated with the Integrated Disclosure Subsection Total Amount.
The dollar amount of the individual payment being made associated with the Integrated Disclosure Subsection Type.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Subsection Payment Timing Type
terms.definition: Defines the point in time during the origination process when the integrated disclosure subsection payment was paid.
The total amount of itemized charges and credits within a specified subsection of the integrated disclosure document.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the title or description of a subsection of an integrated disclosure document.

terms.term: Integrated Disclosure Subsection Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to capture additional information when Other is selected for Integrated Disclosure Subsection Type.
Ability to assign responsibility, ownership or role in order to perform some activity.

Sets forth MISMOs policy regarding the disclosure and licensing of intellectual property rights in regard to the development and implementation of the MISMO Standards. The MISMO IPR Policies may be accessed via the footer of mismo.org.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the intended use of a credit report in alignment with the Fair Credit Reporting Act section 604(Permissible Purposes of a Consumer Credit Report).

terms.term: Intended Credit Request Purpose Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Intended Credit Request Purpose Type.
Borrower's answer to the question: Do you intend to occupy the property as your primary residence?

terms.term: Intent To Proceed With Loan Transaction Indicated Date
terms.definition: The date the borrower indicated his or her intent to proceed with the loan transaction.
Consideration in the form of money paid for the use of money, usually expressed as an annual percentage. Also, a right, share or title in property.
Describes the formula used to calculate interest accrued since the previous payment.

terms.term: Interest Adjustment Index Lead Days Count
terms.definition: The number of days prior to an interest rate effective date used to determine the date for the index value when calculating a new interest rate on a loan.

terms.term: Interest And Payment Adjustment Index Lead Days Count
terms.definition: The number of days prior to an interest rate effective date used to determine the date for the index value when calculating both a new interest rate and a principal and interest payment.
The portion of the UPB on which interest is being collected.

terms.term: Interest Calculation Basis Days In Period Type
terms.definition: The length of the payment period used to calculate interest.

terms.term: Interest Calculation Basis Days In Period Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for the Interest Calculation Basis Days In Period Type.

terms.term: Interest Calculation Basis Days in Year Count Type
terms.definition: The number of days in a year to be used for a loans interest calculation. Commonly used for Daily Simple Interest and other loans where interest due is calculated monthly.
Defines the loan balance upon which the interest is calculated.

terms.term: Interest Calculation Basis Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for the Interest Calculation Basis Type.
The date on which the interest calculation formula goes into effect.
The number of months that the interest determination method is in effect.
The last date on which the interest calculation formula is in effect.
Indicates that the interest calculation period is adjusted.
Describes the length of the interest accrual period.
Specifies the purpose of the interest calculation.

terms.term: Interest Calculation Purpose Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for the Interest Calculation Purpose Type.
Defines the method used to calculate the interest on the loan.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for the Interest Calculation Type.

A ratio used in the analysis of floating rate loans that indicates the maximum interest rate the income property's cash flow would carry. Calculated by dividing the net income before debt service by the loan amount.
Identifies whether interest was credited to the borrower at time of closing for a closed-end mortgage.

The amount of interest due with the first payment in addition to the regular payment as a result of the loan funding on a date other than one month prior to the due date (if interest is paid in arrears). This amount will be zero if odd interest was paid at closing.
The amount of interest being forgiven by the investor or lender at modification.
Indicates that interest is accrued in advance. A value of false indicates interest in arrears.
Identifies Interest on Escrow accrued not yet posted amount.

terms.term: Interest On Escrow Accrued Through Date
terms.definition: Identifies date thru which interest on escrow has accrued.

terms.term: Interest On Escrow Backup Withholding Indicator
terms.definition: Flag to indicate if interest on escrow s/b withheld due to IRS notification.
Identifies if interest is paid on for an Escrow Account of the borrower.

terms.term: Interest On Escrow Year to Date Posted Amount
terms.definition: Identifies the dollar amount of interest on escrow posted for the current year.
When true, indicates that interest is paid on restricted escrow.

The formal review of a lease which is usually memorialized in writing on a form which provides details of the business terms and legal issues.
An official examination and verification of the status of leases (or a lease) to prove or ascertain the lease terms and their adequacy.
A grant/concession given by a landlord to a tenant to induce the tenant to execute a lease. An example: a period of free or reduced rent or improving the leased premised at the landlord's expense.
The date a lease is scheduled to terminate.
The date the lease expires.
A schedule of leases that lists the dates upon which the leases expire.
An instrument by which an individual or entity guaranties payment and/or performance of the tenant's obligations under the tenant's lease.
An instrument modifying the original lease and its terms and conditions.
The date the lease starts.
A brief lease analysis (on a legal basis) which can be recorded.
A method of acquiring ownership of real estate through gradual payments under which a lease is substituted for a mortgage obligation. Also referred to as a lease with option to purchase.

1)The period during which a property owner is actively leasing vacant units or square feet to tenants in an effort to stabilize the property. The process of leasing up. 2)Fully occupied or almost fully occupied; enough commercial space within a property is rented to tenants under lease agreements that the property has stabilized (leased-up).
See SALE-LEASEBACK.
An estate or interest in real property held by virtue of a lease.
The date on which all legal rights in the property revert to the freeholder.
A loan to a lessee secured by a leasehold interest in a property.
When true, indicates that research on the project revealed pending or current legal actions.
Comments entered into the Legal and Vesting portion of the Title Insurance Policy document.
The date on which the legal and vesting data was completed by the title plant.

A property description, recognized by law, that is sufficient to locate and identify the property without oral testimony. This is primarily a component of other documents (i.e. security instruments, title policies, commitments), but is received separately on some occasions.
A free-form text field used to indicate the manner in which the organization is authorized to make or broker loans, e.g., Mortgage Banker, Mortgage Broker, Licensed Lender.

terms.term: Legal Entity Organized Under The Laws of Jurisdiction Name
terms.definition: The name and type of jurisdiction under which the party as an entity is organized and under whose authority the party as an entity operates.

terms.term: Legal Entity Successor Clause Text Description
terms.definition: The description used as the Successor Clause for the legal entity, i. e. Its successors and/or assigns.
The description of the entity type of the party or organization.
The description of the Legal Entity Type when Other is selected as the option from the enumerated list.
A term describing investments that life insurance companies, mutual savings banks or other regulated investors may make under a state charter or court order.
A tract identifier used to legally identify a property. This identifier may be different than the census tract identifier.
Indicates whether the legal data has been validated.
When true, indicates that the highest and best use is legally permissible.
When true, the legislative change has an impact on the subject foreclosure.

Person or entity that invests in or originates mortgage loans, such as a mortgage banker, credit union, commercial bank or savings and loan. In single-family property usage, the lender is generally whoever's name the loan is closed in. (In a table funding transaction, the wholesaler mortgage company is usually considered to be the "lender.") In commercial property usage, the lender is the life insurance company, bank or pension fund that provides the funds and in whose name the loan is closed.
Program that eliminates VA's involvement in loan processing and allows the lender to oversee the appraisal and underwriting process. Lender must be preapproved by VA to participate in this program.
Informs the borrower or a third party, information from, or about, the lender. This is other then a federal, state, or local requirements or regulations. AKA: Cover Letter, Welcome Letter.
The amount necessary to bring the final actual costs in line with the amount initially disclosed to the borrower.
Identifies the type of declining market based on lender analysis.
The name of lenders associate who is responsible for ordering or drawing the loan documents.
The name of lenders associate who is responsible for supervising the funding of the loan.

terms.term: Lender Late Endorsement Request Certification Letter
terms.definition: A letter from the lender on company letterhead requesting insurance endorsement more than 60 days after loan closing or funds disbursement, whichever is later. When submitting a late request for endorsement, the lender is required to include a dated certification with an original signature of its representative on company letterhead, which includes the lender's complete address and telephone number. The certification must be specific to the case being submitted, identifying the FHA case number, the name(s) of the borrower(s), and must state specific information based on the mortgage type.

An area of legal findings which would hold the lender financially responsible for damages and costs based upon the lender's activities (especially in the management of real estate securing any of the lender's mortgage loans as this relates to environmental clean-up liability).

Mortgage insurance program which allows the lender to collect a higher interest rate from the borrower and forward the excess interest to the mortgage insurance company to pay for the mortgage insurance.
When true, indicates that there is lender placed hazard insurance of any kind associated with this loan.
A free-form alphanumeric string which contains the lender's requirements and expectations regarding Title Insurance coverage, including but not limited to policy type, lien position, etc.
A free-form alphanumeric string which contains instructions and requirements that must occur prior to disbursement of funds.
A free-form alphanumeric string which contains instructions and requirements around the recording of mortgage documents.
A tracking number assigned by the wholesale lender to identify the loan for pipeline management.
Indicates that the Lender will provide self-insurance.

terms.term: Lender State Interest Rate Limit Preemption Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates the lender has chosen preemption of state limits on first lien interest rates.
A buydown which has a higher note rate than market. The higher rate funds the initial costs, or subsidy, of the temporary buydown.

The date the lender selects to have their Whole Loan purchase funded. Proceeds are typically wired to the lender 24 hours after the purchase of the loan. By selecting this date, the lender manages when the funds are to be wired.
The maximum dollar amount limit for the mortgage loan.
Specifies the criteria, guidelines or calculation used to establish the Lending Limit Amount.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Other is selected for the Lending Limit Type.
A measurement that specifies the length. The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Linear Unit Of Measure Type.
A provision in a promissory note that allows for loan payments to be adjusted temporarily if the borrower, through no fault of his or her own, is experiencing extreme financial problems.
One holding rights of possession and use of property under the terms of a lease. Also see TENANT.
One who leases property to a lessee. Also called a "landlord."
See ATTORNMENT AGREEMENT.
A letter authorizing a person or company to draw on a bank, or stating that the bank will honor their credit up to the stated amount.
A formal letter stating that a buyer or developer is interested in a property. The letter creates no legal obligation.
The number of levels in a living unit.
A measurement that specifies the total finished area of the level in the living unit. The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Area Unit Of Measure Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that identifies a specific above grade or below grade level in the living unit.
A free-form text field used to describe the level if Other is selected as the Level Type.
A measurement that specifies the total unfinished area of the level in the living unit. The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Area Unit Of Measure Type.
The use of borrowed money to increase the return on investment. For leverage to be positive, the rate of return on the investment must be higher than the cost of the money borrowed.
See DEBT/EQUITY RATIO.
The acquisition of a company, financed primarily with borrowed money, using the acquired company's assets to collateralize the loan.
An accounting term signifying money owed or expected to be owed to another party. In law, a legal term signifying a legal obligation.
A unique alphanumeric string identifying the liability.
The date the liability account was opened.
When true, indicates that the liability account will remain open after the outstanding balance is paid off.
A text description that further defines the Liability. This could be used to describe the job related expenses.
Indicates whether the liability is to be excluded from inclusion in calculations associated with processing the loan.
Insurance covering the risks related to the property and personal liability claims of other parties against the insured party.
The dollar amount of the monthly payment required on borrower's Liability Type.

terms.term: Liability Payment Includes Taxes Insurance Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that the mortgage liability payment includes taxes and/or insurance in addition to principal and interest.
When true, indicates that the liability will be paid off at or before closing.

terms.term: Liability Payoff With Current Assets Indicator
terms.definition: Indicates a liability is to be paid using borrower's current assets, prior to closing, and not out of cash from closing.
The number of months the borrower must make payments in order to satisfy the identified liability.

terms.term: Liability Secured By Subject Property Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates the specified liability is secured by the subject property.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents a financial obligation of an individual or entity. In a mortgage transaction, these are typically related to one or more borrowers.
Specifies the other liability type when Other is selected.
The amount of the outstanding balance for a Liability Type.

A clause in policies which states that if policies or endorsements currently in force are broadened by the passage of legislation or rulings from rating bodies, such policies or endorsements will be construed to include the broadening features.
London Interbank Offered Rate
London Interbank Offered Rate, which is the average rate of interest that major London banks are willing to pay each other for U.S. dollar deposits for various terms.

Generally, permission by a lawful authority to do an act which, without such permission, would be illegal. In real property, a privilege to enter for a specified purpose (e.g., to collect rents), but does not confer on or vest in the licensee any title or estate in the property.
Level of authority of the license issuer.

terms.term: License Authority Level Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for License Authority Level Type.
When true, indicates that the party is exempt from specific licensing requirement(s).
The date on which the license expires.
The identifier of the license or certificate issued to the party. The attribute IdentifierOwnerURI identifies the issuer of the license or certificate.
The date on which the license was issued.
The name of the issuing authority through which the party obtained the license.
The two-character representation of the US state, US Territory, Canadian Province, Military APO FPO, or Territory in which the party is licensed or certified to operate.
The name of the state in which the party is licensed or certified to operate.
A legal hold or claim of a creditor on the property of another as security for a debt. Liens may be against real or personal property.
Describes the lien on the property.

terms.term: Lien Holder Same As Subject Loan Indicator
terms.definition: Indicates that the lien holder of the related loan is the same as the lien holder of the subject loan.
Describes the holder of the lien.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Lien Holder Type.
Describes the lien priority for a piece of collateral where multiple pieces of collateral secure a single loan.

terms.term: Lien Priority Exception Type Other Description
terms.definition: Specifies the lien priority when other is selected for Lien Priority Exception Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the priority of the lien against the property.
A free-form text field used to capture the lien priority type if Other is selected as the lien priority type.
Specifies the recommendation to the investor from the servicer on loan disposition of the senior lien when the subject loan is a subordinate lien.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected as the Lien Recommendation Type.
When true, indicates that a lien will be released in the debt charge off consideration.
A principle in which the holder of a mortgage (a lender) has only a lien or security interest against mortgaged property, rather than a true title interest.

A waiver of mechanic's lien rights; a document signed by a supplier or subcontractor stating that the firm has been compensated for its work, thereby giving up its right to file a claim against the property.
A freehold estate, terminated upon the death of the beneficiary, giving a beneficiary all property rights except the right to sell.
The dollar amount of the face value of the borrower's Life Insurance.
Specifies agreement between a company and an individual to pay a pre-determined amount of money to a beneficiary if the insured dies during the policy term.

terms.term: Life Of Loan Borrower Assistance Paid Amount
terms.definition: The total dollar amount of all borrower assistance paid to the servicer on behalf of the borrower associated with any workouts over the life of the loan. Repayment of funds is not expected.

terms.term: Life Of Loan Total Forgiven Interest Amount
terms.definition: Cumulative total amount of interest forgiven over the life of the loan.

terms.term: Life Of Loan Total Forgiven Principal Amount
terms.definition: Cumulative total amount of principal forgiven over the life of the loan.

terms.term: Life Of Loan Total Interest Paid Amount
terms.definition: The cumulative amount of interest paid over the life of the loan.

terms.term: Life Of Loan Total Miscellaneous Charges Amount
terms.definition: The cumulative amount of miscellaneous charges paid over the life of the loan.

terms.term: Life Of Loan Workout Modification Count
terms.definition: A count of the number of prior completed modifications associated with workouts over the life of the loan.

terms.term: Life Of Loan Workout Modification Defaulted Count
terms.definition: A count of the number of prior completed modifications where the loan subsequently missed two or more payments.
A tax term applying to the exchange of business or investment properties. Taxes on an exchange may be postponed for like-kind properties.
Another term for a no income verification mortgage.
A form of business ownership that consists of one or more general partners who are fully liable, and one or more limited partners who are liable only for the amount of their investment.
Describes in detail the budget for the construction of a home.
An agreement by a commercial bank or other financial institution to extend credit up to a certain amount for a certain time to a specific borrower.
The current amount that has been drawn from a line of credit.

terms.term: Line Of Credit Drawn Pro Rata Share Attributable To Unit Amount
terms.definition: The proportionate amount of the project's drawn line of credit obligated to the subject unit(s).
When true, indicates that the lien is a line of credit.
The maximum amount that can be extended as a line of credit.

terms.term: Line Of Credit Maximum Pro Rata Share Attributable To Unit Amount
terms.definition: The proportionate amount of the project's maximum line of credit obligated to the subject unit(s).

terms.term: Line Of Credit Pro Rata Share Selection Method Type
terms.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the pro rata share line of credit amount that was used in determining the final opinion of value when one or more blanket financing liens is a line of credit.
When true, indicates that the line of credit referenced is secured by collateral.
Identifies the type of linear measurement method applied.

terms.term: Liquid Asset Total Cash Or Market Value Amount
terms.definition: The total amount of the cash or market value of all liquid assets.
The value of an asset upon its sale or disposition.
The ability to readily convert assets or investments to cash.
A notice recorded in the official records of a county to indicate that there is a pending suit affecting land within the jurisdiction.
A free-form text describing the offering prices, dates, and data sources of the previous twelve (12) months of listing.
When true, indicates that the property has been listed within the previous twelve (12) months.
A written authorization for an agent to sell or lease real estate.
The date when the listing was no longer offered for sale or rent.
A unique alphanumeric string used to identify the listing.
When true, indicates that the investor has waived the 90 day property listing requirement.
The date when the listing was created.
The disposition date related to the Listing Status Type.
The disposition of the listing.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for the ListingStatusType.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents how the property is being listed.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Listing Type.

When true, indicates litigation affects the investor. This litigation may seek damages against the investor, challenge the validity of the mortgage loan or poses legal or reputational risk to the investor.
When true, indicates the litigation affects the title or limits valid conveyance of the subject property.
When true, the filed or threatened litigation involves a group of interested parties, qualified by a court.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the reason the judicial process has ended.

terms.term: Litigation End Reason Type Additional Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to provide a supplemental comment or remark to the Litigation End Reason Type.

terms.term: Litigation End Reason Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when Other is selected for Litigation End Reason Type.
The date litigation was filed in a court of law against one or more of the named parties.
The date litigation ended, by settlement, dismissal or the completion of court proceedings. At the completion of court proceedings the parties may still be awaiting final judgment.
The date associated with the reported Litigation Status Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the current procedural state of the reported litigation.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when Other is selected for Litigation Status Type.
The date an interested party learned of threatened litigation.

A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the type of legal action that has been filed or threatened by one or more parties that may impact the servicer, investor, borrower or underlying obligation.
A free-form text field used to provide a supplemental comment or remark to an individual Litigation Type.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when Other is selected for Litigation Type.
Rights concerning the use or enjoyment of properties abutting a river or lake rather than a river or stream (riparian rights).

terms.term: Living Conditions Improved With Rental Counseling Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that a household improved their living conditions after receiving rental counseling.
The number of separate living units in the structure, including any accessory dwelling units.
The number of separate living units in the subject property, excluding any accessory dwelling units.
The percentage of the living units defined in the manner specified in Housing Unit Inventory to the total number of living units.
The balance amount of unpaid principal on the mortgage as of loan acquisition.
The scheduled unpaid principal balance of the mortgage as of loan acquisition or the issue date of the associated security.
A unique identifier for a loan activity reporting transaction.
A mortgage banking function which includes the receipt of payments, customer service, escrow administration, investor accounting, and may include default related activities. Also called Servicing.
When true, indicates that the loan is classified as an affordable loan by the lender or the investor.
The age of the loan expressed in months calculated as defined by trading partner agreement.
The price of the loan including all fees and adjustments, represented as a percent.

terms.term: Loan Amortization Maximum Term Months Count
terms.definition: The maximum number of months over which an extendable mortgage may be amortized.
The number periods (as defined by the Loan Amortization Period Type) over which the scheduled loan payments of principal and/or interest are calculated to retire the obligation.
The duration of time used to define the period over which the loan is amortized.
When true, indicates that the loan amount can increase after closing.

Provides information about the employment, income, assets, debts and other financial information of the prospective borrowers. Includes information about the purpose of the home loan and about the property securing the home loan. Provided by Borrower with assistance from the lender. AKA: Uniform Residential Loan Application, 1003, Credit Application, 65.
Residential Loan Application for Reverse Mortgages
Uniform Residential Loan Application

The date the mortgage loan approval was made by the lender to the borrower. A loan approval involves verifying credit, down payment, employment history, etc. of the borrower(s) and will generally state that the borrower is approved for a loan upon satisfaction of certain conditions.
The date the mortgage loan approval expires.
The number of days the mortgage loan approval is in effect.
When true, indicates that this loan asset was added to the security in the current investor reporting period.
The price of the loan, represented as a percent, prior to applying fees and adjustments.

terms.term: Loan Buyup Buydown Basis Point Number
terms.definition: The number of basis points of loan level buyup/buydown selected by the seller for this mortgage.
Specifies the type of buyup or buydown an eligible Seller has elected to exercise for a specific mortgage.

terms.term: Loan Buyup Buydown Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to provide additional information when Other is selected for Loan Buyup Buydown Type.
Informs the borrower of total finance charges and interest rates associated with the loan.
Defines whether the loan is a closed loan purchase or a table funded loan.
The date and time of the loan comment.
System specific string indicating the source of the loan comment.
The text of the loan comment.

The date the mortgage loan commitment to the borrower was made. The loan commitment is a formal, binding offer from a lender that a specified amount of loan or line of credit will be made available to the named borrower at a certain interest rate, during a certain period and, usually, for a certain purpose. The commitment also specifies the terms and requirements under which the loan will be advanced.
The date the mortgage loan commitment expires.

terms.term: Loan Commitment Letter Interest Rate Percent
terms.definition: A portion of 100 that represents the interest rate on the loan as provided for the interest rate lock commitment letter.
The number of days the mortgage loan commitment is in effect.

A statement required to be disclosed to, or considered by, the borrower of certain information pertaining to loan program features, creditor policies, and requirements in or arising from the legal obligation or loan. Used in conjunction with Loan Consideration Disclosure Statement Type.

A value from a prescribed list that specifies the type of statement required to be disclosed to, or considered by, the borrower of certain information pertaining to loan program features, creditor policies, and requirements in or arising from the legal obligation or loan.

terms.term: Loan Consideration Disclosure Statement Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to capture additional information when Other is selected for Loan Consideration Disclosure Statement Type.
The annual interest and amortization as a percentage of the principal loan amount. Calculated by dividing the debt service by the loan amount.
Describes the period of time prior to the note date within which the credit history was obtained.

terms.term: Loan Credit History Age Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for the Loan Credit History Age Type.
Indicates the party that bears the default loss for the loan.
The frequency that the servicer must report for loans that are in default.
The number of days after which a servicer can stop advancing funds on a delinquent loan.
The date the loan delinquency event occurred.
Used to report an event on a delinquent loan.

terms.term: Loan Delinquency Event Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to capture the Loan Delinquency Event Type if Other is selected.

terms.term: Loan Delinquency History Period Months Count
terms.definition: The duration in months of the period for which the history of the late mortgage is provided.
The reason why the Borrower has become delinquent on the loan.

terms.term: Loan Delinquency Reason Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to capture the Loan Delinquency Reason type if Other is selected.
The date the loan delinquency status occurred.
Loan Delinquency Status Type is used to report the status of a delinquent loan (i.e., is the loan in delinquency, foreclosure, bankruptcy, or some other status).

terms.term: Loan Delinquency Status Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to capture the Loan Delinquency Status Type if Other is selected.
A unique alphanumeric string identifying the extent or level of the loan documentation being collected to process and underwrite the loan.
The dollar amount borrowed against the loan for the draw transaction.
The date on which the draw transaction was executed.
The last date on which the borrower is able to draw funds on a line of credit.

terms.term: Loan Draw Extension Term Months Count
terms.definition: The number of months by which the draw term can be extended in a single transaction.
The maximum dollar amount a borrower can withdraw in each draw transaction against the loan.

terms.term: Loan Draw Maximum Term Months Count
terms.definition: The maximum number of months to which the draw term can be extended.
The minimum dollar amount a borrower can withdraw in each draw transaction against the loan.

terms.term: Loan Draw Minimum Initial Draw Amount
terms.definition: The minimum dollar amount the borrower is required to withdraw in the first draw transaction against the loan.

terms.term: Loan Draw Period Maximum Draw Count
terms.definition: The maximum number of times a borrower can withdraw funds against the loan during a specific period.

terms.term: Loan Draw Start Period Months Count
terms.definition: The minimum number of months from closing after which the borrower may begin to withdraw funds from the loan.
The total number of months during which draws are allowed.

The CFPB Loan Estimate document. Provides disclosures that help consumers in understanding the key features, costs, and risks of the mortgage for which they are applying. The Loan Estimate replaces the GFE document and the initial TILDisclosure document.

terms.term: Loan Estimate Waiting Period Waived Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that upon receipt of the Loan Estimate, and due to a bona fide personal financial emergency, the consumer modified or waived the seven-business-day waiting period that must be met prior to consummation of the mortgage loan transaction.
The estimated closing date for loan at the time of application.
A fee charged a borrower by a lender for negotiating a loan; sometimes used in reference to an additional fee over and above the origination fee.

When true, indicates the Borrower answered “yes” to the declaration question: “Have you directly or indirectly been obligated on any loan that resulted in foreclosure, transfer of title in lieu of foreclosure, or judgment?”
The dollar amount disbursed under a loan agreement in advance of full funding.
The date the loan funds were released from the original lender to the closing agent for disbursement to the borrower.
A VA document that states the portion of a loan that is guaranteed.
The value of the identifier for the specified type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the type of loan identifier.
A free-form text field used to describe the Loan Identifier Type when Other is selected as the Loan Identifier Type.
The source of the information that the loan is in a state of imminent default.

terms.term: Loan Imminent Default Source Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected as the Loan Imminent Default Source Type.
The date that interest begins to accrue for a loan.
When true, indicates that the loan level credit score was used for decisioning of the loan.

terms.term: Loan Level Credit Score Selection Method Type
terms.definition: Specifies the method used to select the Loan Credit Score across all borrowers.

terms.term: Loan Level Credit Score Selection Method Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for the Loan Credit Score Selection Method Type.
The one credit score value that represents the overall credit risk on the loan. This value is determined using credit score values for each qualifying borrower.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents a category of lending limits that are particular to a type of loan.

terms.term: Loan Limit Category Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Loan Limit Category Type.
The date on which the loan limit is scheduled to begin.
Indicates that the loan was manually underwritten.
Name of the organization that has manually underwritten the loan.
Describes how to calculate the margin on the loan.
The date when the loan is scheduled to be paid in full as reflected on the Note.
The scheduled number of periods (as defined by Loan Maturity Period Type) after which the loan will mature.
The unit of time used to define the period over which the loan matures. Used in conjunction with Loan Maturity Period Count.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that identifies the modification action that resulted in a change or changes to the loan note terms.

terms.term: Loan Modification Action Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Loan Modification Action Type.
A testament that the items stated in the modification application package are true and correct.
An agreement between a servicer and a borrower to permanently modify the terms of a mortgage loan and either modify existing or establish new conditions as appropriate.
A statement that a modification is denied and the reason(s) why.
The date on which the Modification Agreement goes into effect.
An application representing underwriting information for a loan modification which may include the reasons for the modification request. AKA: Request for Mortgage Assistance (RMA)

terms.term: Loan Modification Trial Payment Period Agreement
terms.definition: An agreement between a servicer and a borrower to temporarily modify the terms of a mortgage loan for a trial payment period (TPP) and either modify existing or establish new conditions as appropriate.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that identifies the note term(s) that changed as a result of a loan modification. More than one term could change as the result of one loan modification.
Used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Loan Modification Type.
Denotes the method of resolving a loan that has reached the negative amortization limit percent.

terms.term: Loan Negative Amortization Resolution Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Loan Negative Amortization Resolution Type.

A portion of 100 that represents the loan-level pricing of the selected loan and rate chosen after payment of fees and discount points. The net price is represented as a percentage where one hundred percent is the full price of the loan without any discounts.
A control number (i.e. key) for the loan in the sending loan origination system.
A descriptive name of the loan origination system as determined by the vendor. For example, EasyLender.
A unique identifier agreed upon by the parties to the transaction to identify the vendor of the loan origination system used to process the loan.
Specifies the version of the loan origination system used to process the loan.
The date the individual loan originator was first assigned to the transaction.
The date the individual loan originator was last assigned to the transaction.
A value from a MISMO defined list that specifies the type of party that originated the loan.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Loan Originator Type.
The amount the borrower has sent in advance of the scheduled payment date when that amount is not enough to cover the entire amount of the next payment.
The minimum dollar amount that must be applied in order to advance the last paid installment date. This may be applicable to Title I daily simple interest loans.
The calendar year when the year to date payments were made on a loan.
Provides Lender with information to determine the amount required to pay off an account and the outstanding principle balance as of a specific date.
A line item component of a price quote, expressed as a dollar amount.

terms.term: Loan Price Line Item Category Description
terms.definition: Defines the category of the Price Line Item. Categories such as Fee, Adjustment, or Charge may reflect tax or accounting implications for the line item.
A line item component of a price quote, expressed as a percent of the loan amount.
Denotes a type of fee, price adjustment, or other charge that is provided as detail information with a price quote.

terms.term: Loan Price Line Item Type Other Description
terms.definition: A text description of the type of pricing line item, used when the value of Other is chosen for the attribute Price Line Item Type.
Describes the format of the price as being relative to par (0-Base) or absolute (100-base).
The date and time at which a Price Quote was created.
The date and time at which a Price Quote expires.
A unique identifier for a loan price quote, assigned by the party that makes the price quote for tracking purposes.

terms.term: Loan Price Quote Interest Rate Percent
terms.definition: The mortgage loan interest rate for which the price quote is calculated.

The supply chain of loans, both before and after a loan closing involves funds to purchase the asset and expected or real income from the sale of the asset. In the supply chain one organizations sale price is the purchase price of another organization.

terms.term: Loan Price Quote Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information or a description of the Loan Price Quote Type when Other is selected as the value.
The name of the legal entity from which the seller acquired the loan.
The status of the particular loan product.
The period from loan application through funding of a mortgage loan.
When true, indicates that the loan program is classified as an affordable program.
Identifies the mortgage program associated with the loan as defined by a specific entity. Entity may be referenced using OwnerIdentifierURI or "Loan Program Sponsoring Entity Name".
The name of the entity that defines the loan program.

The ratio of the amount of the loan to the appraised value or sales price of real property (expressed as a percentage).
The total number of loans submitted in a request.
A government agency that monitors and implements programs to satisfy community housing development needs.

Location of the resource within the external resource.
