A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the location where a video from a Remote Onlne Notarization session is stored.

terms.term: RON Video Location Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for RONVideoLocationType.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the estimated age range of the roof.
An enumeration or a coded value identifying the Roof Load Zone that the manufactured home was designed and constructed to conform to.
Identifies the type of roofing material used in the structure.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Roof Material Type.
When true, indicates that the roof of the structure is observable.
A free-form text field describing the condition of the room being referenced.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the condition of the room.

terms.term: Room Condition Status Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Room Condition Status Type.
A free-form text field used to describe in detail the identified room feature.
Specifies the features of the identified Room Type.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Room Feature Type.
A free-form text field describing the quality of the room being referenced.
A free-form text field summarizing the quality of the room being referenced.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents a category of room.
A free-form text field used to describe the room if Other is selected as the Room Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the degree to which the room has been finished.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the estimated range of years when the room was updated.

terms.term: Room Updated Timeframe Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Room Updated Timeframe Type.

terms.term: Rowhouse Townhouse Back To Back Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that the rowhouse/townhouse shares a rear wall with a rear wall of another property.
When true, indicates that a rowhouse/townhouse is located at the end of the row of attached properties.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the location of the rowhouse/townhouse when there are other properties above or below.
When true, indicates that there are other properties above and/or below the rowhouse/townhouse being referenced.

A organization who agreed to grant, or who has been deemed to have agreed to grant, the Royalty-Free Patent License (as defined in the IPR Policy) with respect to this MISMO Product pursuant to MISMOs IPR Policy, a copy of which is available for reference at www.mismo.org.

The Residential Standards Governance Committee and the Commercial Standards Governance Committee work in concert with the MISMO Officers and the MISMO Manager and other MISMO committees and report to the MISMO Board of Directors.
A unique code associated with an executed rule.
A text description of an executed rule.
Method used by a lender (usually on installment loans) for calculating an interest rebate on a loan paid off or refinanced prior to its maturity date.

terms.term: Rural Housing Conditional Guaranty Expiration Date
terms.definition: For Rural Housing loans, the expiration date of the guaranty.

terms.term: Rural Housing Conditional Guaranty Interest Rate Percent
terms.definition: For Rural Housing loans, the interest rate included in the USDA guaranty.

A government agency within the U.S. Department of Agriculture which offers various financing programs available to aid in the development of rural America. These rural housing programs are divided into three categories; Community Facilities (CF), Single Family Housing (SFH), and Multi-Family Housing (MFH). These programs were formerly operated by the Rural Development Administration and the Farmers Home Administration.
A unique alphanumeric string identifying the box located on a rural route for the delivery of mail, as assigned by the USPS.
A unique alphanumeric string identifying the rural route for the delivery of mail, as assigned by the USPS.
When true, indicates the subject property county has been identified by the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau as Rural or Underserved.
Calculated amount required as a component in specifying the presumption of compliance type.

terms.term: Sale Price Gross Total Adjustment Amount
terms.definition: The gross dollar amount of the adjustments made to a comparable property price.

terms.term: Sale Price Net Total Adjustment Amount
terms.definition: The net dollar amount of the adjustments made to a comparable property price.
The dollar value of the total adjustments made to a comparable property sales price during the application of the Sales Comparison approach to determine the market value of the subject property.

terms.term: Sale Price Total Adjustment Net Percent
terms.definition: The percentage of the net sales price adjustments to the sales price of a property during the application of the sales comparison approach to property valuation.

terms.term: Sale To List Price Ratio Percent
terms.definition: A ratio that represents the difference between the list prices and negotiated sales prices for settled sales in the subject property's market.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the type of sales transaction for the property.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Sale Type.
A financing arrangement in which a developer sells a property to an investor, then buys it back on a long-term sales contract. Also called an "installment-sale contract."
A sales arrangement where a seller deeds a property to a buyer for consideration. The seller then leases the same property back from its new owner.
When true, indicates the sales comparison approach will be included in the appraisal report to support the assignment.
A free-form text field used to describe or comment on the Sales Comparison approach in evaluating the subject property.

terms.term: Sales Comparison Current Sales Agreement Analysis Comment Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe or comment on the analysis of the current Sales Agreement on subject property.

terms.term: Sales Comparison Total Bedroom Value Amount
terms.definition: The dollar value of all the bedrooms. This value is determined by multiplying the Sales Comparison Value Per Bedroom Amount by the total number of bedrooms in the subject property.

terms.term: Sales Comparison Total Gross Building Area Value Amount
terms.definition: The dollar value of the gross building area. This value is determined by multiplying the Sales Comparison Value Per Gross Building Area Amount by the Gross Building Area Square Feet Count value of the subject property.

terms.term: Sales Comparison Total Room Value Amount
terms.definition: The dollar value of all of the rooms. This value is determined by multiplying the Sales Comparison Value Per Room Amount by the total number of rooms in the subject property.

terms.term: Sales Comparison Total Unit Value Amount
terms.definition: The dollar value of all the living units. This value is determined by multiplying the Sales Comparison Value Per Unit Amount by the number of living units in the subject property.

terms.term: Sales Comparison Unit Of Measure Description
terms.definition: Specifies the unit of measure used in the Sales Comparison approach when comparing vacant land properties. (e.g. $ per lakefront acre; $ per wooded acre.)

terms.term: Sales Comparison Value Per Bedroom Amount
terms.definition: The dollar value of a bedroom as indicated by the Sales Comparison approach to property valuation.

terms.term: Sales Comparison Value Per Gross Building Area Amount
terms.definition: The dollar value per square foot of living area as indicated by the Sales Comparison approach to property valuation.

terms.term: Sales Comparison Value Per Room Amount
terms.definition: The dollar value of a room as indicated by the Sales Comparison approach to property valuation.

terms.term: Sales Comparison Value Per Unit Amount
terms.definition: The dollar value of a living unit as indicated by the Sales Comparison approach to property valuation.
Something a seller pays of value to a purchaser in order to entice the purchaser to buy the home. Another term for seller contribution.
The dollar amount of the value of the individual sales concession corresponding to the Sales Concession Type.
When true, indicates the total amount of sales concessions are known.
A free-form text field used to describe sales concessions granted by an interested party.
When true indicates the presence of a concession in the sales contract.
Specifies the party providing the sales concession.

terms.term: Sales Concession Provided By Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Sales Concession Provided By Type.
Quantifies the type of concessions related to the transaction for which the contract has been analyzed.
A free-form text field used if SalesConcessionType is Other.

terms.term: Sales Concessions Typical To Market Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that sales concessions are common for the identified market.
A free-form text field describing the conditions of the sale.
A written agreement between buyer and seller stating terms and conditions of a sale or exchange of property.
When true, indicates that the sales contract has been reviewed and accepted by both parties.
The amount of money the contract is for.
A free-form text field used for the analysis of the terms and conditions of the property sales contract.
The date the sales contract was fully executed.
When true, indicates that an active sales contract is associated with the property.

terms.term: Sales Contract Invoice Review Comment Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field reporting any comments about the sales contract or the reason it was not reviewed.
Indicates that the appraiser did review the sales contract.
The name of the vendor of the contract.
A free-form text field describing the sales contract.
A free-form text field describing the result of the review and analysis of the contract for sale or why analysis was not performed.
Indicated that the appraiser reviewed and analyzed the contract for sale for the subject purchase transaction.

terms.term: Sales Contract Terms Consistent With Market Indicator
terms.definition: Indicates that the terms and conditions of the sales contract are consistent with the local market.

terms.term: Sales History Not Researched Comment Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe or comment on why the sales or transfer history research of the subject property and comparable sales was not performed.
Indicates that the sales or transfer history research of the subject property and comparable sales was performed.
The dollar value of a bedroom of the property determined by dividing the sales price by the total number of bedrooms in the property.

terms.term: Sales Price Per Gross Building Area Amount
terms.definition: The sales price in terms of dollars per square foot of the gross building area. This is a ratio between the sales price and an area, but it is a monetary value rather than a factor or rate.

terms.term: Sales Price Per Gross Living Area Amount
terms.definition: The sales price in terms of dollars per square foot of gross living area. This is a ratio between the sales price and an area, but it is a monetary value rather than a factor or rate.

terms.term: Sales Price Per Ownership Share Amount
terms.definition: The dollar value of one share of the property determined by dividing the sales price by the total number of property ownership shares.
The dollar value of one room of the property determined by dividing the sales price by the total number of rooms in the property.
The dollar value of a living unit in a multi-unit property determined by dividing the sales price by the total number of units within the property.

terms.term: Sales Price To List Price Rate Percent
terms.definition: Specifies the ratio of the property sales price to its list price.

terms.term: Sales Price Total Adjustment Gross Percent
terms.definition: The percentage of the gross sales price adjustments (i.e. sum of the absolute adjustment values) to the sales price of a property during the application of the sales comparison approach for property valuation.
The estimated value of a depreciable asset at the end of its useful life. Net salvage value is the asset's depreciated value minus the cost of disposing of or removing it.
When true, indicates that the comparable property was constructed by the same builder as the subject property.
When true, indicates that the comparable property is in the same project as the subject property.
A lease in which the "sandwich party" is a lessee, paying rent on a leasehold interest to one party, and is also a lessor, collecting rents from another party or parties.

On July 30, 2002, President Bush signed into law the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, which he characterized as ""the most far reaching reforms of American business practices since the time of Franklin Delano Roosevelt."" The Act mandated a number of reforms to enhance corporate responsibility, enhance financial disclosures and combat corporate and accounting fraud, and created the ""Public Company Accounting Oversight Board,"" also known as the PCAOB, to oversee the activities of the auditing profession.
A secondary tenant in a shopping center that depends on the ability of an anchor tenant to draw customers.
The discharge of an obligation by paying a party what it is due.
Confirms that a judgment filed against a property has been released. Provided by a legal authority. AKA: Acknowledgement of Satisfaction of Judgment.
The recorded instrument the lender provides to evidence payment in full of the mortgage debt.

Confirms the security interest has been paid off and the lien on the property is released. Required to be recorded. AKA: Reconveyance, Real Estate Lien Release, Satisfaction of Deed of Trust Certificate And Affidavit Of Satisfaction, Certificate Of Discharge, Certificate Of Satisfaction, Deed Of Reconveyance, Deed Of Release, Discharge Of Deed To Secure Debt, Discharge Of Mortgage, Full Deed Of Release, Full Reconveyance, Lost Mortgage Satisfaction, Release Of Lien, Release Of Mortgage, Request For Cancellation, Request For Full [X] / Partial [ ] Release Of Deed Of Trust And Release, Satisfaction, Satisfaction Of Mortgage, Satisfaction Piece, Satisfaction, Cancellation Or Discharge Of Mortgage, Trust Deed Release.

terms.term: Savings And Community Bankers Of America (SCBA)
terms.definition: Trade association located in Washington, D.C. serving the savings institution business and the public interest by furthering thrift and homeownership.

A mutual or stock association chartered and regulated by the Office of Thrift Supervision. Traditionally, deposits are invested in residential mortgage loans, although savings and loans now have broader lending powers.

Successor insurance fund to FSLIC, this fund insures the deposit accounts of federally insured savings associations. The SAIF, which is separate from the Bank Insurance Fund (BIF), is administered by the FDIC.

Refers to how much a system can be expanded. The term by itself implies a positive capability. For example, "the device is known for its scalability" means that it can be made to serve a larger number of users without breaking down or requiring major changes in procedure.
Process of collaborating with all interested parties associated with the transaction to schedule the closing location and closing date and time.
Based on scheduled amortization, date at which the loan due date reaches the midpoint of the loans amortization period (e.g., for a 360 month loan, the date of month number 181).
The number of payments the borrower is expected to make per year.
The date of the first scheduled mortgage payment to be made by the borrower under the terms of the mortgage.
The total number of payments the borrower is expected to make over the course of the loan.
The unpaid principal balance on the loan based on an agreed upon schedule.
Remittance agreement which requires the servicer to give investor scheduled interest, regardless of actual collections from borrowers, and actual principal collected.
Remittance agreement which requires the servicer to give the investor the scheduled interest and the scheduled principal due, whether or not payments are collected from borrowers.

Considered the next generation of DTDs, a schema is a DTD plus data type information. Schemas are a set of rules with a document outlining which tags are allowed and how those tags relate to one another.
An architect's sketches illustrating space planning, structural systems and structure in relationship to a site plan.
Free-form text description of the school in the area for the specified type.
The name of the school district in which the property is located.
The Uniform Resource Locator (web address) for the school district.
The highest grade offered by the school.
The lowest grade offered by the school.
The full name of the specified school.

The public school type as categorized by the common names for grades supported by the indicated school. Each state determines what grade range constitutes elementary education. According to its length, elementary education may be followed (or not) by a number of years of middle school education (generally three years). Secondary education takes place in grades 7-12, depending upon the laws and policies of states and local school districts. There is no national structure, curriculum or governing law; all laws and policies are set and enforced by the 50 state governments and the over 14,000 local school districts. All states and school districts have set the secondary school graduation level as the completion of 12th grade, and the common name for the secondary graduation qualification is the High School Diploma. This diploma name covers a variety of awards for different curricula and standards.
The number of grades offered by the indicated school type.
A free-form description of the school if School Type Other is selected.
The Uniform Resource Locator (web address) for the school.
The number of years the borrower has attended school.
A description of the nature of service, activities, studies, jobs or work to be undertaken by a party.
Servicemembers Civil Relief Act
When true, indicates that the loan is subject to the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act (SCRA).
A letter sent to service members detailing that their mortgage loan is in default, advising them of potential protections and providing contact information for further discussion. AKA: HUD98070.
The date on which SCRA benefits, such as interest rate reductions and/or foreclosure protections, begin to apply to the loan.
The date on which SCRA benefits, such as interest rate reductions and/or foreclosure protections end.
When true indicates that relief under Servicemembers Civil Relief Act (SCRA) has been requested.
Specifies the status of relief under the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act (SCRA) for any borrower on the loan.

terms.term: SCRA Relief Status Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected as the SCRA Relief Status Type.
Specifies the type of SCRA relief that the borrower is receiving.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected as the SCRAReliefType.
The dollar amount of the monthly mortgage payment subsidy provided in accordance with the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act (SCRA).
When true, indicates that the amount of income is only earned during portion of the calendar year.
Specifies the details of the seasonal payment feature, including the period during which periodic payments are not scheduled.
When true, indicates the loan contains a seasonal payment feature.
The month that the period during which payments are not scheduled ends.
The month that the period during which payments are not scheduled begins.
A mortgage on which payments have been made regularly for a year or longer.
The leasing of space in a shopping center or other property that was previously occupied by another tenant.
A property purchased for occupancy by the owner but which is not the primary residence. Usually recreational properties.
A mortgage that has rights subordinate to a first mortgage. Also called "second trust."
Another term for a second mortgage.
A funding method using a loan secured by a second mortgage on a property. Sometimes used to refer to any financing technique other than equity and first mortgage debt.
Indicates whether a subordinate mortgage will be paid off by the refinance and rolled into the new first mortgage balance. Used for refinances.

A mortgage banking function responsible for developing mortgage products to originate, managing interest rate risk, setting pricing, and executing the sale, securitization, or retention of mortgage loans in a way that optimizes liquidity, profitability, and balance sheet efficiency.
The market where lenders and investors buy and sell existing mortgages or mortgage-backed securities, thereby providing greater availability of funds for additional mortgage lending.
A division or parcel of land on a government survey comprising one square or 640 acres.
Informs the borrower that a loan is considered a high cost loan. Required by Regulation Z. AKA: 2016a.

HUD's primary program for the rehabilitation and repair of single-family properties. A 203(k) loan is a first mortgage that covers the costs of rehabilitation and purchase or refinance of an eligible property. The goals of the Section 203(k) loan program are community and neighborhood revitalization and expanded opportunities for homeownership for low- and moderate-income families.
The section number on the Good Faith Estimate/HUD-1 associated with a fee type.

The thirty-six (36) square miles outlined by a surveying township. Sections are numbered boustrophedonically (right to left then dropping down a row and continuing left to right) beginning in the northeast section. Each Section contains 640 acres.
Identifies the section of the National Housing Act which defines underwriting guidelines for VA or FHA loan evaluations.

terms.term: Section Of Act Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Section of Act Type.

terms.term: Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act (SAFE Act)
terms.definition: Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act (SAFE Act)
Secure Electronic Transaction protocol, a rival to SSL.
Cryptographic has a function which takes an input and produces a 160-bit hash value known as a message digest, which is typically rendered as a 40-digit hexadecimal number.
Cryptographic has function which takes an input and produces a 256-bit hash value known as a message digest, which is typically rendered as a 64-digit hexadecimal number.

Secure Identity Services Accreditation Corporation, a non-profit subsidiary of the Mortgage Bankers Association (MBA) that develops and maintains industry standards for secure identity credentials to be used within e-mortgage related transactions and accredits issuers of secure identity credentials against these same standards.

The industry-standard method for protecting web communications developed by Netscape Communications Corporation. The SSL security protocol provides data encryption, server authentication, message integrity, and optional client authentication for a TCP-IP connection. This term is also defined in the MERS eRegistry Procedures Manual available at members.mersinc.org.

The Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) is a broad measure of the cost of borrowing cash overnight collateralized by Treasury securities. The SOFR includes all trades in the Broad General Collateral Rate plus bilateral Treasury Repurchase Agreement (repo) transactions cleared through the Delivery-versus-Payment (DVP) service offered by the Fixed Income Clearing Corporation (FICC), which is filtered to remove a portion of transactions considered "specials". Note that specials are repos for specific-issue collateral, which take place at cash-lending rates below those for general collateral repos because cash providers are willing to accept a lesser return on their cash in order to obtain a particular security.

The Participant named on the MERS eRegistry that has been sold, pledged, assigned, or granted a security interest in the eNote by the Controller. This term is also defined in the MERS eRegistry Procedures Manual available at members.mersinc.org.

The Participant that is authorized by the Secured Party to perform certain MERSeRegistry transactions on the Secured Party's behalf. This term is also defined in the MERS eRegistry Procedures Manual available at members.mersinc.org.
A governing body that regulates the sale and registration of securities. The SEC protects investors and the general public against fraud and malpractice in financial markets.
The process of pooling loans into mortgage backed securities for sale into the secondary mortgage market.
A deposit of money by a tenant to a landlord to secure performance of a written or oral rental agreement (lease).
Mortgage or deed of trust evidencing the pledge of real estate as collateral for the loan.
Mortgage or deed of trust evidencing the pledge of real estate as collateral for the loan. Establishes the lender's security interest in the real property.
Adds additional terms to the security instrument.
Specifies the type of addendum referenced on the Security Instrument.

terms.term: Security Instrument Addendum Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Security Instrument Addendum Type.
The assumption fee expressed in dollars that is charged by the Lender if there is an assumption on the loan.

terms.term: Security Instrument Attorney Fee Minimum Amount
terms.definition: The minimum amount of attorney fees that the borrower will be charged resulting from an acceleration and/or foreclosure of mortgage.
The attorney fees the borrower will be charged, expressed as a percentage of the amount decreed for principal and interest resulting from an acceleration and/or foreclosure of mortgage.
The Name of the Attorney who prepared or supervised the preparation of the security instrument. This field is used, for example, on the Maryland Mortgage.

terms.term: Security Instrument Certifying Attorney Unparsed Address
terms.definition: The address of the attorney who prepared or supervised the preparation of the security instrument. This field is used, for example, on the Maryland Mortgage.
The date referenced in the security instrument.

terms.term: Security Instrument Maximum Principal Indebtedness Amount
terms.definition: The maximum principal indebtedness amount in the state of Tennessee as stated on the deed of trust.
Changes one or more of the terms of a loan of the mortgagor in the security instrument.

terms.term: Security Instrument Modification: Consolidation Extension Modification Agreement
terms.definition: Used for refinance loans in state of NY. AKA: CEMA.

terms.term: Security Instrument Multiple Units Real Property Is Improved Or To Be Improved Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates the Multiple Units Real Property Is Improved Or To Be Improved check box on the New York Mortgage should be checked.
The name of the Note Holder.

terms.term: Security Instrument Notice Of Confidentiality Rights Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to capture the notice of confidentiality rights verbiage. This field is used, for example, on the TX Security Instrument.
The dollar amount of the other fees required to be disclosed on the Rhode Island security instrument.
The description of the other fees required to be disclosed on the Rhode Island security instrument.

terms.term: Security Instrument Owelty Of Partition Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates the Owelty Of Partition check box on the Texas security instrument should be checked.

terms.term: Security Instrument Person Authorized To Release Lien Name
terms.definition: On the Arkansas Mortgage, the Name of the person who is authorized to release lien. This field is used, for example, on the Arkansas Mortgage.

terms.term: Security Instrument Person Authorized To Release Lien Telephone Value
terms.definition: The telephone number of the person who is authorized to release lien. This field is used on the Arkansas Mortgage.

terms.term: Security Instrument Person Authorized To Release Lien Title Description
terms.definition: The Title of the person who is authorized to release lien. This field is use, for example, on the Arkansas Mortgage.
When true, indicates the Purchase Money Transaction check box on the Texas security instrument should be checked.

terms.term: Security Instrument Real Property Improved Or To Be Improved Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates the Real Property Is Improved Or To Be Improved check box on the New York Mortgage should be checked.

terms.term: Security Instrument Real Property Improvements Not Covered Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates the Real Property Improvements Not Covered check box on the New York Mortgage should be checked.

terms.term: Security Instrument Recording Requested By Name
terms.definition: The name of the person requesting the recording of the security instrument.

terms.term: Security Instrument Renewal And Extension Of Liens Against Homestead Property Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates on the Texas security Instrument that the Note is in renewal and extension.
Adds additional provisions to the security instrument.
Specifies the type of rider referenced on the Security Instrument.

terms.term: Security Instrument Rider Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Security Instrument Rider Type.
Rider that modifies terms of security instrument to provide for assignments to the MERS registry.

terms.term: Security Instrument Signer For Registers Office Name
terms.definition: The name of the person who is authorized to sign for the office recorder. This field is used, for example, on the North Carolina Deed of Trust.

terms.term: Security Instrument Tax Serial Number Identifier
terms.definition: The identifier of Tax Serial Number for the Utah security instrument.
The trustee fee expressed as a percentage of the gross sale price and attorney's fees.
The description of the Vendors Lien as it appears on the Texas security instrument.
When true, indicates the Vendors Lien check box on the Texas security instrument should be checked.
The description of how title is held on the security instrument.
The interest of a creditor in the security collateralizing an investment.

Reflects the quality of a private issue mortgage-backed security (MBS). The security rating gives an investor some idea of the likelihood that the mortgage comprising the pool of a private issue MBS will repay. Security ratings range from triple A (highest quality) to triple B (lowest quality).
A collection of values that describe the type or level of monitoring of a security system that is installed in a home.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for the Security System Type.
The date that the security will be delivered to the designated book entry account.
The securities trading account identifier assigned to a customer by an investor.
A portion of 100 that represents the dollar amount of variance between the reported (actual) and the scheduled (expected) UPB.
Funds required to start a development project, generally advanced by a developer or equity owner as a capital contribution to the project. Also called "front-end money" or "front money."
Process of determining the loan product that the Borrower(s) wish to apply for, and the interest rate, discount, and fees associated with the loan.
Process of determining the method of underwriting (automated or manual).

When true, indicates that the Credit Score Value is the recommended value chosen from a collection of credit scores for a single borrower or guarantor, based on criteria as defined by trading partners. For example, this may be used to identify the middle Credit Score.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the type of service provider that is associated with this fee or payment.

terms.term: Selected Service Provider Nature Of Relationship Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field describing the nature of any relationship between the service provider and the lender. Plain English description of the relationship should be utilized, such as Depositor of the Lender.

terms.term: Selected Service Provider Ownership Interest Percent
terms.definition: A portion of 100 that represents the lender's percentage of ownership interest in the selected service provider organization.
A classification of the collection of loan parameters to support borrower shopping for loan products or proposed loan products that would suit the current borrower needs.

When true, indicates that the individual is self-reporting as having served, or is currently serving in the US Armed Forces. Includes enlisted persons that may not have served in “Active Duty” status, and service in the National Guard or Reserves. Also includes “surviving spouses” of Veterans who served and were Missing In Action (MIA) /Killed In Action (KIA), who died of a condition or impairment connected to their service in the Armed Forces (as determined by VA or DoD), or who self-report that their spouse’s service and connected disability/impairment entitles them to benefits from the VA.
A person who owns at least 25% of the entity which generates income for that person.

Payment by the seller or any other interested party of some or all of the purchaser's usual closing costs. Investors and insurers sometimes limit the amount of seller contribution and require lenders to adjust the property's value if contributions exceed limitations. Undisclosed seller contributions (such as decorating allowances, appliances or payment of moving expenses) are made to borrowers outside of closing and are also subject to investor and insurer restrictions.
Indicates that the property seller is the owner of public record for the subject property.

terms.term: Seller Lead Hazard Disclosure And Acknowledgment
terms.definition: A document which discloses to buyers known lead-based paint and lead-based paint hazards in the housing and any available reports on lead in the housing.
The date through which MI has been paid by the seller.
The estimated closing costs amount that the seller of the subject property will pay.

terms.term: Seller Paid FHA VA Closing Costs Percent
terms.definition: The percentage of estimated closing costs that will be paid by the seller of the subject property, including any seller prepaids, but excluding discount points.
Date seller acquired the property as documented on the Title Report.
A term used by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac for a mortgage banker or other entity that has met the requirements necessary to sell and service mortgages for Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac.

The process of establishing a relationship with borrowers through written or electronic communication. This may include welcome letters, payment coupons and other information regarding loan activities per RESPA regulations.

terms.term: Send Reconveyance or Lien Release to Recorder
terms.definition: The process in which the Servicer or Borrower sends the Reconveyance to the Recorder, so that the release of lien or transfer of title can be recorded.
A first mortgage.

Allows producers and consumers of XML instance documents that are valid MISMO V3 documents to mark any data point to be treated as sensitive. MISMO recommends that any use of a data point labeled as "Sensitive Information" in the LDD ALWAYS have this attribute set to "true".
A method of valuation of the rate of return on an investment with changes in a single factor.
The process of analyzing a large volume of text to determine whether it expresses a positive sentiment, a negative sentiment, or a neutral sentiment. Also referred to as "Opinion Analysis".
When true, indicates that the unit has a separate address from other unit(s) on the property.

terms.term: Separated From Military Service Due To Disability Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates veteran was discharged, retired or separated from military service due to a disability.
An integer value used to provide an order to multi-instance sibling elements. The value must be unique for each sibling element.
A court-related action by which rental income derived from property is ordered by the court to be deposited with and held by the clerk of the court or other governmental/court official.
Optional delivery contracts with different expiration dates, but identical underlying contracts.
The actual date of completion of the product/service being fulfilled.
The actual price of the product/service being fulfilled.
The price that the service provider charged for the cancellation of the order.
The estimated date of completion of the product/service being fulfilled.
The estimated date that resolution to the current issue/problem will be resolved.
The estimated price of the product/service being fulfilled.
Specifies the date and time of the designated Service Event State Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the stage at which the service event is taking place.

terms.term: Service Event State Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Service Event State Type.
When true, indicates the requested service is must be completed as soon as possible.
The date by which the requested service is needed.
An alphanumeric designation assigned to the account that payment will be processed from. For credit card transactions this is the account number imprinted on the credit card.
The total amount of payment being tendered.

terms.term: Service Payment Credit Account Expiration Date
terms.definition: For credit card transactions this is the credit card expiration date imprinted on the credit card.
This enumerated attribute identifies the type of credit card or other payment method.

terms.term: Service Payment Credit Method Type Other Description
terms.definition: When Service Payment Method Type is set to Other, enter the description in this data attribute.
A description of the method of funds transfer to be used for the transaction.

terms.term: Service Payment Method Type Other Description
terms.definition: A description of the type of payment when Other is selected from the enumerated list.
An alphanumeric designation assigned to the prepaid account to be debited for the payment.

terms.term: Service Payment On Account Maximum Debit Amount
terms.definition: The maximum dollar amount that can be debited from the prepaid account on any single transaction.

terms.term: Service Payment On Account Minimum Balance Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount at which the system should send a message that the prepaid account needs to be replenished. It may also trigger the system to discontinue processing documents until more funds are added to the account.
A unique identifier assigned to each payment transaction for tracking and auditing purposes.

terms.term: Service Payment Secondary Credit Account Identifier
terms.definition: For credit card transactions this is an additional identifier that appears on the credit card in various locations depending on the Credit Card Type.
A descriptive name for the product type, such as: Lenders Policy.
A unique identifier that correlates to a specific request product type.

terms.term: Service Product Name Add On Description
terms.definition: A brief description of the service or product option being added to a primary service or product.

terms.term: Service Product Name Add On Identifier
terms.definition: Some unique identifier that correlates to a specific sub-part of the product; usually a number.
A descriptive name for the response product, such as: Super Eagle.
A unique identifier that correlates to a specific product name; usually a number.
The date the written service provider list disclosure was given to the customer.

For the request/response of products that contain a range of dates it is needed to identify the date range that that product delivery satisfies. This element identifies the start of the period being identified.

For the request/response of products that contain a range of dates it is needed to identify the date range that that product delivery satisfies. This element identifies the end of the period being identified.
The date and time when the request was generated for submission.
A unique identifier of the reason for submitting a request.
The date and time that a request submission was received.
The date that the service requestor would like the execution of the service to be completed and the results of the service provided.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the state of the service request.
A free-form text field for ad hoc instructions that are provided to the fulfilling vendor, usually by the third party management company facilitating the order.
The date and time that a response was provided.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the type of service being defined under the SERVICE element.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Service Type.

The party that owns the mortgage servicing rights for the loan and is responsible for the collection of all funds due from the borrower to satisfy the terms of the related note. Includes all borrower contact, management of escrow and custodial accounts, and may include default related activities.
Identifies the servicer's plan of the varying loan payment and/or rate change characteristics.

terms.term: Servicer Attested Last Trial Payment Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that the final trial payment has been received and all the updates for the official modification have been made.
When true, indicates that the servicer attests that the program guidelines for a modification have been followed.

terms.term: Servicer Days Of The Week Description
terms.definition: The normal business days of the week to contact Servicer with inquiries, as reflected on the Notice Of Assignment, Sale, Or Transfer Of Servicing Rights document.
The description of the party to contact with servicing related questions, as reflected on the Notice Of Assignment, Sale, Or Transfer Of Servicing Rights document.

terms.term: Servicer Hours Of The Day Description
terms.definition: The normal business hours to contact Servicer with inquiries, as reflected on the Notice Of Assignment, Sale, Or Transfer Of Servicing Rights document.
The telephone number related to the description of the party to contact with servicing related questions, as reflected on the Notice Of Assignment, Sale, Or Transfer Of Servicing Rights document.

terms.term: Servicer Loss Mitigation Software Platform Name
terms.definition: The name of the servicer loss mitigation software platform being utilized for a workout evaluation request submission.

terms.term: Servicer Loss Mitigation Software Platform Version Identifier
terms.definition: A unique identifier of the loss mitigation software platform used by the servicer for a workout evaluation.
The date on which the servicer's officer has signed off on the modification agreement.
The date that the current Servicer will stop accepting payments from the borrower for the mortgage loan, as reflected on the Notice Of Assignment, Sale, Or Transfer Of Servicing Rights document.
The date that the new Servicer will start accepting payments from the borrower for the mortgage loan, as reflected on the Notice Of Assignment, Sale, Or Transfer Of Servicing Rights document.
A unique identifier of the program in which the servicer is eligible to participate. The party assigning the identifier can be provided using the IdentifierOwnerURI.
The date on which the servicer role type became active.
Specifies a type of Servicer.
When Other is specified in Servicer Type, this data element contains the description.
The date of the welcome call to the borrower for a servicing transfer was performed.

A mortgage banking function which includes the receipt of payments, customer service, escrow administration, investor accounting, and may include default related activities. Also called Loan Administration.
A written agreement between an investor and mortgage servicer stipulating the rights and obligations of each party.
The date and time of the servicing comment.
A system specific string indicating the source of the servicing comment.
The text of the servicing comment.
Indicates the type of servicing comment.
A free-form text field used to capture the Servicing Comment Type when Other is selected.
When true indicates that the communication is about the borrower's dissatisfaction with the Servicer or other entity related to their mortgage.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the source of the comment.

Informs the borrower that the right to collect their mortgage loan payments may be transferred, and they have certain rights under federal law. Required by RESPA / Regulation X. AKA: Notice to Mortgage Loan Applicants.
The minimum service fee rate, expressed as a percent, to be earned by the servicer.
The fee earned by a servicer for administering a loan for an investor usually expressed as a percentage of the unpaid principal balance of the loan and deducted from the monthly mortgage payment.
See WORKING FILES.
Fees which the mortgage servicer earns for performing loan administration duties.

The price, expressed as a rate, paid for the right to service the loan and receive its servicing compensation. The rate is applied to the unpaid principal balance of the loan (UPB) to determine the dollar price.
A stipulation in the agreement for the sale of mortgages in which the seller is not responsible for loan administration.
The amount accepted for the servicing REO sale of a property.

terms.term: Servicing REO Cumulative Loss Passed To Security Amount
terms.definition: The loss amount passed through to the security to date, including but not limited to any forgiven principal, as a result of a modification.
The date that the servicer exited the REO process on the property associated with the loan.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that identifies the reason that the REO process is concluded as of the status date.

terms.term: Servicing REO Exit Reason Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Servicing REO Exit Reason Type.

terms.term: Servicing REO Gross Liquidation Proceeds Amount
terms.definition: The gross amount due to the property seller after a servicing REO sale has closed, as reported on a settlement statement.
The total amount of REO management fees (including auction fees) paid over the life of the loan.

terms.term: Servicing REO Net Sales Proceeds Amount
terms.definition: The net proceeds amount received from the closing (before servicer reimbursement) of a servicing REO property sale.

terms.term: Servicing REO Offer Acceptance Condition Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field describing the terms under which the servicer accepted an offer to purchase an REO property.
The date when a servicer accepted an offer to buy a servicing REO property.
The expiration date of an accepted offer establishing a deadline on the closing on a servicing REO property sale.

terms.term: Servicing REO Reporting Period Loss Passed To Security Amount
terms.definition: The cumulative loss amount passed through to the security during the reporting period, including subsequent loss adjustments and any forgiven principal as a result of a modification.

terms.term: Servicing REO Servicing Fees Claimed Amount
terms.definition: The amount of accrued servicing fees claimed at time of servicer reimbursement in the course of liquidation.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that identifies that the REO proceedings are active or closed as of the status date.

terms.term: Servicing REO Status Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Servicing REO Status Type.
The amount recovered during the current reporting period from the borrower or a third party associated with a servicing REO property after the initial loss has been reported.
The amount of the actual unpaid principal balance (UPB) at the time of REO Sale.
A stipulation in the agreement for the sale of mortgages in which the seller is responsible for loan administration and is paid a fee for doing so.
See MORTGAGE SERVICING RIGHTS.
Reduction of principal in a loan portfolio due to monthly payments, payoffs and foreclosures which reduce the value of the portfolio.
That portion of the interest rate added by the lender to cover the cost of administering the mortgage asset.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies specialized servicing action to be taken or restricted regarding the servicing of an account.

terms.term: Servicing Stop Action Type Additional Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to provide a supplemental comment or remark regarding the Servicing Stop Action Type.

terms.term: Servicing Stop Action Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to capture the Servicing Stop Action Type if Other is selected.
An enumerated or coded value defined by a source for use by a servicer to identify a servicing stop.
A free-form text field used to capture details regarding the Servicing Stop Code.
The date a servicing stop becomes effective on an account.
The date a servicing stop should be removed from an account.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies a loan condition that triggers a stop code action on the account.

terms.term: Servicing Stop Reason Type Additional Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to provide a supplemental comment or remark regarding the Servicing Stop Reason Type.

terms.term: Servicing Stop Reason Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to capture the Servicing Stop Reason Type if Other is selected.
The dollar amount of the scheduled unpaid principal balance as of the termination date of the servicing agreement.

Broadly covers the transfers of servicing responsibilities, and in some cases the transfers of servicing rights, in total or in part, through a subservicing or a whole loan servicing arrangement. This transfer of servicing loan data and all historical loan information is transferred from the transferor servicer to the transferee servicer. Impacted parties are notified through items such as goodbye and welcome letters to borrowers. Each servicing transfer is commonly conducted as a one-time event. 'Servicing Transfer' may also be referred to as 'Transfer of Servicing.'
The date at which the transfer of servicing is effective as reflected on the Notice Of Assignment, Sale, Or Transfer of Servicing Rights document.
The event of executing a contract between a transferor and transferee to convey loan servicing rights. Prior investor approval must be obtained.
When true, indicates that the transfer of servicing is prohibited during life of the loan or for a designated period of time or until a certain event or condition is satisfied.
The role of this servicer in a servicing transfer transaction.
Informs the borrower that the servicing of their loan is being transferred. Required by RESPA / Regulation X. AKA: Notice of Transfer of Servicing, Hello/Goodbye Letter.
Defines whether the servicing on the loan will be retained or transferred to another party. Typically only on closed loans.
If true, indicates the servicing transferor does not wish to remain an active servicer with the investor.
The number of minutes spent with an client or borrower in a counseling session.
Process in which the Lender sets interest rates based on market conditions, business strategy, and investor demand.

Lines that define the required distances for the location of a structure in relation to the perimeter of the property. They are in accordance with building codes, deed restrictions and zoning requirements.
The closing of a mortgage loan. Also, the delivery of a loan or security to a buyer.
A person or entity which coordinates or conducts a closing or settlement.
The total dollar amount estimated or paid as settlement charges for this loan product.
Money paid by borrowers and sellers to effect the closing of a mortgage loan, including payments for title insurance, survey, attorney fees and such prepaid items as taxes and insurance escrow.

Describes the funds that are payable at closing. Items that appear on the statement include real estate commissions, loan fees, points, and initial escrow amounts. Required by RESPA/Regulation X. In most cases the Settlement Statement is superseded by the CFPB Closing Disclosure.
The process of establishing a loan record on a servicing system when it is received from an originator (new loan) or another servicer (seasoned loan).
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents a type of sewer system. Also used in conjunction with a type of utility ownership.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Sewer System Type.
Single Family Default Monitoring System

Identifies the insuring section and the applicable HUD insurance fund; identifies an assistance payment contract; identifies where the lender has the option under its contract of mortgage ins to receive benefits in default. (Reference HUD SFDMS Guide)
The maximum dollar amount that may be claimed as a share of the increase in value of the property.
Indicates the loan is one in which the lender, in exchange for a loan with a favorable interest rate, participates in the profits (if any) the borrower receives when the property is eventually sold.
A mortgage in which the lender offers the borrower a below-market interest rate in exchange for a portion of the profit upon eventual sale of the property.
The percentage of the increase in property value that accrues when the appreciation is shared.
The portion of the down payment paid by a third party as part of a shared equity agreement.

Indicates the mortgage is for resale-restricted, owner-occupied housing in which the rights, responsibilities, and benefits of residential property ownership are shared between individual homeowners and another party.
The prompt to display for a question used to verify identity.
The expected response for a question used to verify identify.
An agreement whereby the developer or landowner builds the walls, roof and floor of a building, then gives tenants a cash allowance to complete the interior.
A deed given by court order when a property is sold to satisfy a judgment or tax lien.
In the sale or securitization of mortgage loans, the preparation and delivery of documents for loans sold to investors.
Owning commitments in excess of mortgages in the pipeline.
A method of calculating the amount of premium refunded on a hazard insurance policy cancelled between anniversary dates.
The dollar difference between mandatory commitments and inventory loans divided by pipeline dollar volumes adjusted for fallout.
A workout program wherein the lender accepts less than the total payoff amount.
An agreement between the investor of a loan and the borrower to enter into a short sale on a property.
Describes type of short sale related to a property.

terms.term: Short Sale Offering Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Short Sale Offering Type.
A list of actions and associated dates to be followed during a short sale process.
When true, indicates the signatory attests he/she has the authority to sign.

An authorized representative who is required to sign documents on behalf of the legal entity. To be used in conjunction with Required Signatory Count. If the rule varies per document, this information must be provided under DOCUMENT/DEAL_SETS.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the signature authority for executing loan documents on behalf of a borrower.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when 'Other' is selected for SignatureAuthorityType.
Specifies whether the signature field is for a full signature or for an initials mark.

Specifies whether the signature is required or optional. A value of true indicates that the signature must be executed in order for the document to be considered fully executed. A value of false indicates that the signature is optional and does not need to be executed in certain circumstances.
Denotes whether the foreign system signature is required or not.
Contains the signature type proposed by the document creator. The actual type of the signature applied to the signature field may be different (please see audit trail).
Contains a description of the signature type when the value of Other is used for the SignatureType.

terms.term: Signed Authorization To Request Tax Records Indicator
terms.definition: Indicates that the IRS form (4506 or 4506T) that gives the lender the authority to request copies of tax records is present.
When true, indicates that a legal entity (e.g., Trust, LLC) is a party in the loan closing event which will require specific signing instructions for representing that legal entity.
A free-form alphanumeric string which contains specific directions on how a signing entity signature must be executed (e.g., Trustee, Managing Member) by Document.
One who invests in a business but does not participate in the operation of the enterprise and may be anonymous, except to the other partners.

A system of mortgage accounting under which a servicer reports currently paid installments as a single item. The only other items detailed are uncollected installments and collections of anything other than current monthly installments.

terms.term: Single Entity Greatest Number Of Shares Count
terms.definition: The greatest number of shares owned by a single entity in the cooperative project.

terms.term: Single Entity Greatest Number Of Units Count
terms.definition: The greatest number of units owned by a single entity in the condominium project.
A design where all apartment units are placed on only one side of a corridor.
An accounting method servicers use in conducting an escrow account analysis by computing the sufficiency of escrow account funds by considering each escrow item separately.
In commercial real estate, funds regularly set aside for the replacement of improvements.
Indicates that there adverse site conditions or external factors.
When true, indicates that the site has defect(s), damage(s) or deficienc(ies).
All improvements made to a site, such as clearing, grading and the installation of public utilities, before the actual construction of a building.
A free-form text field used to describe the dimensions of the site such as its width and depth.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the drainage reason that may impact the property.

terms.term: Site Drainage Reason Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Site Drainage Reason Type.
The dollar value estimated for the property site (e.g., land that is improved so that it is ready to be used for a specific purpose).
A free-form text field used to further describe the estimated value provided in Site Estimated Value Amount.
A free-form text field describing the site feature and/or its impact on the value and marketability of the property.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents a given characteristic associated with the site.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Site Feature Type.
Specifies a use, other than the present use, that would constitute a higher and best use of the site.
When true, indicates that the present use or the proposed use is the highest and best of the site.

terms.term: Site Improvement As Is Cost Amount
terms.definition: The "As Is" dollar amount of the site improvement as of the appraisal report effective date.
A free-form text field describing the improvement for which the "As Is" value is provided.
A free-form text field used to describe factors affecting the site.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents proximity of the site influence to the property.
Specifies a type of condition that affects the property.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Site Influence Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list which represents the overall rating of the differences between the comparable and the subject for all types of site influences.

terms.term: Site Other Improvements As Is Amount
terms.definition: The dollar value contributed by other "as is" improvements located on the subject property.
A drawing which shows all improvements to a site, such as clearing, grading and the installation of public utilities, before the actual construction of a building.
A free-form text field used to describe the shape of the site.

terms.term: Site Size Shape Topography Acceptable Indicator
terms.definition: Indicates the site size, shape, and topography are generally conforming to and acceptable to the market area.

terms.term: Site Size Shape Topography Not Acceptable Description
terms.definition: A description of how the site size, shape and topography do not conform to what is acceptable in the market area.
A free-form text field used to describe the topography of the site.
Indicates if the site has underground electrical and/or telephone cables.

terms.term: Site Utility Alternative Energy Source Type
terms.definition: A collection of values that specify the alternative energy source that is used by a utility.

terms.term: Site Utility Alternative Energy Source Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for the Site Utility Alternative Energy Source Type.
A free-form text field describing the utility and/or its impact on the value and marketability of the property.

terms.term: Site Utility Non Public Ownership Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe the ownership of the utility when Non Public is selected for Site Utility Ownership Type.
Describes how the site utilities differ from what is typical from the market area.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies whether the utility is public or non-public.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the method by which the site value is calculated.

terms.term: Site Valuation Method Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Site Valuation Method Type.
The value of land without improvements, as if vacant.
When true, indicates a separate land value will be included in the appraisal report to support the assignment.
A free-form text field used to describe the views from the site.
A free-form text field used to describe the zoning classification of the property site.
Identifies the zoning classification applied to the site.
A free-form text field describing any issues concerning how the site complies with zoning regulations including limitations on future development.

terms.term: Site Zoning Compliance Illegal Reason Type
terms.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the reason that the site does not comply with zoning regulations.

terms.term: Site Zoning Compliance Illegal Reason Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Site Zoning Compliance Illegal Reason Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the level of compliance of the site to zoning regulations.
When true, indicates that a sketch and/or floor plan has been provided.
Specifies the action to be taken when a skip payment feature is exercised.

terms.term: Skip Payment Action Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Skip Payment Action Type.

terms.term: Skip Payment Initial Restriction Term Months Count
terms.definition: The number of months from origination during which the skip payment feature may not be exercised.
The total number of loan payments that a borrower has skipped since loan origination.
When true, indicates that a non-structural enclosure of a foundation crawl space exists.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the skirting material.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Skirting Material Type.
Lease of air rights, sometimes involving a cantilevered structure or a bridge.
Privately owned companies, licensed and regulated by the Small Business Administration. The SBA provides equity capital and long-term financing.
Securable Manageable Archivable Retrievable Transferable

An electronic document based on a MISMO specification that locks together a document's data, visual presentation, and signatures such that it detects subsequent tampering and can be programmatically validated to guarantee the original document's integrity. This term is also defined in the MERS eRegistry Procedures Manual available at members.mersinc.org.

A section within a MISMO SMART document that can capture the SMART Doc profile, the version number of the software, platform, or specification used to generate the document and the date and time that the document was generated.

An optional section in a SMART Doc that when present, contains entries that show the document's history, including corrections, additions, signings, validation, voiding, and editing of the document, including who edited the document, date and time of the edit, and the system that it was edited on.
The data section in a SMART Doc that captures the document's data and may include additional data or Metadata that is not viewable on the document.
In the MISMO reference model, individual related SMART Docs are grouped together as a document set.

A section of the SMART Doc that contains or points to style sheets for generating or populating document viewable images, based on the data in the Deal Sets, and/or the Signatories data. The MAP data can be used to verify that the data in the target VIEW element matches the data provided in the DEAL_SET and SIGNATORY elements.

The section in the SMART Doc that links data in different sections of the document. For example, a relationship can identify which Signatories are associated with a particular document View or link a Signatory to a party listed in the Deal Sets.

A section in the SMART Doc that contains information regarding the type of signature used to represent a legally binding signature of a specific party named in the document. Other data within this element may contain more detailed data about the signing event, such as its location, date and time as well as information about the notary certificate used in the notarial act that the notary memorializes in the document.

The section of the SMART Doc that represents a "tamper seal" of one or more parts of the document. The "tamper seal" provides a way to detect if a specified data section within the document has been changed since the date and time that the electronic seal was originally created. The SYSTEM_SIGNATURE element uses a security technology called the X.509 digital certificate. See Digital Signature.
The section of a SMART Doc that contains the actual presentation of the document that would appear on screen or on a printed output.
A Securable, Manageable, Archivable, Retrievable, and Transferable document.
Simple Mail Transfer Protocol
The identifier of the party within a social media site. Use the IdentifierOwnerURI attribute value to identify the social media provider.

Confirms that Social Security benefits are payable and the amount received each month. Provided by the Social Security Administration. AKA: Social Security Benefit Letter, Social Security Decision Notice.

terms.term: Society Of Industrial And Office Realtors (SIOR)
terms.definition: A real estate trade organization that serves industrial and office property owners, users and investors.

A professional and educational association for the appraisal profession. SREA confers the following designations: Senior Residential Appraiser (SRA), Senior Real Property Appraiser (SRPA) and Senior Real Estate Analyst (SREA).
Secured Overnight Financing Rate
Architectural, engineering and legal fees associated with building construction, as distinguished from land and other costs.
The amount invested in the development or purchase of a property that is immediately deductible for tax purposes, such as prepaid interest and fees.

terms.term: Solar Panel Array Age Years Count
terms.definition: A numeric value that specifies the age in years of the solar panels in the array.
A free-form text field that describes the angle of horizontal deviation, measured clockwise, of a bearing from a standard direction, as from north or south of the solar panel array.

terms.term: Solar Panel Array Estimated Kilowatt Hours Output Per Year Number
terms.definition: A numeric value that identifies the estimated annual power output produced by the solar panel array measured in kilowatt hours per year.

terms.term: Solar Panel Array Estimated Output Source Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field describing the source or service used to determine the estimated kilowatt hours per year produced by the solar panel array.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that indicates the area of structure or site where the subject solar panel array is located.

terms.term: Solar Panel Array Location Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Solar Panel Array Location Type.
An unstructured name that identifies the company that produced the solar panel.

terms.term: Solar Panel Array Maximum Kilowatt Output Number
terms.definition: A numeric value that identifies the maximum power output of the solar panel array measured in kilowatts.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that classifies the type of ownership of the solar panel on the property.

terms.term: Solar Panel Array Tilt Slope Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that describes the details of the tilt and slope of a solar panel array in context of the location of placement such as a roof.

terms.term: Solar Panel Array Warranty Terms Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field describing information about any warranty terms that may exist on the solar panels in the array.

terms.term: Sold Under HUD Single Family Property Disposition Program Indicator
terms.definition: On the FHA Non Owner Occupancy Rider, this indicates that the Security Instrument applies to Property sold under HUD Single Family Property Disposition Program and meets the requirements thereof.
A form of self-employment in which the individual who is self-employed has formed no separate legal entity such as a corporation.
Indicates whether the borrower wishes to receive Email solicitation from the lender.
Indicates whether the borrower wishes to receive telephone solicitation from the lender.

terms.term: Solicitation By US Mail Allowed Indicator
terms.definition: Indicates whether the borrower wishes to receive US Mail solicitation from the lender.
The date on which the solicitation effort was made.

A document that servicers must send to delinquent borrowers which explains alternatives to foreclosure. AKA Delinquent Notice. Example: Guide Exhibit 1131, Borrower Solicitation Letter, 31 Days Delinquent
Specifies the method used in an attempt to make contact with the right party in a solicitation effort.
A free-form text field used to capture additional information when Other is selected for Solicitation Method Type.
Identifies the type of sound measurement method applied.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents areas mapped as special airport hazard zones at the end of the runway(s) where aircraft accidents are most likely to occur.

terms.term: Special Airport Hazard Zone Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Special Airport Hazard Zone Type.
A governmental subdivision with the power to tax and improve property within its jurisdiction. Also called "special improvement district."
When true, indicates that the borrower is employed by a family member, property seller, real estate agent/broker, or other party to the transaction.
Specifies a unique category of employer which is the source of income for the borrower.

terms.term: Special Borrower Employer Relationship Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Borrower Employer Relationship Type.
When true, indicates that the borrower has a family relationship or business affiliation with the seller of the property.

terms.term: Special Flood Hazard Area Distance Linear Measure
terms.definition: A measurement that specifies the distance in feet of the nearest Special Flood Hazard Area to a particular property.The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Linear Unit Of Measure Type.
Flag that indicates if any portion of the building/mobile home is in an identified Special Flood Hazard Area (SFHA) and that flood insurance is required.
When true, indicates the existence of special tax assessments on the property.
A deed containing a covenant whereby the grantor agrees to protect the grantee against any claims arising during the grantor's period of ownership.
A remedy in a court of equity compelling a defendant to carry out the terms of an agreement or contract.

A dollar amount determined by VA that must be credited against the veteran's indebtedness at completion of foreclosure. Used as the amount to be bid by the lenders at the foreclosure sale and also used in calculation for the lender's claim under the VA guaranty.
Construction of a building without prior rental, lease or sale agreements.
The rate of principal prepayments (foreclosures and payoffs) of a pool of mortgages.
Standards and Procedures for Electronic Records and Signatures.
A method of securing financing for commercial real estate by splitting property into fee and leasehold interests (land and improvements). Each interest is then sold or financed separately.
An option on an option. The right, but not the obligation, to buy an option for a specified premium on a specified date.
Single-family loans solicited on an individual basis, rather than through Realtor referrals.
See CASH MARKET.
Zoning on a lot-by-lot basis, following no prescribed pattern or plan.

When true, indicates that the individual is a surviving spouse of a Veteran who served and was Missing In Action (MIA) /Killed In Action (KIA), a Veteran who died of a condition or impairment connected to his/her service in the Armed Forces (as determined by VA or DoD), or a Veteran whose service connected disability/impairment, they believe, entitles them to benefits from the VA.
The difference between the rate at which money can be borrowed and the rate at which it is loaned. Also, the difference between the ask and bid prices on a security.
Social Security Number
The count of the associations between name and SSN for this individual.
When true, indicates that the Social Security Number has been certified.
The date on which a Social Security Number has been verified as authorized by the Borrower using Form SSA-89.
Measurement over a period of time to establish an average or expected outcome.
A detailed projection of all income and disbursements over a selected period of years, averaged for a single year.
An appraiser who works as an employee for a mortgage company as opposed to the company hiring an independent firm to appraise properties.
See PROGRESS PAYMENT.
Confirms whether the property is located in a flood zone and therefore whether it requires flood insurance. Provided by FEMA. AKA: Flood Cert, FEMA Standard Flood Hazard Determination.
Standard Generalized Markup Language created in 1978 as a markup language used in technical documentation as the precursor to XML.
A central city area and its surrounding suburbs and small jurisdictions.
A usual rate a rating bureau establishes for all companies writing hazard or title insurance policies in a specific area.
Standard Vector Graphics is an alternate view form for XHTML.
A free-form alphanumeric string which contains an additional line of standardized Address information that must be on an additional line in order to be processed correctly by USPS.

terms.term: Standardized Additional Address Line Two Text
terms.definition: A free-form alphanumeric string which contains a second additional line of standardized Address information that must be on a second additional line in order to be processed correctly by USPS.
A free-form alphanumeric string which contains the USPS standardized address with the address number, pre-directional, street name, post-directional, address unit designators and address unit value.

A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies a further level of detail for a street address, for example, Suite or Unit, in a standardized abbreviated form approved by USPS. This list is based on the USPS Publication 28 on Postal Addressing Standards.

terms.term: Standardized Address Unit Designator Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Standardized Address Unit Designator Type. This should be used for new USPS values only.

A value from a MISMO prescribed list that describes text used in a Spanish language Puerto Rican street address that contains an urbanization that is not preceded by the prefix URB, and is expressed as a standardized USPS abbreviation as outlined in USPS publication 28.

terms.term: Standardized PR Urbanization Type Other Description

terms.term: Standardized Rural Highway Contract Route Type Other Description

A value from a MISMO prescribed list that describes text sometimes used in a Spanish language Puerto Rican address, instead of a specific street address, expressed as a standardized USPS abbreviation as outlined in USPS publication 28.

terms.term: Standardized Spanish Address Designator Type Other Description
