terms.term: Standardized Street Suffix Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Standardized Street Suffix Type. This should be used for new USPS values only.

In secondary marketing, a commitment to purchase mortgages with specific terms, understanding that delivery is unlikely. The commitment is issued for a fee paid by the seller to the purchaser. Synonymous with an optional delivery commitment.
An option to sell a specified dollar amount of mortgages or mortgage-backed securities by or on a specified date at a specified price.
A nonrefundable fee a lender pays an investor for a standby commitment.
A loan where no amortization payments are required and the entire loan comes due at maturity. Interest is normally paid at periodic intervals while the loan is outstanding.
The number of residential housing units begun within a stated period of time.
The two-character representation of the US state, US Territory, Canadian Province/Territory, or Military Address abbreviation (for example: AE, AP, AA).
A document issued by a state to identify a resident in lieu of a driver's license. Evidences a person's identity and state identifier.
The name of the US state, US Territory, Canadian Province/Territory, or Military Address.
The state of recordation referenced in the subject recordable document.
The state or province of birth of the individual.

terms.term: State Refinance Program Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for the State Refinance Program Type.

See AGREED AMOUNT.
Describes how the borrower is benefiting from a loan transaction. AKA: Tangible Benefit Letter.
Code values exchanged between business partners relating to the condition of a status message.

Text describing specific details of a status message.
Business name for the value shown in the Status Code data element.
State laws requiring that certain contracts be in writing; including contracts for the sale of real property.
Specifies the details of the step payments feature, including the period during which periodic payments are scheduled to increase.
A lease that provides for decreases in rent at set intervals.

terms.definition: The number of shares associated with the stocks or bonds that the borrower has disclosed (named) as an asset
Confirms legal ownership of stock in a corporation.

A supplemental order submitted with an initial futures trade that will be executed, should the market move to or beyond a specified level. This move limits gains and/or losses on the futures position.
The total number of above grade levels in a low rise, high rise or mid rise building.
An options strategy that involves buying or selling both a put and call on the same security with the same expiration date and same strike price.
A method of depreciation in which an equal amount of depreciation is taken annually over an asset's economic life.
One who purchases property for another to conceal the identity of the real purchaser.
A rate reduction refinance which requires less documentation than a full package mortgage application.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the means of access and exit to and from the property.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Street Access Type.
The official name of a street assigned by a local governing authority.
The directional symbol that represents the sector of a city where a street address is located. Example: E, W, N, S, NE, NW, SE, SW.
The street vector or the direction the street has taken from some arbitrary starting point. Example: E, W, N, S, NE, NW, SE, SW.
The number assigned to a building or land parcel along the street to identify location and ensure accurate mail delivery.
The trailing designator in a street address or the appropriate abbreviation. Example: Drive, Way, Court, Street, etc.
A type of foreclosure proceeding used in some states in which title to the foreclosed property is invested directly in the mortgagee by court decree, without holding a foreclosure sale.
The stated price on a securities contract at which the underlying security may be bought or sold prior to or upon expiration.

A commercial development in which the main thoroughfares are bordered by an almost continuous row or strip of retail stores and allied service establishments. Also, any shopping area that consists of a row of stores.
A security formed by segregating principal from interest to make separate interest only and principal only mortgage-backed securities.
The amount of structural alterations, improvements, and repairs.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the type of structural design when dwellings are connected (e.g. rowhouse, townhouse).
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Structural Design Type.
A free-form text field expanding on the Rating Condition Type.
Specifies the characteristic of the structure being rated. The rating value of the characteristic is specified by Rating Condition Type.

terms.term: Structure Analysis Rating Item Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe the item of the structure being rated if Other is selected as the Structure Analysis Rating Item Type.
A free-form text field used to describe aspects of the structure that add or detract from its appeal.
A measurement that specifies the total interior area of the structure (a.k.a. gross building area (GBA)). The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Area Unit Of Measure Type.
A free-form text field used to describe the general condition of the structure.
A free-form field used to hold additional comments concerning the current status of the construction of the structure.

terms.term: Structure Excluding Vehicle Storage And ADU Finished Area Measure
terms.definition: A measurement that specifies the finished area of the structure, excluding the finished area within the detached garage and the finished area from any accessory dwelling units present in the structure. The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Area Unit Of Measure Type.

terms.term: Structure Excluding Vehicle Storage And ADU Unfinished Area Measure
terms.definition: A measurement that specifies the unfinished area of the structure, excluding the unfinished area within the detached garage and the unfinished area from any accessory dwelling units present in the structure. The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Area Unit Of Measure Type.
Specifies an aspect of the structure that is typical to its neighborhood.
A free-form text field used to describe a structure feature if Other is selected as the Structure Feature Type.
An unique alphanumeric string used to identify and/or differentiate between multiple structures located on the property.
Indicates that the structure has never been occupied since it was completed.

terms.term: Structure Non Continuous Finished Area Measure
terms.definition: A measurement that specifies the total finished area(s) attached to the dwelling that is separate and not accessible from any unit(s) (e.g., a finished office above, below or behind an attached garage that cannot be accessed from within any living unit). The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Area Unit Of Measure Type.
Indicates that the structure is a single-family residence.
A free-form text field used to describe the existence or proposed construction of a structure.

terms.term: Structure Typical To Neighborhood Atypical Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field describing how the structure differs from the typical neighborhood structure.

terms.term: Structure Typical To Neighborhood Exists Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that the aspect specified by Structure Typical To Neighborhood is present in the structure.
A free-form alphanumeric string which contains commentary for the structure.

A measurement that specifies the total volume of the structure, including finished and unfinished areas, including ADUs. The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Volume Unit Of Measure Type.
A free-form text field used to provide the data definition when a Supporting Record Type of 'ServicingFile:ServicerStructuredData' or 'ServicingFile:ThirdPartyStructuredData' is selected.
The right to ownership of everything beneath the surface of the earth, such as oil and minerals.
A person or company contracted to perform work for a developer or general contractor.
Improved or unimproved land divided into a number of parcels for sale, lease financing or development.
When true, indicates that the project building containing the subject property is complete.
Indicates whether the subject property has prior sales history.
Indicates whether the liability will be re-subordinated to the subject loan after closing.

terms.term: Subject Property Amenities Defects Exist Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that at least one of the amenities associated with the property has defect(s), damage(s) or deficienc(ies).

terms.term: Subject Property Net Cash Flow Amount
terms.definition: The positive or negative amount of the existing or proposed cash flow on the subject property where the property is an investment.

terms.term: Subject To Completion Feature Comparison Type
terms.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the comparison of the materials and workmanship to the original plans and specifications.
A free-form text field describing the property feature that was subject to completion in the original appraisal.

terms.term: Subject To Completion Feature Incomplete Or Inconsistent Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe or comment on the construction that is incomplete or inconsistent as compared to the original plans and specifications.

terms.term: Subject To Completion Feature Location Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to describe or comment on the location of the property feature that was subject to completion in the original appraisal.
A mortgage clause in which title to a mortgaged property is taken without assuming personal liability for the mortgage debt.
A lease executed by a lessee to a third person for a term no longer than the remaining portion of the original lease.

A document issued by the Uniform Collateral Data Portal (UCDP) that summarizes the appraisal submission details, the status of the submission, and the Document File Identifier (Doc File ID) Loans delivered to Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac must have an appraisal with a ""Successful"" status in the UCDP prior to loan delivery.

Process of electronically submitting the Appraisal to the Investor or Insurer Portal, reviewing findings, and taking corrective action as needed based on Investor/Insurer requirements and Lender policies.

terms.term: Submit Documentation for VA Full File Loan Review
terms.definition: Process in which the Lender submits required documentation (Loan Review file, UCD and ULAD) for the VA Full File Loan Review (FFLR), using the VA Loan Review API.
The process of submitting the HMDA Loan Application Register (LAR) to the CFPB
Identifies the ordering of multiple submitting parties.

The identifier created and used by the submitting party to track a transaction or associated interactions. The identifier is expected to be returned in the submitting party's transaction identifier attribute.
The use of one mortgage as collateral to obtain another.
When true indicates that subordinate financing is being created simultaneously with the subject loan.
A lien or encumbrance (for example a second mortgage or mechanic's lien) on real estate whose priority is inferior to another's recorded interest in the same property.
The aggregate payment amount permitted to be made to subordinate lien holders in exchange for lien releases.
When true, indicates that the subordinate lien holders have accepted the offered amount and will release the lien.
A lease in which rights of the lessor of the ground are junior to the rights of the holder of the first mortgage.

The act of a party acknowledging, by written record, that a debt is inferior to the interest of another in the same property. Subordination may apply not only to mortgages, but to leases, real estate rights and any other types of debt instruments.
A clause in a lease by which the tenant acknowledges that its interest in the lease premises is inferior to the interest of the lender whose mortgage encumbers the leased premises.

A document by which parties acknowledge, by written record, that the debt of one is inferior to the debt or interest of another in the same property. Subordination may apply not only to mortgages, but to leases, real estate rights and any other types of debt interests.
The right of a party to proceed against another for recovery.
One of three major players involved in SISAC, subscribers hold and use the credentials for electronic signatures.
Lender that performs the on-going servicing activities for the mortgage or pool under an agreement with the contractually responsible servicer.

The Participant named on the MERS eRegistry that is authorized by the Master Servicer to perform certain MERS eRegistry transactions on the Master Servicer's behalf. This term is also defined in the MERS eRegistry Procedures Manual available at members.mersinc.org.
Specifies the servicing rights that a subservicer holds.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected as the Subservicer Rights Type.

A term for aid. Federally subsidized mortgages typically have an interest rate lower than market because of government assistance. Temporary buydowns are considered subsidized mortgages, because there is money placed in an escrow fund to supplement the regular payment for a certain period of time.
Establishes that the borrower will set up a subsidy account to supplement the mortgage payment.
A hedging strategy involving the sale of futures, offset by the purchase of an equivalent security before delivery is necessary. An alternative to a forward sale.
The assumption of liability by another on a mortgage or trust deed note, with the concurrent release of the original maker by the mortgagee.
Names a successor trustee. AKA: Appointment of Successor Trustee.

terms.term: Successor In Interest Legal Ownership In Property Effective Date
terms.definition: The date that the ownership in the subject property was effective for the specified successor in interest.

terms.term: Successor In Interest Ownership Aquisition Reason Type
terms.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the reason the successor in interest has acquired ownership rights to the property.

terms.term: Successor In Interest Ownership Aquisition Reason Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is used for SuccessorInInterestOwnershipAcquisitionReasonType.
The date associated with the specified SuccessorInInterestStatusType.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the status of the successor in interest.

terms.term: Successor In Interest Status Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is used for SuccessorInInterestStatusType.
The name suffix of the individual represented by the parent object. (E.g., JR = Junior, SR = Senior, etc.)
The summary amount expressed in dollars.
Identifies the type of summary amount.
A free-form text field used to capture the payment frequency type if Other is selected as the Summary Type.
Percentage of the loan amount contributed by all interested parties. This may be captured on the Uniform Underwriting Transmittal Summary (1008/1077).

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Borrower Incentive Curtailment Amount
terms.definition: The amount of any Borrower incentive payments applied to the unpaid principal balance of the Mortgage during the accounting cycle.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Deferred Principal Curtailment Amount
terms.definition: The amount of any curtailment applied to the deferred UPB during the accounting cycle.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Deferred UPB Amount
terms.definition: For mortgages with a partial principal forbearance, the amount of the deferred (non-interest bearing) unpaid principal balance as of the accounting cycle cutoff.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Escrow Payment Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount of all payments by the borrower being reported in the Loan Monetary Event Summary applied to the escrow balance.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Gross Interest Amount
terms.definition: The portion of all payments being reported in the Loan Monetary Event Summary allocated to interest based upon the current loan interest rate.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Gross Principal Amount
terms.definition: The portion of all payments being reported in the Loan Monetary Event Summary that is applied to principal.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Interest Bearing UPB Amount
terms.definition: For mortgages with a partial principal forbearance, the amount of the interest-bearing unpaid principal balance as of the accounting cycle cutoff.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Interest Paid Through Date
terms.definition: The date through which interest is paid with the final activity being reported in the Loan Monetary Event Summary. This is the effective date from which interest will be calculated for the application of the next payment. (For example, used for Daily Simple Interest loans.)

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Investor Special Handling Description
terms.definition: Investor specific instructions associated with the Loan Monetary Event Summary.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Last Paid Installment Applied Date
terms.definition: The date that the final activity being reported in the Loan Monetary Event Summary was actually applied.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Last Paid Installment Due Date
terms.definition: The due date of last paid installment (DDLPI) being included in the summary reporting.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Net Interest Amount
terms.definition: The portion of the Summary Loan Monetary Event Gross Interest Amount due to the Investor.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Net Principal Amount
terms.definition: The portion of the Summary Loan Monetary Event Gross Principal Amount due to the Investor.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Optional Products Payment Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount of all payments made by the borrower that are being reported in the Loan Monetary Event Summary applied to optional product features.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Event Scheduled UPB Amount
terms.definition: The current unpaid principal balance on the loan, based on an agreed upon schedule.
The dollar amount of the unpaid principal balance on the loan after applying the last monetary event for the reporting period.
The total remittance amount being reported to the Investor by the Servicer for this summary monetary event.

terms.term: Summary Monetary Investor Remittance Effective Date
terms.definition: The date the investor should draft the remittance from the lenders bank account for this summary monetary event. This is typically the day after the remittance is reported to the investor.
A government lien imposed on a property for violation of environmental and public health and safety rules.

A lien or encumbrance on property that is superior to most every other claim against the same property irrespective of the time of recording or claiming the lien or encumbrance (usually arising in the context of liens for remediating hazardous waste).

A shopping center that provides an extensive variety of general merchandise. Usually built around at least three department stores of at least 100,000 square feet each. A super-regional usually contains about 750,000 square feet of gross leasable area, but may exceed 1,000,000 square feet.

The term "Superfund" is frequently used to refer to the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation and Liability Act (CERCLA), enacted in 1980, and modified by the Superfund Amendments and Reauthorization Act (SARA) in 1986. Under this federal statutory framework, the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is empowered to determine which locations are contaminated by hazardous waste, respond appropriately to protect public health and the environment and allocate liability for associated response costs.
A lien or encumbrance (for example a mortgage or mechanic's lien) on real estate whose priority is greater (or superior) to the interest of another's interest in the same property.
That part of a building or structure above the ground or foundation.

A machine learning technique that uses labeled datasets to train algorithms to predict outcomes and recognize patterns. In Supervised Learning, the machine learning process is done under the observation of labeled variables.
Indicates the date the supervisor signed the report.
Collects information on borrower homeownership education, housing counseling and language preference to better understand the needs of borrowers during the home buying process.
Identifies another lower-level private or public sector agency under whose guidelines the mortgage is originated.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information or a description of the Supplemental Mortgage Type when Other is selected.
Processes that are done in support of normal operations but are outside of the loan lifecycle.
The date that the supporting record was created.
When true, indicates that the supporting record contains the details of the consumer's original communication and may include consumer supplied documentation.

The ending date of the period of time represented by the data in the supporting record. This date may or may not be included on the supporting record. For example a payment history covering a stated period of time may not show that date if no payment was made.
The unique alphanumeric string identifying a supporting record as assigned by the party creating the record.

terms.term: Supporting Record Not Provided To Borrower Indicator
terms.definition: When true indicates that a supporting record was not provided to the borrower since it contains information that is confidential, proprietary or privileged and cannot be disclosed. The supporting record might be disclosed to a regulator under certain circumstances.
A free-form alphanumeric string which contains a description of the analysis of the supporting record and the conclusion(s) drawn from that analysis.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the intended use of a supporting record set.

terms.term: Supporting Record Set Purpose Type Additional Description
terms.definition: A free-form alphanumeric string which contains a supplemental comment or remark regarding the Supporting Record Set Purpose Type.

terms.term: Supporting Record Set Purpose Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to capture the enumeration when Other is selected for Supporting Record Set Purpose Type.

The beginning date of the period of time represented by the data in the supporting record. This date may or may not be included on the supporting record. For example a payment history covering a stated period of time may not show that date if no payment was made.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that classifies the human perceivable presentation of an electronic record used to provide evidence.
A free-form text field used to provide a supplemental comment or remark regarding the Supporting Record Type.
A free-form text field used to capture the enumeration when Other is selected for Supporting Record Type.
Written evidence of a third party, called the surety, that will be primarily liable for a debt in the case of default.
A measurement of land, prepared by a registered land surveyor, showing the location of the land with reference to known points, its dimensions and the location and dimensions of any improvements.
Confirms that no encroachments have been built since the preceding survey. Provided by the borrower.
A formal statement, signed, certified and dated by a surveyor, giving the pertinent facts about a particular property and any easements or encroachments affecting it.
Unapplied funds balance, excluding loans in bankruptcy (overpayments, underpayments, repayment plan funds, gov funds i.e., 235, alien funds, etc.).
Provides an arithmetic total of the Suspense Balance Amount data items within the Loan container in this data set.
When true, indicates that the household received assistance from the counselor to create a sustainable budget through financial management services.
The exchange of one asset or liability for a similar asset or liability to lengthen or shorten maturities, raise or lower coupon rates or exchange fixed and variable payment streams.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents a feature of the swimming pool.

terms.term: Swimming Pool Feature Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Swimming Pool Feature Type.
The sale of equity interests in real estate projects to investors other than the original developer.
Information that has been generated on a computer to augment or replace real data to improve artificial intelligence models, protect sensitive data, and mitigate bias.
Combining a short position with a call position. In mortgage banking, selling mortgages forward while simultaneously buying call options.

Authoritative system recognized to establish the identity of the Controller of a registered eNote and the Location of the Authoritative Copy of the eNote. This term is also defined in the MERS? eRegistry Procedures Manual available at members.mersinc.org.
When true indicates that the system specified is a permanent, attached system otherwise it is portable.
Means the person or persons responsible for operating one or more of the systems being utilized with respect to a particular real estate mortgage loan transaction
Mortgage transaction where the broker or third-party originator (TPO) closes the mortgage in its own name for simultaneous assignment to an investor who advanced money for the funding.
Tagged Image File Format.
A borrower's paycheck after taxes and other deductions have been subtracted.
Process in which the Lender engages with approved counterparties to obtain investor commitments to purchase individual or pools of loans, pursuant to applicable commitment types.
Process of establishing either a best efforts or Mortgage Backed Security (MBS) contract between the Lender and an Investor for a specific Issue Date.
See CONSTRUCTION LOAN DRAW.
A commitment by a lender to provide a long-term mortgage upon satisfactory completion of construction.
A first mortgage loan that is committed and expected to be made upon completion of a specified real estate project.

Tamper-Evidencing is a method used in conjunction with Digital Signatures that can determine if a specific section of an Electronic Record has been modified. Evidence of tampering is determined by comparing the Hash Value created for the Digital Signature and a recalculation, at a later time, of the Hash Value from the Electronic Record. See the MISMO XML Digital Signature guide (http://www.mismo.org/files/ImplementationGuidelines/XMLDigitalSignatureI- Guide.pdf).

A "seal" wrapping an Electronic Record that is created by a Digital Signature. The seal can be verified to ensure that no changes have been made to the Electronic Record since the seal was put in place. Also known as, Tamper Seal, Tamperseal Signature, and Tamper Evident Signature.
The digital signature of a SMART document.
Physical assets.

Targeted area residences are residences located in a census tract in which 70 percent or more of the families have income that is 80 percent or less of the statewide median family income, as defined under Internal Revenue Code Section 143, subsection j, paragraph 2, subparagraph A. The determination that a census tract is a qualified census tract must be based on the most recent decennial census for which data are available, as provided under subsection j, paragraph 2, subparagraph B of the same section. Often called a “targeted area.”
The exemption or reduction of local taxes on a project for a specific period of time.

terms.term: Tax Abatements Or Exemptions Annual Amount
terms.definition: The annual amount granted in tax reductions or exemptions.

terms.term: Tax Abatements Or Exemptions Expiration Date
terms.definition: The date when the tax reduction or exemption expires.

terms.term: Tax Advances On Accounts Not Escrowed Indicator
terms.definition: Indicates that the Servicer has incurred advances to pay delinquent taxes on a non-escrowed account.

The taxes and insurance amount (excluding Optional Insurance) that is a part of the total payment being reported. This includes any mortgage insurance, all taxes, and property and casualty insurance amounts that are to be placed in an escrow account.

terms.term: Tax And Insurance Payment Effective Date
terms.definition: The effective date of the Tax and Insurance Amount that is being reported.
Evidence of a collateral assessment process referencing the property tax assessed value without a physical inspection and relying only assessor data or tax cards.
A number assigned by the taxing authority to identify the tax bill (parcel number, account number, etc.) This may not be the same as the City, State or County Assessor Parcel Identifier.
Identifies the type of tax to be paid.
A free-form text field used to capture the Tax Authority Type if Other is selected as the Tax Authority Type.
Authorizes the tax collector to send the tax bill to the respective mortgagee, servicing or processing organization. AKA: Tax Escrow Account Designation, Initial Tax Authorization Notice.

A taxpayer's cost of property for tax purposes, including cash paid and the principal amount of mortgage debt encumbering the property at the time of acquisition. The property's tax basis is increased from time to time by additional cash investment in the property, and is decreased from time to time by tax deductions (such as depreciation) relating to the property and by cash withdrawals.
Describes taxes charged by state or local governments. AKA: Tax Information Sheet, Tax Bill, Property Tax Statement.
The contract number assigned to the loan by the tax service.

terms.term: Tax Contract Life of Loan Indicator
terms.definition: Indicates if the tax contract is transferable with the loan.
The date the request for a tax contract was submitted.
Sub identification number to identify each parcel associated with the property under contract.

An expense that the government allows you to subtract from your income before tax liability is computed. The federal government allows you to subtract certain itemized deductions such as mortgage interest in lieu of utilizing the standard deduction.
A deed on property purchased at public sale for nonpayment of taxes.
An agreement between a landlord and tenant whereby the tenant absorbs any increase in real estate taxes attributable to the leased property.
Indicates if monies for this tax item are escrowed.
Indicates whether the mortgagor has an exemption for payment of this tax item.
A claim filed against a property, a person or an entity for unpaid taxes.
Releases a tax lien against a property, person, or entity. AKA: Satisfaction of Taxes.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that identifies the method of tax payment selected by a Borrower based on state specific requirements.

terms.term: Tax Payment Option Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Tax Payment Option Type.
Indicates that the IRS form (4506 or 4506T) that gives the lender the authority to request copies of tax records has been executed by the lender.

Reports information used to calculate income and income taxes. This is a generic document type used for any IRS tax return document when the specific IRS tax return document type is unknown or unnecessary. Valid AKA: Partnership Return, Corporate Return, Individual Return, S-Corporation, Schedule K1, Schedule D.
The year ending date for the tax return period covered by the requested copy of transcript or tax return request.

terms.term: Tax Return Transcript Request Customer File Number
terms.definition: A numeric value that specifies the customer file number applicable to item 5b on IRS Form 4506-T and 4506-C.
The sale of property by a taxing authority or an officer of the court acting on a judgment to satisfy the payment of delinquent taxes.
A service performed by a tax service company which identifies the payment due date of local taxes for the servicer.
A reduction of taxable income through the reinvestment of earnings on capital; any investment that postpones or avoids tax payments.
A provision in a lease whereby real estate tax increases imposed on the lessor are passed along to the lessee as additional rent.
A bond partly or wholly exempt from federal and/or state income tax.
The financing of an urban renewal project by a bond issue to be serviced from the anticipated additional tax revenues generated by the renewal process.
The portion of the monthly mortgage that is allocated to the property tax on the subject property.
A document which assigns a taxpayer identifier to a party. Evidences a party's identity and taxpayer identifier value.

terms.term: Taxpayer Identification: Numero De Identificacion Tributaria
terms.definition: In Bolivia, Colombia, El Salvador and Guatemala the taxpayer identifier is called Numero De Identificacion Tributaria, or NIT. Evidences a persons identity and taxpayer identifier.

A value from a MISMO prescribed list that classifies identification numbers used by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) in the administration of tax laws. A Social Security number (SSN) is issued by the SSA; all other taxpayer identification numbers are issued by the IRS.
The specific value of the taxpayer identifier as assigned by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) to the individual or legal entity.
When true, indicates that taxpayer has been a victim of identity theft.
A starting rate which is below the fully indexed accrual rate (FIAR) on an adjustable rate mortgage.
A securities valuation strategy based on the philosophy that past price movement patterns are useful for predicting future price movements.
A lower interest rate on a mortgage for a fixed period at the beginning of the mortgage term.

terms.term: Ten Or More Parking Spaces Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that the identified car storage type has ten or more parking spaces.
Confirms existence of the insurance policy that covers the property against defects in workmanship. Provided by Insurance company. AKA: 2-10 Warranty.
The use of real estate under any kind of right of title.
A holding of real estate without agreement or fixed term of possession, that can be terminated at the will of either the lessor or lessee.
A form of ownership in which husband and wife are co-owners with rights of survivorship.
A form of undivided ownership interest by two or more persons that provides for no right of survivorship. The interest need not be of equal percentage.
A type of ownership whereby real property is held in the name of the partnership rather than in the name of individual partners.

One who is not the owner but occupies real property under consent of the owner and in subordination to the owner's title. The tenant is entitled to exclusive possession, use and enjoyment of the property, usually for a time and amount specified in the lease.
All costs that are a pro rata responsibility of the tenant over and above the contract rent specified in the lease, for example, a fee for common area maintenance.
Constructed improvements to the base building, such as interior partitions, drop ceilings, and other finishes which prepare a space for occupancy and use by a tenant.
In commercial real estate, an arrangement of tenants who offer different products or services and, when placed together, complement one another in their ability to attract customers.
The period of time between the commencement date and termination date of a note, mortgage, legal document or other contract.
A free-form text field describing a specific requirement or exception.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that identifies a condition for a Commitment or Preliminary Title Report as a Requirement or an Exception.
A mortgage in which, for a specified period of time, only interest is paid, after which the principal is due.
The state or condition of leaving a will at death.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies whether a party has consented to receiving text messages.

A process in natural language processing (NLP) that involves condensing a longer text document into a shorter summary. It aims to capture the most important information and express it in a concise form, making it easier to quickly understand the essence of the original text.

Attempts to state the circumstance under which lenders would not be deemed "participating in the management" of "influencing" the control, handling or disposal of hazardous materials at a borrower's property, and, therefore, would not be liable for their remediation.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the structural components that have thermal rated insulation.
An enumeration or a coded value identifying the Thermal Zone that the manufactured home was designed and constructed to conform to.
The change in the time value of an option between points in time.
A market characterized by low liquidity and trading volume. Price fluctuations relative to volume tend to be wide, as are spreads between bid and ask prices.
One not a party to an agreement or a transaction, but who may have rights therein.
Used when a third party employment verification vendor provides verification of employment.

terms.term: Third Party Investor Fee Pass Through Percent
terms.definition: The percentage of fees paid by the borrower that are passed through to a third party investor.

terms.term: Third Party Investor Interest Pass Through Percent
terms.definition: The percentage of interest payments made by the borrower that are passed through to a third party investor.

terms.term: Third Party Investor Principal Pass Through Percent
terms.definition: The percentage of principal payments made by the borrower that are passed through to a third party investor.

terms.term: Third Party Loan Acquisition Price Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount that was paid by the seller to acquire the loan from a third party.
Indicates that a third party due diligence review firm has reviewed the loan data.

The process of corresponding with interested third parties regarding the servicing administration of a loan. Third parties include but are not limited to mortgage insurers, hazard insurers, optional insurance vendors, tax service companies, homeowners associations (HOA) and attorneys.
When true, indicates that the winning bid at the foreclosure sale was submitted by a party other than the servicer.

Entity or individual that completely or partially takes the mortgage loan application from a borrower. A TPO may process, underwrite or fund the mortgage before transferring, assigning or selling it to another mortgage lender.
Savings banks or savings and loan associations.
A minimum change in price up or down. In the mortgage securities market, a tick is of a point in price.
A market in which trading volume is high and competitive, and spreads between bid and ask prices are narrow.
Truth In Lending
Informs the borrower of the annual percentage rate, or APR, of the borrower's loan as well as other facets of the mortgage program. Required by TILA / Regulation Z. AKA: TIL, TILD.
The date as reflected on a single instance of the TIL Disclosure document.
The estimated total amount of the payment that is applied for the payment period specified on the TIL Disclosure document.
The amount of the payment that is applied toward interest for the payment period specified on the TIL Disclosure document.
The interest rate in effect during a specified payment period specified on the TIL Disclosure document.

terms.term: TIL Negative Amortization Full Principal Payment Amount
terms.definition: For a negative amortization loan, the full principal payment amount as reflected for the payment period as disclosed on the TIL Disclosure document.

terms.term: TIL Negative Amortization Minimum Principal Payment Amount
terms.definition: For a negative amortization loan, the minimum principal payment amount as reflected for the payment summary period as disclosed on the TIL Disclosure document.
The date of the payment adjustment for this TIL Payment Summary Item as disclosed on the TIL Disclosure document.
Specifies the type of this Payment Summary Item.

terms.term: TIL Payment Summary Item Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for TIL Payment Summary Item Type.
The length of the payment period as it relates to the TIL Period Duration Type for the TIL Payment Summary Item as disclosed on the TIL Disclosure document.
The type of payment period applicable to the TIL Payment Summary Item as disclosed on the TIL Disclosure document.

terms.term: TIL Primary Boxes Loan Calculations Are Estimates Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that the calculated values for the APR, Finance Charge, Amount Financed, Total of Payments, and Total Sales Price (disclosed in the five primary boxes of the TIL) are estimated values.
The amount of the payment that is applied toward principal for the payment period specified on the TIL Disclosure document.

terms.term: TIL Taxes And Insurance Escrow Payment Amount
terms.definition: The amount of the payment that is applied toward payment of taxes and/or insurance for the payment period specified on the TIL Disclosure document.
A phrase in a contract stating that performance within a specified period of time is an essential element of the transaction.
The value of an option above its intrinsic value.
Flag indicating if the loan is eligible for a rate reduction if payments are received in a timely manner.
The percentage amount the interest rate will be reduced if payments are made in a timely manner.

Written evidence of the right to or ownership in property. In the case of real estate, the documentary evidence of ownership is the title deed that specifies in whom the legal estate is vested and the history of ownership and transfers. Title may be acquired through purchase, inheritance, devise, gift or through foreclosure of a mortgage.
Describes the result of a title search of public records. This is the source document that produces the conditions in a title commitment. Provided by Title Insurance company. AKA: Title Search.
The date the public records, upon which the abstract relies, were last updated.
The detailed description of the exception on the Title product.
Indicates that the exception is included in the Title product.
The detailed description of the requirement for Title Commitments, Title Search Reports and other like documents.

terms.term: Title Additional Requirement To Be Recorded Indicator

Process of reviewing data on each insurance policy for the subject property to confirm effective dates, Borrower information, address, occupancy, and premiums are accurate for the loan.

terms.term: Verify Prior to Close Conditions Met
terms.definition: Process of confirming all conditions, required prior to closing, have been satisfied.

terms.term: Verify Prior to Funding Conditions Met
terms.definition: Process of confirming all conditions required to be met prior to funding have been satisfied.

terms.term: Verify Settlement and Title Agent Provided Docs
terms.definition: Process of reviewing documents provided by the Settlement Agent and/or the Title Agent specific to the loan closing.
Process that includes adding the mortgage loss payee clause, and verifying sufficient coverage and policy data.
The process of determining the veteran's disability benefit status and related VA Funding Fee.
The technology that tells the viewer which version of MISMO is being used.
A standard such as MISMO that focuses on one specific industry, and rides on top of a horizontal standard (such as SML or XHTML).
A legal claim or right to the present or future enjoyment of real property.
Indicates whether the vesting data has been validated.

When true, indicates the borrower qualifies as a Veteran under HUD guidelines and that the loan application should be evaluated as a 203(b)(2) Veteran Loan. If any borrower qualifies as a Veteran under VA guidelines then the loan (including all borrowers) may be processed as a VA loan application.
See DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS.
Any information or instructions regarding a document view that a preparer includes to assist the recipient with understanding the contents or processing rules.
An identifier for the current instance of VIEW. The party assigning the identifier should be provided using the IdentifierOwnerURI.
Indicates that a document view is recorded in the public records.
The number of pages in a document view.
When true, indicates that the associated ViewType is the primary view.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the extent of the view.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for View Range Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the specific view types as observed for valuation purposes by the appraiser that may affect desirability and market value.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for View Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list which represents the overall rating of the differences between the comparable and the subject for all views associated with the rental unit.

A document that authorizes a person to enter the territory for which it was issued. A visa may be a document, but more commonly it is a stamp endorsed in the person's passport. Evidences a person's identity and visa identifier..
When true, indicates that a visual observation was completed, as defined by the applicable organization's policy or guideline.
The ability of a machine or program to receive and interpret dictation or understand and carry out spoken commands.
The sensitivity of a security's price to changes in the overall market. Also, interest rate fluctuations resulting from an unstable market.
Volume or Book number assigned to recorder document by the recorder.
Volume type of the document referenced in the subject document.
A description of the volume type when Other is selected from the enumerated list.
Identifies the type of volume measurement method applied.

An elective transfer of property title from a defaulting borrower to the lender, as an alternative to foreclosure. This arrangement saves the lender the expense of foreclosure, and the borrower receives credit for payment in full.
A voluntary action filed under the United States Bankruptcy Code (the "Code") by a debtor seeking protection under the Code.
Authorizes lender to increase borrower's escrow accounts. AKA: VEPD.
Identification used for voting in a governmental election that contains the voter's name and address.
The employee of a Member who receives all MISMO communications and votes on behalf of the Member on all MISMO matters.
In construction lending, system of "paying" subcontractors vouchers in lieu of cash; they then redeem the documents to the construction lender for actual payment.
IRS form which reports income paid and taxes withheld by an employer for a particular employee during a calendar year.
IRS form which determines the amount of Federal taxes the employer will withhold from a person's paycheck each pay period.

terms.term: Wage And Income Transcript Requesting Position Type
terms.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents wage and income tax payer position.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents wage and income transcript options.

terms.term: Wage And Income Transcript Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Wage and Income Transcript Type.
The written evidence from a contractor or supplier, surrendering the right of lien to enforce collection of debt against a property.
An endorsement issued by an insurer that waives its right of subrogation against a third party. It is usually requested by an insured in conjunction with a lease.

terms.term: Waiver Of Trial By Jury Provision
terms.definition: A provision in a loan document whereby the borrower and/or lender waive their respective rights to a trial by jury in a legal action/lawsuit on a loan document.
The specific value of a walk score which is a measure of the walkability from the property to services such as grocery stores or other amenities. The score is defined by www.walkscore.com.
Funds borrowed in excess of costs required to develop and build a real estate project.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the type of wall material used for the structure.
A free-form text field used to describe the wall material if Other is selected as the Wall Material Type.
The dollar amount of the advance against a warehouse line of credit.

An organization that provides a line of credit (Warehouse Line) to the Lender to fund the loan closing. Funds are repaid when the loan is sold or transferred to a permanent investor. Note: While the loan is in Warehouse, the Warehouse Bank may also act as the Document Custodian.
Uniquely identifies a subcategory of a warehouse commitment.
A short-term lender for mortgage bankers. Using the note as collateral, the warehouse lender provides interim financing until the mortgage is sold to a permanent investor.
An indicator denoting whether a Warehouse Bank is involved in the mortgage loan transaction through a relationship with the lender.
Loans that are funded and awaiting sale or delivery to an investor.

Short-term borrowing of funds by a mortgage banker using permanent mortgage loans as collateral. The money borrowed is used to make additional mortgage loans. This interim financing is used until the mortgages are sold to a permanent investor.
Difference between the rate at which the mortgage banker is borrowing from the warehouse lender and the interest rate of the underlying collateral mortgages.

Warrants that the builder certifies that the construction of the property is complete. On all properties that receive high loan-to-value financing, the builder must complete prior to closing the loan. AKA Form HUD-92544.
An abuse or destructive use of property by one in rightful possession (such as an owner or tenant).

A list of loans which, while current in terms of monthly payments, pose a potential risk of loss due to deferred maintenance, delinquent real estate taxes, low debt service coverage, major lease expirations or other signs of increasing financial stress on property performance.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that classifies the water depth for watercraft to access.

terms.term: Water Access Depth Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Water Access Depth Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the property access right to the body of water.

terms.term: Water Access Right Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Water Access Right Type.

terms.term: Water Frontage Total Length Linear Measure
terms.definition: A measurement that specifies approximate total linear measurement of all waterfronts. The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Linear Unit Of Measure Type.
A collection of values that specify the type of water heating system present in a property.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for the Water Heater Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the source of water for the property. Also used in conjunction with a type of utility ownership.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Water Source Type.
A collection of values that specify the type of water treatment system present in a property.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for the Water Treatment Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents a type of individual water supply well.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Water Well Type.
When true, indicates that the property rights include the right to improve, build or install waterfront features.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents a natural or man-made component that can reside in or along side a body of water.
A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Waterfront Feature Type.
Identifies the type of weight measurement method applied.
The weighted average of the gross interest rates of the mortgages in a mortgage pool, as of the issue date, with the balance of each mortgage used as a weighing factor.

An average of the different interest rates applicable to the transaction, based on the portions of the amount to which each interest rate applies, when multiple interest rates are applied to different portions of a loan's principal balance in a precomputed transaction.
The weighted average of the remaining terms to maturity of the mortgages in a mortgage pool as of the issue date.
Any advance of new funds to a mortgage banker for funding or purchasing mortgage loans where the collateral package is not in possession of the collateral agent or is not free of lien or bailment.
A signature that is executed with ink on paper.

Work Groups (WGs) and Communities of Practice (COP) conduct MISMOs product development work. Composition, operations, functions, and activities of the WG/COPs are defined in the MISMO Development Process Document (DPD)5: Separate DPDs exist for Residential and Commercial product development. Work Group and Community of Practice participants need not be affiliated with MISMO Members.
Results of topical discussions of interest to the mortgage industry published by MISMO.
The dollar amount of interest due on the date which the whole loan was sold to the investor.
The dollar amount of principal balance outstanding on the date which the whole loan was sold to the investor.
The date on which the whole loan was sold to the investor.
Unsecured mortgages sold individually to investors.

A loan origination strategy by which loans are purchased from mortgage brokers, mortgage bankers or other loan originators (banks, thrifts, etc.) The loans may be purchased prior to closing, at closing or after the loans are closed depending on the arrangement between the originator and the wholesale lender. Wholesale origination enables a lender to acquire mortgage servicing rights without incurring the fixed costs associated with a retail origination strategy.
A measurement that specifies the width.The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Linear Unit Of Measure Type.
An enumeration or a coded value identifying the Wind Zone that the manufactured home was designed and constructed to conform to.
A free-form text field used to describe in detail the identified window type.
A measurement that specifies the combined surface area for all windows in the structure. The applicable unit of measurement is specified by the Area Unit Of Measure Type.
Specifies the type of windows on the property.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Window Type.
Work in Progress. Any MISMO Standard or MISMO Collateral that is in the development process including a standard or collateral that has been sent to the public for comment.
Process of executing the wiring of loan funds following the receipt of wire instructions from a secure and valid source.
Describes the procedure for wiring funds to escrow account. Provided by closing agent.
Authorizes a wire transfer of funds. AKA: Wire Set Up Authorization, Seller Wire/Change Authorization.
Confirms that the recipient is in receipt of funds sent via bank wire process.
The amount of funds that are required to satisfy the wire transfer item, specified by the WireTransferLineItemDescription.
A free-form text field describing a payment for a specific disbursement.

terms.term: Wire Transfer Line Item Section Type
terms.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the title or description of a sub section of the Wire Amount Validation section of the Closing Instruction document.
A mortgage in which the lender will not pursue personal liability against the borrower. The lender's security is the real estate being financed.

terms.term: Wood Destroying Insect Information, Existing Construction (VA Form 26-8850/HUD Form 92053)
terms.definition: A form used to report the findings of a pest control operator, in response to a condition imposed on conditional commitment or CRV, that an existing property be inspected for insect damage.

Development Process Document Only: As used in this document, "Work Group" refers to all of the volunteer industry working groups that develop MISMO Products including AWG, IM, DWG, COP. NOTE: Contrary to its use throughout the P&Ps, the term Work Group, when used to refer to the Work Group License, encompasses all MISMO groups: the Board, GCs, WGs, and any other subgroups or committees Policies and Procedures Only: As used in the Policies and Procedures, "Work Group" refers to the contributor industry and development work groups that develop MISMO Work Products.
A brief statement describing a DWG's or Community of Practice's purpose and scope.
Process by which a fully verified loan application is prepared by the processor for underwriting.
The excess of current assets over current liabilities.
The ratio of current assets to current liabilities; one of the most commonly used ratios to indicate a company's financial position.
An alternative action to foreclosure for the benefit of the lender and the borrower. Includes loan modification, short sales and various forms of forbearance. Also called "restructure."
When true, indicates that the loan is actively in the workout process.
A plan between the lender and borrower to bring a delinquent or defaulted mortgage current.
The amount of cash the borrower is able to contribute to the workout transaction.
A free form text field that contains comments about the specified Workout Comment Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that describes that specifies the type of comment about the workout.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected as the Workout Comment Type.
The date on which the workout agreement goes into effect.
The date and time that the workout was evaluated.
Order in which the workout types should be considered by the servicer.
Categorizes the process status of the workout as defined by investor policy guidelines.
Identifies the program associated with the workout.
The date associated with the specified Workout Qualification Status Type.
Specifies the qualification status of the workout.

terms.term: Workout Qualification Status Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected as the Workout Qualification Status Type.
A unique identifier of the version of the workout rules used in a workout evaluation.
The date on which the workout is scheduled to be completed.
A unique identifier of the workout solicitation program.
The date on which the associated Workout Status Type ended.
The date on which the associated Workout Status Type occurred.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the status of the corresponding Workout Type.
A free-form text field used to provide a supplemental comment or remark regarding the Workout Status Type.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Workout Status Type.
The date on which the most recent workout was submitted.
A unique identifier of the investor defined subtype of workout category that is under evaluation.
Specifies a hierarchy of suitability of all workouts offered to the borrower based on eligibility of the borrower.
The date to which the term of the workout was extended.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the method used to facilitate the workout or loss mitigation of a loan in default.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Workout Type.
Specifies the reason that a workout was not successful.

terms.term: Workout Unsuccessful Reason Type Other Description
terms.definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected as the Workout Unsuccessful Reason Type.
Describes the procedure for performing an analysis or making a determination and captures results of the work.

The World Wide Web Consortium was created to lead the World Wide Web to its full potential by developing common protocols and standards that promote its evolution and ensure its interoperability. This term is also defined in the MERS eRegistry Procedures Manual available at members.mersinc.org.
A scenario in which the rate of an adjustable rate mortgage increases as fast as the caps will allow, i.e., the worst that can happen.
A refinancing technique involving the creation of a second mortgage which includes the balance due on any existing mortgages, plus the amount of the new secondary or junior lien.

To use an Encryption Key to authenticate the combination of an electronic record and existing electronic signatures associated with that electronic record, or to detect alterations to the combination of the electronic record and the prior electronic signatures, or to authenticate or detect alterations in a package of multiple electronic records.
A court order authorizing an official to execute a decision such as eviction of a tenant or selling property (a writ to carry out the judgment or decree of a court).
Wall Street Journal
The signature made by a person who is unable to sign their name. This type of signature is only legally valid when witnessed by another person.
The uniform standards for the electronic interchange of business documents developed by the American National Standards Institute. EDI transaction sets are developed using these standards.

The standard that defines the format of the public certificates (i.e., Digital Certificates) in the Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) used by the MERS eRegistry to encrypt data transmitted to/from the MERS eRegistry and digitally sign the XML messages sent to/by the MERS eRegistry. (https://www.mismo.org/standards-resources/mismo-product/esignatures). This term is also defined in the MERS eRegistry Procedures Manual available at members.mersinc.org.
XML Advanced Electronic Signatures
eXtensible Linking is a W3C standard that defines how one document or XML element links to another. XLINK is used in SMART Doc Relationships.
An xlink set of attributes that identifies two end points and the kind of relationship they have to each other.
An xlink attribute group for defining the end point of a relationship.

Extensible Markup Language. XML is a markup language designed specifically for delivering information over the World Wide Web. Defined by the W3C, it is a set of rules for encoding documents in a format that is both human-readable and machine-readable. This term is also defined in the MERS® eRegistry Procedures Manual available at members.mersinc.org.
A data container within an XML file: <ElementName>Actual Data</ElementName>
XML Schemas express shared vocabularies and support rules-based application processing. They provide a means for defining the structure, content, and semantics of XML documents.

The ISO 639-1 two character code value representing the langage of the text of the element data point. For example en for English es for spanish. If no ISO639-1 value exists for the language use the ISO639-2 three character value. For example Philippine languages phi.
A roadmap in XML that specifies exact data points to follow.
eXtensible Stylesheet Language. A language defined by the W3C for the presentation of XML.
eXtensible Stylesheet Language Formatting Objects. A language defined by the W3C to convert XML to other representations such as PDF.
eXtensible Stylesheet Language Transformations. A language defined by the W3C to convert XML to other representations such as XHTML.

terms.term: Year To Date Hazard Insurance Premiums Paid Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount of hazard insurance premiums paid on a loan during the summary year.

terms.term: Year To Date Interest Paid Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount of interest paid on a loan during the summary year.

terms.term: Year To Date Late Charges Paid Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount of late charges paid on a loan during the summary year.

terms.term: Year To Date MI Premiums Paid Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount of mortgage insurance (MI) premiums charges paid on a loan during the summary year.

terms.term: Year To Date Principal Paid Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount of principal paid on a loan during the summary year.

terms.term: Year To Date Taxes Paid Amount
terms.definition: The dollar amount of real estate taxes paid on a loan during the summary year.
The ratio of investment income to the total amount invested over a given period of time.
A graphic representation of market yield for a fixed income security plotted against the maturity of the security.

The prepayment premium which will equal the present value of any costs to the lender resulting from the difference in interest rates between the date of the note and the date on which the prepayment is made.
The lender's percentage of annual return on actual funds loaned, assuming that the loan will be paid in full at maturity.
The final class in a multiclass mortgage-backed security which receives no principal or interest until all other classes are retired.
A bond which pays no interest until maturity, but is sold at a discount from its redemption price.
Long-term commercial financing that defers all principal and interest payments until maturity.

The positioning of a structure on a lot so that one side rests directly on the lot's boundary line. Although such construction is usually prohibited by setback ordinances, it can be a part of a special space-conserving project.
The creation of districts by local governments in which specific types of property uses are authorized.

terms.term: Zoning Permit Rebuild To Current Density Indicator
terms.definition: When true, indicates that the zoning regulations allow the property to rebuild to the current density.
